izzyondroid:me.ananas.hyperlinkknapsack.name: Hyperlink Knapsack
izzyondroid:me.ananas.hyperlinkknapsack.description:
This is a link manager app for Android. There is already plenty of link manager software available to choose from, but from what I've seen all of them are either accessible as a website only or have a mobile app that is also a webapp. This application is therefore built using native Android components to offer a satisfyingly smooth performance on mobile devices.
 The app doesn't store any links locally, but loads them dynamically into an infinitely scrollable list from a REST API.
 LinkAce has been my favourite bookmarking software for quite some time now, so for now that is the only backend service this app supports. I'm planning to add support for at least one backend some time later, which explains why the LinkAce lists are referred to as collections in the app instead.
 To connect to your LinkAce server, tap the triple dots menu in the top right, then Settings . In the Server section specify your server address in a http[s]://<address>[:<port>]/ format and then paste the API token from your LinkAce dashboard into the API key field.

apple-macos:6740553198.name: FlowDown - Open & Fast AI
apple-macos:6740553198.description:
FlowDown is a fast, minimal AI chat app that makes working with large language models feel smooth, focused, and under your control.
For guides, tips, and advanced setup help, visit flowdown.ai.
Why FlowDown
Lightweight and efficient 
Focus on your conversation, not the app. FlowDown launches quickly, stays out of your way, and keeps long chats responsive, even on busy machines.
Rich formatting with Markdown 
Get clear, readable answers. FlowDown renders Markdown beautifully, so code blocks, bullet lists, tables, and headings in AI responses are easy to scan and use.
Works with the tools you already have 
Connect to any OpenAI-compatible API, from major cloud providers to services running in your own home lab. If it speaks the OpenAI API, FlowDown can talk to it.
Talk with text, images, and audio 
Show, not just tell. Paste screenshots, drop in images, or record your voice to ask questions. Use it to:
- Transcribe meetings or lectures
- Summarize voice notes
- Ask about the content inside a photo
Smooth, instant-feeling conversations 
Blazing-fast text rendering makes responses stream in fluidly, so you can start reading and refining your prompt without waiting for the model to finish.
Automatic chat titles 
Stop hunting for the right thread. FlowDown names your conversations automatically based on their content, so you can quickly find that "API bug fix" or "Trip planning" chat later.
Shortcut integrations 
Use FlowDown inside your workflows. With Shortcuts support, you can:
- Send selected text from another app to your model
- Generate drafts, summaries, or replies with one tap
- Build custom automations that call your favourite model
Privacy by design 
Your data is yours. FlowDown does not collect your chats. For maximum confidentiality, you can run models locally on your own machine with no external server involved.
Open source and transparent 
Every line of code is available on GitHub. Inspect it, audit it, or adapt it for your own setups. You can see exactly how your AI client works.
Open code
FlowDown is fully open source.
Source code is available at: 
https://github.com/Lakr233/FlowDown 
Local models
For offline, private usage, FlowDown can run models locally on Apple Silicon devices with sufficient memory.
Supported model families include: 
Cohere, Gemma, Gemma2, Gemma3, InternLM2, Llama / Mistral, OpenELM, Phi, Phi3, PhiMoE, Qwen2, Qwen3, Starcoder2, MiMo, and GLM4.
This gives you:
- Full control over your data
- No dependency on external servers
- The ability to experiment with different open models
Remote models
A complimentary remote model is included so you can start chatting immediately. This starter service is best-effort, with rate limits and no uptime guarantee.
For consistent, reliable use, we recommend:
- Bringing your own API, or
- Hosting your own inference server on local or home-lab hardware
FlowDown supports all OpenAI-compatible endpoints, making it ideal for connecting to tools like Ollama and LM Studio running on your own machine for maximum privacy.
Some setups require technical knowledge. If you are new to self-hosted AI or custom endpoints, please read our documentation carefully; the app can be challenging without it.
For advanced or enterprise use, configuration examples and best practices are documented on our website.
Important note
AI-generated content can be inaccurate or misleading. Always verify critical information and use FlowDown responsibly; you are responsible for how you use the output.
© 2025 FlowDown Team. All rights reserved.

apple-macos:6799450691.name: Weather Magic PWS
apple-macos:6799450691.description:
Weather Magic PWS puts your own personal weather station on your iPhone. It reads the data your station already sends to Weathercloud and shows your readings as they come in. You can also connect your own station's Weather Underground account (optional).
If your station goes offline, Weather Magic PWS can use a nearby backup station so you still see current conditions until your station is back.
FREE
- Live data from your home station
- Today's graphs
- One backup station
Free does not include long-term history, cloud storage or data export.
PRO: ONE UNLOCK FOR IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription. Buy it once and it unlocks Pro on your iPhone, iPad and Mac. On iPhone and iPad you can try Pro free for 30 days first, once; the trial never renews or charges. Pro adds:
- Your station's history and week, month and year graphs, read from your own cloud database. Long-range graphs load quickly because they use hourly and daily averages.
- Your own cloud database: choose Turso or Supabase and connect an account you control
- Multiple devices: one computer, such as your Mac, collects your station's data every minute. If it stops, another computer takes over automatically. Your iPhone and iPad view the data from the cloud.
- A second backup station
- Air quality
- Near-real-time lightning: the wind vane shows nearby strikes on 1, 5, 10 and 20 mile rings with a flashing bolt. On iPhone and iPad, lightning comes from your collecting computer through your cloud database, so no key is needed here.
- Data export
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Your station's data goes only to your own database. It is not sent to us. Data read from public backup stations is used only in the app and is never pushed back to its source.
GOOD TO KNOW
- Weather Magic PWS is built for owners of a personal weather station that sends its data to Weathercloud. Connecting your own station's Weather Underground account is optional.
- Viewing history from the cloud needs Pro, your own Turso or Supabase account, and a computer running Weather Magic PWS to collect your station's data.
- Lightning data is provided by OpenWeather and requires a free OpenWeather account and API key on your collecting computer. Pro setup there walks you through creating one. No key is needed if your weather station reports lightning itself.
- Air quality and lightning depend on the data available for your area.
- Readings come from your station and the sources you connect, and may sometimes be delayed or unavailable.
Not for lightning safety decisions.

apple-macos:1035237815.name: Commander One PRO: FTP & Cloud
apple-macos:1035237815.description:
Commander One PRO is a powerful FTP client developed in Swift with a dual-pane interface. The app offers a wide range of enhanced functionality for efficient and seamless work with files, documents, archives, remote servers, cloud computing services, etc. It caters to the needs of both everyday users and developers/administrators alike, providing convenience and versatility across various tasks.
The app supports FTP/SFTP protocols, and WebDAV as well. You can connect to multiple remote servers simultaneously, access and manage files as if they were local ones, all within an intuitive two-pane interface. Besides, Commander One PRO offers robust file transfer capabilities, letting you use FTP to transfer files between servers without the need to download them to your Mac. 
Commander One PRO uses Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) with a 256-bit key length, making it a reliable and secure FTP manager for your data. This strong encryption mechanism ensures the utmost protection for your online connections and files. 
With a variety of connection options available, you can easily copy files directly from FTP to S3/Google Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive and other cloud storage services. Forget about the hassle of downloading and re-uploading files manually. With Commander One PRO, sharing files is as easy as dragging and dropping between two panels.
Work with Cloud Services:
- Ensure additional protection to the files stored online due to the Encryption feature.
- Connect your personal or business Dropbox accounts and gain full access to your files.
- Share Dropbox links right from Commander One PRO.
- Connect your Google Drive account and work with your files and folders, including “Shared with me” folder.
- Support for Google Shared Drives (formerly Team Drives).
- Mount Microsoft OneDrive on Mac and access your online files as any local ones.
- Mount the entire Amazon S3 account or just a specific bucket.
- Flawlessly handle files stored on Amazon S3 accounts.
- Connect S3-compatible storages to your Mac.
- Easily mount and manage files on OpenStack.
- Manage your Mega files and folders without saving them on Mac.
- Gain total control over your files stored on pCloud.
- Get full support for Box.com directly from Commander One PRO.
- Have access to your files stored on Backblaze B2 right from Commander One’s PRO window.
Work with archives:
- Work with 7zip archives as regular folders: view, add, or remove files without extracting.
- Create 7zip archives protected with a password.
- Have full control over your TAR packages (TBZ, TGZ, Tar.Z, tar.lzma and tar.xz) including compression, extraction, opening as a folder with support for search archive contents.
- Unpack RAR format with ease, search archive contents, copy files without even extracting them.
- Deal with .zip, .ipa, .apk, .jar, .ear, .war, .xpi, .cab, .bz, .bz2, .taz, .z, .gz, .xz, .tb, .tb2 files as with regular folders.
Support for MTP devices:
Have a seamless work with any MTP device. To access and edit their contents - just connect your device to Mac and it will be shown as a mounted drive.
Highly customizable:
- Commander One PRO, a reliable FTP client for Mac, includes pre-designed color themes and allows you to create your very own theme for maximum convenience and individual appearance.
- Set up fonts to obtain visual convenience.
Take your workflow to the next level. Download Commander One PRO and experience fast, secure, and convenient file transfer and management.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension that converts GitHub Flavored Markdown user syntax to links.

fedora-packages:folly/folly-devel.name: folly-devel
fedora-packages:folly/folly-devel.description: Folly (acronymed loosely after Facebook Open Source Library) is a library of C++14 components designed with practicality and efficiency in mind. Folly contains a variety of core library components used extensively at Facebook. In particular, it's often a dependency of Facebook's other open source C++ efforts and place where those projects can share code. It complements (as opposed to competing against) offerings such as Boost and of course std. In fact, we embark on defining our own component only when something we need is either not available, or does not meet the needed performance profile. We endeavor to remove things from folly if or when std or Boost obsoletes them. Performance concerns permeate much of Folly, sometimes leading to designs that are more idiosyncratic than they would otherwise be (see e.g. PackedSyncPtr.h, SmallLocks.h). Good performance at large scale is a unifying theme in all of Folly. The folly-devel package contains libraries and header files for developing applications that use folly.

fedora-packages:ghc-semigroupoids/ghc-se.name: ghc-semigroupoids
fedora-packages:ghc-semigroupoids/ghc-se.description: Provides a wide array of (semi)groupoids and operations for working with them. A 'Semigroupoid' is a 'Category' without the requirement of identity arrows for every object in the category. A 'Category' is any 'Semigroupoid' for which the Yoneda lemma holds. When working with comonads you often have the '<*>' portion of an 'Applicative', but not the 'pure'. This was captured in Uustalu and Vene's "Essence of Dataflow Programming" in the form of the 'ComonadZip' class in the days before 'Applicative'. Apply provides a weaker invariant, but for the comonads used for data flow programming (found in the streams package), this invariant is preserved. Applicative function composition forms a semigroupoid.

Here is its tale: Once upon a time the standard "Data.List" module held no function for splitting a list into parts according to a delimiter. Many a brave lambda-knight strove to add such a function, but their striving was in vain, for Lo, the Supreme Council fell to bickering amongst themselves what was to be the essential nature of the One True Function which could cleave a list in twain (or thrain, or any required number of parts). And thus came to pass the split package, comprising divers functions for splitting a list asunder, each according to its nature. And the Supreme Council had no longer any grounds for argument, for the favored method of each was contained therein. To get started, see the "Data.List.Split" module.

fedora-packages:golang-github-mailru-eas.name: golang-github-mailru-easyjson
fedora-packages:golang-github-mailru-eas.description: Package Easyjson provides a fast and easy way to marshal/unmarshal Go structs to/from JSON without the use of reflection. In performance tests, easyjson outperforms the standard encoding/json package by a factor of 4-5x, and other JSON encoding packages by a factor of 2-3x. firefox-addons:2992325.name: Tab Focus
firefox-addons:2992325.summary: Prevent selected tabs from detecting when you switch away.
firefox-addons:2992325.description:
Tab Focus is a browser extension that prevents websites from knowing when you switch away from their tab. When enabled on a tab, it intercepts all tab-switch detection methods used by pages: the Page Visibility API, visibilitychange events, blur and focus events, pagehide, and animation frame throttling. The page always sees itself as visible and focused, no matter what you are actually doing.
You can enable protection per tab with a single click or hotkey, choose between three spoofing modes (full, visibility only, or focus only), and set auto-disable timers. Auto-rules let you protect specific sites automatically every time they load, and tab groups let you enable protection across a set of sites at once. A clean popup gives you a live view of all open tabs, rule management with wildcard pattern matching, import and export, and a stats panel tracking usage over time.

bluejetty:00120829:ios.description:
ALIAS is a word game that you play in teams.
In ALIAS you have to say things in “other words”. The idea is to explain words using synonyms, opposites or clues so that your team mates guess as many words from the card as possible before the sand in the sand timer runs out. The team moves forward on the board the same amount as words guessed. The team to reach the ‘Finish’ first is the winner.
Game Rules
Alias is a team game. It's needed to guess as many words as you can in defined time frame.
Split into 2 groups of equal numbers. The player takes the device in which the pre-activated "Alias" app is started, and tries to explain a group of words from the card.
Game rules:
• Translations or words with the same roots are not allowed.
• If team members guess the root of the words, it can be used to explain in another way • The words are predicted only if the spelling exactly matches to the word written in the card
• The words can be explained without maintaining the sequence.
• Even if the word is predicted by opponent group, it can be accepted as a correct answer
If the word is predicted, player should tap on it (+1 point).
If the word was not violated any rule or explain predicted, it should be unselected.
If user by mistake clicked on the word which is not predicted, it can be pressed once again and the word will be again unselected. During the game, if there is an appeal, it can be edited with pressing on the score button in the scoring page.
If the participants guess all the words on the card, keeping the rules of the game, and there is still residual time, new card will be automatically generated and user can continue explain the new words using the remaining time.
If for some reason there is at least one word left (failed to explain) in the card, then the user can press the "back" button and pass the device to the other team's players. The sum of the scores for all rounds will be automatically calculated in scoring page. The winner is the group which first collects the required points (configured in settings).
Estimate the time spent with friends and have a good time.

bluejetty:00115127:ios.summary:
Your iPhone storage fills up over time — similar photos, duplicate shots, old screenshots, long screen recordings, large videos, Live Photos, and many other forgotten files slowly accumulate in your gallery.
Clean Storage: Phone Cleanup is
bluejetty:00115127:ios.description:
Your iPhone storage fills up over time — similar photos, duplicate shots, old screenshots, long screen recordings, large videos, Live Photos, and many other forgotten files slowly accumulate in your gallery.
Clean Storage: Phone Cleanup is a simple and powerful tool that helps you review, organize, and manage these items in one place.
You can quickly explore each category, decide what to keep, and safely remove files you no longer need. The app also helps you find, merge, and back up duplicate or incomplete contacts to maintain an organized and secure address book.
● Clean Storage: Phone Cleanup Key Features
Duplicate Photos
Automatically detects exact copies of the same image, letting you compare and keep the one you prefer. This helps reduce unnecessary repeats without affecting the quality of your gallery.
Similar Photos
Groups visually similar shots — bursts, multiple takes, or look-alike angles — so you can easily review them side by side and keep only the strongest or most meaningful versions.
Screenshots
Collects old, accidental, or forgotten screenshots into one section. This makes it easier to identify what’s still relevant and remove images that no longer serve a purpose.
Screen Recordings
Shows long or outdated recordings you may have forgotten about, allowing you to review and decide what to keep. Helpful for managing large files that often take more space than expected.
All Videos
Displays all videos in a unified view — including long clips and high-resolution files. This makes it easier to manage space taken by heavy media across your device.
Live Photos
Identifies Live Photos that may not be needed anymore. You can organize them or remove the extras while keeping your favorite dynamic memories safe.
Other Files
Highlights additional media and items that quietly fill up your storage over time. This helps you spot files that are easy to overlook in the regular gallery.
Duplicate Contacts
Finds contacts with matching names, numbers, or emails. You can merge duplicates to keep your address book clean and structured.
Contacts Backup
Creates a backup of your contact list that can be used to restore your data if needed.
● Subscription Terms
You can subscribe for full access to all features within Clean Storage: Phone Cleanup.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase
- Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period
- You can manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase
No need to spend time searching manually — just open the app and review the results. Enjoy a lighter, more organized photo library that keeps only what really matters.
By using Clean Storage: Phone Cleanup, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
Privacy Policy: https://stratadevstudiolimited.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://stratadevstudiolimited.com/terms.html

In 1984, Jerry and Connie Ridley opened their first Ridley's in Payson, Utah. Today, their company has grown to a chain of 31 stores and 2 stand-alone pharmacies.
Ridley's prides itself on being a hometown food and drug store that employs valued members of the local community who enjoy serving their neighbors.
Throughout their growth, Ridley's focus has remained the same: to provide customers with exceptional customer service, quality products, and lower prices than big-box superstores. Ridley's strives to provide both great service and value to their large and loyal customer base and is proud to say that they're, "Small enough to serve you. Large enough to save you money."

bluejetty:00131282:ios.description:
Shmoody: Your Personalized Wellness Companion
Shmoody is your all-in-one self-care and personal growth toolkit, designed to help you navigate tough moments and build uplifting habits over time. We're here to make feeling good feel possible.
Think of us as a space for actionable strategies and uplifting tools to help you feel more balanced, supported, and energized—no matter where you’re starting.
WHAT YOU’LL DISCOVER IN SHMOODY:
Mood Tracker: Reflect and gain insights into your patterns over time.
Instant Boosts: Explore simple actions designed to lift your spirits and energize your day.
Community Support: Connect with like-minded peers for encouragement and accountability.
Personal Growth Challenges: Take small steps that add up to meaningful progress.
Shmoody isn’t just an app—it’s your companion in cultivating a life filled with joy and purpose.
A PERSONALIZED, RELATABLE APPROACH TO WELL-BEING
We’ve been there too. Feeling stuck, unsure of what to do next. That’s why we created Shmoody—to provide practical, science-backed tools and a welcoming, approachable space to explore what works for you.
WHY CHOOSE SHMOODY?
Shmoody is about taking one small step at a time toward feeling better and living well. It's built on real-world insights and designed to fit seamlessly into your life. No pressure, no judgment—just simple, effective tools to support you along the way.

bluejetty:00184918:ios.description:
Radio stanice Srbije od sada možete slušati uživo preko interneta pomoću aplikacije Radio Uživo Srbija. Trenutno imamo najviše radio stanica iz Srbije, a broj radio stanica svakog dana raste.
Narodna muzika, zabavna muzika ili rok muzika izbor je Vaš!
Aplikacija ne radi bez interneta, a sve radio stanice rade 24h uživo! Slušajte srpski radio bilo kada i bilo gde preko svog telefona.
Popularne Srpske radio stanice na vašem mobilnom telefonu možete da pretražujte po žanrovima ili po gradovima. Lista radio stanica se formira prema slušanosti u aplikaciji. Kada izaberite vašu omiljenu radio stanicu pustite je, a aplikacija će ostati u pozadini dok Vi radite bilo šta drugo na vašem telefonu.
Opcija "Omiljene" Vam omogućava da napravite vašu listu omiljenih FM radio stanica i slušate besplatnu muziku kada god poželite.
Opcija "Nedavno" Vam izlistava poslednjih 50 slušanih FM radio stanica tako da se uvek možete vratiti i videti šta ste slušali prethodno.
Srpska muzika po žanrovima:
Narodna muzika, Zabavna muzika, Srpska muzika, muzika uzivo, Rok, Haus, Dens, Tehno muzika, Lagana, Hip-hop, Rep Disco Mix, Romska muzika, Evergrin, Vlaška muzika, Krajiška, Izvorna muzika, Klasična, Starogradska muzika, Kola, Dečija muzika, Exyu, Duhovna, Bluz, Džez ...
Pretražujte srpske radio stanice po gradovima:
Radio Beograd, Radio Novi Sad, Kragujevac, Niš, Subotica, Vršac, Zrenjanin, Požarevac, Pančevo, Valjevo, Smederevo, Jagodina, Paraćin, Ćuprija, Kraljevo , Čačak, Kruševac, Užice, Novi Pazar, Leskovac, Vranje ...
Napomena:
Da bi se besplatna muzika slušala uzivo, aplikacija "Radio Uživo Srbija" zahteva stalnu internet konekciju za slušanje internet radio stanica. Zato je potrebno da imate pristup internetu kako bi je koristili.
Nešto nije do nas:
- Neke radio stanice imaju limite za maksimalni broj slušalaca, pa će delovati kao da ne rade, molimo Vas pokušajte ponovo za nekoliko minuta.
- Neke radio stanice nemaju listu pesama uživo pa je ni mi ne možemo prikazati.
Hvala vam što slušate internet radio stanice iz Srbije i koristite aplikaciju Radio Uživo Srbija.
Privacy Policy: https://www.radioexpert.net/radio-uzivo-srbija-privacy-policy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00165532:ios.description:
Out exploring on your snowmobile? Take your own mobile trail assistant for the ride!
**NEW THIS SEASON**
► Track your trips: leave breadcrumbs for easier backtracking, get statistics on your average speed and distance traveled, and much more!
► List your equipment: keep track of how much distance you covered with a specific vehicle and keep notes on each one.
► Satellite View: enjoy the mobile app with a better basemap and add the Satellite View in your tools!
*****
Vermont Association of Snow Travelers (VAST) brings an enhanced version of its web application to your pockets, making for a better riding experience than ever. Working both with and WITHOUT mobile data coverage, you will be able to enjoy the app’s functionalities no matter where you are on the trails.
This app gives you access to the following *OFFLINE* features, anywhere, anytime, even in areas without cell coverage:
► See your location on the map through your phone’s GPS signal
► View nearby restaurants, gas stations, hotels, parking, and other services
► Access the trail conditions as per the last data connection available
► See the distance between you and a specific point
► Quickly save and load itineraries
Getting back to a zone with mobile coverage? Enjoy these additional *ONLINE* features :
► Keep an eye on updated trail statuses for the best riding experience
► Easily meet with friends by sharing your position with each other (no one else can see your location)
► Plan out an itinerary and share it with your group
Welcome to the Snowmobile Vermont mobile experience and enjoy the ride!
Notes:
►Continued use of the GPS and location sharing running in the background can significantly increase battery consumption. It is recommended to toggle it off when not needed to improve autonomy.
The Pro Version is a 4.99$ USD per year auto-renewable subscription. Payment will be charged to the iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s account settings after purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and identify the renewal cost. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Link to our privacy policy: https://www.evtrails.com/privacy-terms-and-conditions/
Link to our terms of use: https://www.evtrails.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00147067:ios.description:
Vay delivers on-demand electric cars straight to you. Get a car delivered via remote driver, drive it yourself, and end your trip when you're done.
It's the freedom of a rental car with the convenience of an app. No rental counter. No long pickup process. No waiting in the back seat. Just request a car, get in, and drive.
With Vay, you can choose what works best for your trip. Request Driverless Delivery when available and have a car brought to your pickup spot. Or pick up a nearby car yourself and get moving even faster.
Once your Vay arrives, you take the wheel. Use it for errands, appointments, groceries, dinner plans, business trips, quick trips across town, or a few stops in one rental. Your route, your schedule, your music, your space.
Need to park during your trip? Use Stopover to lock the car and keep it reserved while you shop, eat, pick someone up, or run inside. When you are ready, unlock it again and go.
Ending your rental is simple, too. Park the car yourself in an approved area, or use Remote Valet where available and we can park it for you.
Why choose Vay?
● Driverless Delivery
Get an electric rental car delivered to you without a driver inside.
● Drive Yourself
Stay in control of your trip instead of riding as a passenger.
● Flexible Rentals
Use Vay for quick trips, errands, appointments, city plans, and longer everyday needs.
● Stopovers
Keep the car reserved while you make stops along the way.
● Remote Valet
At eligible locations, end your trip and let Vay handle parking.
● Affordability
Vay can be up to 50% cheaper than rideshare or a traditional taxi when you pick up and park the car yourself.
● Electric Cars
Drive clean, quiet EVs designed for easy city travel.
Vay is built for people who want more flexibility than traditional car rental and more control than rideshare. It is car sharing, rental, and driverless delivery in one simple app.
Download Vay today and experience a smarter way to get a car when you need one.
Questions? Visit vay.io or email support@vay.io.

bluejetty:00062777:ios.description:
Together is a free video chat app specifically designed so grandparents, grandkids and other family can safely cultivate meaningful relationships and capture special moments. Play together and talk on a single app made to strengthen your relationships and build family bonds regardless of where you are.
With Together’s interactive calling app, video calls are much more than just a chat. Parents and grandparents can virtually read a bedtime story, play a memory game or draw in real-time on an easy-to-use and safe app. Our unique activities make creating and sharing memories as easy as ever, and help families create incredible moments while video calling.
Video calling apps are a great way to connect with family members, and we make it more secure and fun than ever before. Families can now play and chat together, read interactive stories or delve into their creative sides and draw up a shared masterpiece.
The Together app makes this all possible while capturing precious moments through high-quality video calls. Make digital family communication extra special with the Together video chat app and download today.
TOGETHER FEATURES:
FREE, SAFE & EASY TO USE FAMILY VIDEO CHAT
- Together is kidSAFE Certified meaning parents can enjoy worry-free connections and video chats
- Users of any age can navigate the Together app, making video chats simple for everyone
- Together is perfect for everyone, from grandparents to even the youngest users
READ STORIES WHILE VIDEO CHATTING
- Together offers a library of interactive books to choose from so you can dive into exciting stories
- Read engaging bedtime stories on video together
- Scan your own books and add them to your library with Together’s integrated book scanner
- Browse a selection of Premium books for rental or purchase
VIDEO CHATS WITH FUN ACTIVITIES
- Together brings a new twist to family video chat apps
- Play together with popular games like chutes & ladders, bingo and more within your video chat
- Give family chats a creative spin by drawing together while on video chats
- Keep family communication entertaining with fun video chat games
VIDEO CHATTING WHENEVER YOU WANT
- Enjoy high-quality video chats with loved ones while using the Together app
- Families can bond no matter how far apart they are through a safe app
- Everyone is just a call away with a Together family video chat, focused on bringing families closer
PRICING
- Together is free to use and offers unlimited call time for all plans
- Upgrade to a subscription plan to get access to even more books, games and activities
Thanks so much for supporting the development of this app!
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
- If you choose to purchase our subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://www.kinzoo.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.kinzoo.com/terms

bluejetty:00027146:ios.description:
Accurate Free Golf GPS distances for EVERY golf course worldwide. Play faster, smarter golf with precise distances right when you need them. Have an Apple Watch? Connect in seconds!
Get instant front, middle, and back yardages for confident club selection on every shot. Uncover insights that actually improve your game.
Seamless on-course performance with a clean, fast interface that never slows you down.
Golf Pad is the complete free golf GPS and rangefinder app designed to help you play faster, make smarter decisions, and lower your scores. Get precise distances to the green, hazards, and targets. With fast, reliable GPS, you’ll always know exactly what club to hit. Keep your focus on the game with full Apple Watch support. Get distances, track shots, and manage your round right from your wrist. With plays-like distances that factor in elevation and conditions, plus powerful round tracking and ALL NEW advanced stats, Golf Pad gives you everything you need to improve.
Golf Pad delivers consistent updates, modern features, and exceptional value - all backed by a responsive support team that golfers trust.
Download Golf Pad for free and be ready to play in seconds.
FREE FEATURES:
GPS RANGEFINDER: Accurate distances to the front, middle, and back of every green, plus hazards and layups on every course worldwide
APPLE WATCH: Front, middle and back yardages on your wrist so you can leave the phone in the cart!
DIGITAL SCORECARD: Track scores for up to 4 golfers in stroke play, Stableford, and more. Log putts, penalties, fairways, and sand saves
SHOT TRACKING: Record every shot automatically and measure your real club distances over time
STATS & ROUND HISTORY: Review your strengths, weaknesses, and trends after every round
LIVE LEADERBOARD: Share your round in real time and compete with your group hole by hole
OFFLINE COURSE MAPS: Download courses in advance and play anywhere in the world, even without a signal
PREMIUM FEATURES:
14 Day Trail available any time.
3D GREEN MAPS: Read breaks and slopes on every green for smarter approach shots and better putting on 15,000+ courses
IN DEPTH STROKES GAINED: Find out exactly where you're gaining or losing strokes: hole by hole, shot by shot, club by club
ADVANCED STATS: Deeper charts, custom filters, and full performance breakdowns to pinpoint what to work on
HANDICAP & USGA POSTING: Automatically track your handicap and post scores directly to USGA GHIN
PLAYS-LIKE DISTANCES: Factor in elevation, weather and wind for true carry distances on every shot
CLUB RECOMMENDATIONS: Get personalized club suggestions based on your own performance data
ADVANCED APPLE WATCH FEATURES: Track shots, keep score, green maps and view distances to hazards right on your watch.
MORE GAMES: Play modes like Stableford, Match Play, Skins, Nines
GO AD-FREE: Enjoy more screen real estate and better battery life
"Been using this app for 12 months and find it to be very helpful, in fact priceless on the course. It's simple to use and provides great feedback; distances, hazards, elevation etc. I particularly like the "feels like" distances"
- Neil Morrison

Leave us a review!

Match 3 col
bluejetty:00173772:ios.description:
What do you get when you combine match 3, word puzzles, and inspirational quotes? A match 3 made in heaven! Get your daily dose of positivity with Bold Moves+, the positively relaxing (and challenging) match 3 word puzzle game.
Match 3 colors to collect letter tiles, break through obstacles, and solve the phrase to find inspiration from motivational quotes and positive affirmations. Earn rewards and boosters, progress through chapters of puzzles, and win limited-time events.
CHALLENGE YOUR BRAIN AND YOUR MINDSET
Easy to play but tough to master! Triumph over hundreds of fun match 3 puzzle games set in calming, nature-inspired levels. Earn rewards and achievements with weekly events centered around messages of inner strength, self-reflection, mindfulness, self-care, personal well-being, and life adventures. Put your strategy skills to the test to match, swap, and collect letter tiles. Make matches of three in a row or more to clear colors, remove blocks, and form words. Solve the phrase to reveal celebrity quotes, win games, reach milestones, and move on to the next level of your journey.
RECHARGE YOUR SOUL EVERY DAY
Match 3 games CAN be self-care, for sure! Enjoy encouragement and relaxation with daily rewards and inspiring affirmations to set you on a path of personal growth and empowerment. Immerse yourself in tranquil, zen-like landscapes and peaceful environments, perfect for a meditative escape. Casual gameplay with dazzling combos and power-ups provides a much-needed mental escape, whether for 5 minutes or 5 hours. A refreshing spin on a classic game, Bold Moves+’ quote cards can even serve as a journal or diary full of inspiration for a rainy day!
SPREAD JOY
Share your favorite quotes with friends and spark joy, hope, and happiness.
“It’s no secret that I love sharing quotes with my friends, and Bold Moves presented by OWN is a new game that allows you to do just that—but with a twist: You have to solve a puzzle to unlock the inspirational words." – Oprah Winfrey, regarding the original version of Bold Moves.
Download Bold Moves+ now and start on your path to a happier, more positive you.

bluejetty:00015415:ios.name: Logic Grid Puzzles
bluejetty:00015415:ios.summary: Learn and enjoy Logic Puzzles with 100 unique puzzles of increasing difficulty and multiple sizes. Decode written clues & fill in the grid to solve each puzzle. Work your way up from from beginner to master! Use the unlimited Smart Hints to
bluejetty:00015415:ios.description:
Learn and enjoy Logic Puzzles with 100 unique puzzles of increasing difficulty and multiple sizes. Decode written clues & fill in the grid to solve each puzzle. Work your way up from from beginner to master! Use the unlimited Smart Hints to see exactly which clue applies to the current board and why. Start with small 3×4 puzzles and challenge yourself with huge 4×7 cell puzzles.
Smart Hints examine your solution so far and explain how to fill in another cell by referencing your current board position and telling you what clue to use next (internet access required). 
Other features include Auto-X for faster entry and multi-level Undo. These make it easier and quicker to focus on the logic! If you're completely stuck, you have the ability to check the grid for errors. 
There are never any ads or nags or gimmicks. The app supports iOS iCloud sync and accessibility features, including VoiceOver, Larger Text and Dark Mode. 
If you run out of puzzles there are multiple "100 packs" of new puzzles available for purchase. These are in the same size & quantity as the original free puzzles: 30 each of 3×4 & 30 3×5, and 10 each of 4×4, 4×5, 4×6 & 4×7.
Alternatively, you can purchase an Unlimited Puzzles monthly subscription for $4.99 USD per month (or similar for your country). 
Subscription payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal at the same price as the initial month within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase or using the “Manage Subscriptions” link. There is no free trial.
Logic Grid Puzzles’ privacy and terms of use policies: https://eggheadgames.com/legal/
Email: support@eggheadgames.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/EggheadGames
Web: https://eggheadgames.com
The puzzles are licensed from the popular Puzzle Baron websites.

bluejetty:00087303:ios.description:
The app your home screen has been waiting for. Radiance is a wallpaper app made with real artists, and it offers more ways than ever before to spice up your phone. Pick from a growing library of handmade wallpapers, find the perfect one in seconds, and set it in one press.

bluejetty:00156731:ios.description:
Heart feels off? Inconclusive ECG?
Get your ECGs read by certified experts within minutes, for peace of mind. 500,000+ ECGs read so far. Qaly is the leading ECG app for Apple Watch, Fitbit, Kardia, and other devices. 
On the Qaly app, get your ECGs reviewed by certified cardiographic technicians, trained to read ECGs for 30+ palpitations and abnormal heart rhythms like Afib, SVT, PVC, PAC, short or prolonged PR interval, short or long QT interval, WPW, and more. Track your heart rate variability (HRV) to monitor stress and recovery.
The Qaly app (formerly ReadMyECG) is built by Stanford cardiologists and engineers, including Dr. Marco Perez, a Stanford Associate Professor of Medicine and Stanford Cardiac Electrophysiologist.
Join 200K+ heart heroes signed-up with the Qaly app today, the only app where human experts analyze and interpret ECGs from your Apple Watch, Fitbit Watch, Withings Watch, KardiaMobile, WHOOP, Garmin or any other device within minutes, day or night.
----
Qaly members stay heart healthy:
“I would like to thank everyone reading the ECGs on Qaly. Because of Qaly, I went to my doctor and was diagnosed with SVT and was told it was probably never an anxiety disorder. I have lived 15 years of hell thinking I was having intermittent panic attacks and agoraphobia. Getting set up for an ablation. I will be forever grateful.”
— Marcie D. from Alabama
“Qaly was so helpful in quickly identifying signs of a potentially serious heart condition … Without Qaly, I would have blown off the ECG and maybe shown it to my primary care doctor at my next appointment a few months away.”
— Lori B. from Virginia
“My Apple Watch categorizes my arrhythmia as normal or inconclusive, which makes me question what I’m feeling. Without Qaly, it would’ve taken me another 6 months to a year to take this to a doctor. With Qaly I gained valuable information. Qaly is the key.”
— Jessi I. from Washington
-----
Qaly members get peace of mind:
• ECG analyzer for all watches and devices: Apple Watch ECG, Fitbit ECG, Kardia ECG, Wellue ECG, Withings ECG, WHOOP ECG, Garmin ECG, holter monitors, and more.
• Borderline ECG, Inconclusive Apple Watch ECG, Inconclusive Fitbit ECG, Unclassified KardiaMobile EKG, WHOOP ECG, Garmin ECG, and all other Inconclusive ECGs analyzed within minutes, for clarity.
• See irregular heartbeats like PAC and PVC on your ECG, analyzed by an expert ECG reader.
• See your PR Interval, QRS Interval, and QTc Interval on your ECG, also analyzed by an expert EKG reader.
• Get more from Qaly technician interpretations than your typical ECG analyzer app or HRV tracker: Qaly is the only ECG interpretation app where human experts provide professional analysis of your heart readings within minutes.
• Share Qaly reports with your doctor, cardiologist, or electrophysiologist.
----
The Qaly app displays ECG data by integrating with the Health app. This is not available on the iPad.
Disclaimer: Qaly does not practice medicine or provide medical services. The Qaly application and service is only for general informational and educational purposes and is in no way intended to, or be relied upon to replace or constitute professional medical care or attention by a qualified healthcare provider. The information about health provided by the Qaly application and service is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease. IF YOU THINK YOU HAVE A MEDICAL EMERGENCY, CALL YOUR DOCTOR OR 911 IMMEDIATELY. DO NOT RELY ON ELECTRONIC COMMUNICATIONS OR COMMUNICATION THROUGH THE QALY APPLICATION FOR IMMEDIATE, URGENT MEDICAL NEEDS. THE COMPANY SERVICE IS NOT DESIGNED OR INTENDED TO FACILITATE MEDICAL EMERGENCIES.
----
The electrocardiogram (ECG/EKG) functionality utilized by this app, available through Apple Watch and Withings devices, is accessible in regions where relevant regulatory clearances—such as FDA clearance, CE marking, UKCA marking, TGA approval, and Health Canada approval—are recognized and in effect.

SEE Y
bluejetty:00028871:ios.description:
See your progress. Find your rhythm. Reach your goal.
Meet Weight Loss Tracking Buddy (WLTB), your personal companion for losing, gaining or maintaining weight. Set meaningful goals, log food in seconds and understand your progress.
SEE YOUR FINISH LINE
Choose a goal weight and a weekly pace or target date. Follow your progress, celebrate milestones and switch to maintenance when you reach your goal.
TRENDS, NOT WOBBLES
Explore interactive weight charts, pinch to zoom, inspect weigh-ins and see your trend line. Pro adds longer history and detailed charts for calories, macros and body progress.
STOP GUESSING CALORIES (PRO)
Snap a meal for AI calorie and macro estimates, or scan a nutrition label without typing it in. Log meals, save your favourites and track protein, carbs, fats, sugar, fibre and salt.
KNOW WHAT'S LEFT TO EAT (PRO)
See your daily calorie budget and macro targets at a glance. Apple Health can factor activity into your daily budget.
YOUR WEIGHT, IN SYNC (PRO)
Sync weight and food with Apple Health, and bring in weigh-ins from compatible apps and scales.
MORE THAN A NUMBER (PRO)
Track fasts with Live Activities, Dynamic Island updates and reminders. Record body measurements and compare before-and-after progress photos.
MADE FOR YOUR DAY
Reorder your dashboard cards, use Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets and log weigh-ins with Apple Watch. Siri and Shortcuts make logging quicker. Prefer weight-only tracking? Switch calorie tracking off.

bluejetty:00046153:ios.description:
The Home National Bank app allows you to have your banking at your fingertips! 
The app will give you the ability to view account balances and history, download previous account statements and check images, transfer funds, pay bills, and make mobile deposits. The app will be kept up to date with all new features as they become available.
Why wait? Get started using our free app today by visiting www.homenatlbank.com to set up online banking. If you have already set up your online banking, just download the app and log.
Features:
Accounts
Check account balances, view account history, and obtain copies of past statements and check images. Up to 18 months of account history is available within the mobile app.
Bill Pay
Set up payees, schedule payments and make changes to previously set up payees. 
Mobile Deposit
Deposit your checks without coming to the bank. Use the mobile deposit feature to make deposits wherever you are. All you need to do it take a picture of your check using the mobile app and upload the image to the bank. 
Transfers
Make internal transfers between your accounts at Home National Bank, make external transfers from your account at Home National Bank to your account at another institution or send and request funds to/from friends and family. All of this can be done easily through our app. 
Contact Us
Use the location feature to find the Home National Bank ATM or branch closest to you or give us a call using the Call us feature.

過去の写真プリントもご注文いただけます。子どもが生まれた月・生まれる前からの写真もさかのぼってプリントすることができるので、ずっと残せる家族のアルバムができあがります。
④ アプリの通知で注文し忘れ防止
無料の注文時期を毎月アプリがお知らせするので、忘れずに続けることができます。注文はお気に入り写真を選ぶだけ。たった3分程度で簡単に注文完了するので無理なく使い続けられます。

・時間がなくて撮りためた家族の写真が整理できず、そのままになってしまっている

・印刷：銀塩光沢プリント
・寸法：8.9×8.9cmの正方形
・用紙：国内メーカー製高級印画紙
・その他：白フチのあり／なしをお選びいただけます
◆宝ものになる専用アルバム
・お気に入りが見つかる豊富なバリエーション
・写真をしまうだけでスッキリ整理
◆写真をきれいに印刷するには
できるだけ晴れた屋外や十分な光で撮影された明るい写真をご利用ください。
また 1辺が1,080px以上の大きな写真をお使いいただき、あまり拡大しないようにしていただくことをお勧めしております。
*別途、配送料がかかります
**2021年2月期_インターネットアンケートによるブランドイメージ調査 対象者：21歳以上既婚かつ20歳以下の子どもがいる女性(n=240) 日本マーケティングリサーチ機構調べ
***過去月分のご注文は、プリント料金と配送料がかかります

bluejetty:00068000:ios.description:
Funny Farm - LIVE PUZZLES for kids! Solve the puzzle of the animals and check what the farm animals can do! The game was developed by PSYCHOLOGISTS for children's improvement. Voiced in English.
The farm purposes are to develop for children the following cognitive functions:
- THINKING - explore possible actions with objects.
- IMAGINATION - imagine how the heroes will become alive.
- ATTENTION - place objects exactly.
- MORAL qualities - help children and animals and feed them.
REAL SOUNDS and BRIGHT GRAPHICS, lots of animations will make the game more colorful!
You will learn the following characters and MISSIONS:
1. Feed the horse and foal, collect flowers for the girl.
2. See if the scarecrow can kick the birds away.
3. How to get milk from a cow? Feed the kitten.
4. Plant and grow vegetables in the garden beds.
5. Guests are in the garden! Find out who can eat the crop!
6. Shear the lamb and collect the wool.
7. Why do pigs sit in the mud and what do they like to eat for lunch?
8. Harvest vegetables and fruits.
9. Fun life in a chicken coop!
10. How do we get honey? Watch funny bees.
Join the game with funny animals and pick live puzzles! 2 games are absolutely free!

bluejetty:00157806:ios.description:
The blood moon appeared and horror awakened from the abyss, turning the peaceful human world into the eternal underworld.
Ghost Nun, Strange Schoolgirl, Nine-Tailed Fox Demon, Slender Man, Evil Nurse, Skeleton King, Lich and Zombies...All the terrifying legends came to life. Countless evil spirits invaded, devouring people's hope and faith.
As one of the most powerful exorcists, you followed the guidance of the gods and formed an exorcist league with mysterious mages belonging to different faiths and sects to jointly fight against the greatest disaster ever faced by humankind.
Now, are you ready to head into the abyss of horror and fight for humanity?
[Power Up with Exquisite Gear]
Venture into the abyss armed with legendary weapons and sacred artifacts. Every piece of gear enhances your strength and shapes your destiny. Unleash your full potential and forge your path to victory.

Challenge the terrifying bosses, uncover their dark secrets, and claim insane rewards. Master unique combat mechanics, claim your victory, and prove yourself as the ultimate exorcist.
[Equip Your Arsenal with Demon-Slaying Gear]
Farm rare and powerful gear, upgrade your stats, and unlock legendary traits to dominate the battlefield. Arm yourself wisely—the fate of humanity depends on it.
[Collect and Control Nightmarish Creatures]
Not all dark forces are your enemies—some can be tamed and turned into powerful allies. Harness dark powers, command legendary demons, and use their abilities to crush your enemies and conquer the abyss.
[Customize Your Exorcist Class to Perfection]
Your faith defines your power. Choose from a variety of mystical sects, unlock devastating abilities, and shape a playstyle that aligns with your beliefs.

bluejetty:00161290:ios.description:
AI Skin Scanner – Your Comprehensive Skin Partner
AI Skin Scanner combines advanced AI-powered photo analysis with user-friendly features to help you monitor, understand, and care for your skin. From analyzing photos of skin issues like irregular spots or rashes to evaluating skincare ingredients and providing AI-driven advice, this app offers a comprehensive approach to skin care.
Key Features:
- Mole Checker – Monitor moles over time with AI-powered photo analysis.
- Rash Identifier – Understand potential causes and get insights on managing skin rashes.
- Cosmetic Ingredient Checker – Evaluate skincare product ingredients for suitability with your skin.
- AI Chat – Get instant, personalized advice on skin care and answers to your questions.
- Personalized Skin Care Tips – Receive tailored recommendations to enhance your skincare routine.
- Skin Monitoring Tools – Track skin changes over time with photo-based monitoring and reminders.
How It Works:
1. Capture: Take photos of moles, rashes, or other skin concerns using your device's camera.
2. Analyze: Instantly receive AI-powered insights through advanced photo analysis, supported by scientific research and expert-reviewed data. 
3. Chat: Consult the AI for friendly, easy-to-understand skin care advice. 
4. Check: Use the cosmetic ingredient checker to ensure your skincare products align with your skin's needs. 
5. Track: Monitor changes in your skin with regular photo updates and reminders. 
This app employs AI-powered photo analysis to provide skin insights and recommendations. For additional information on the accuracy of our algorithm, refer to this reputable medical resource: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36386072/
Disclaimer: 
This app is designed for general skin care assistance only and does not replace professional medical advice. For health-related concerns, please consult a qualified healthcare provider.

bluejetty:00131546:ios.description:
Access your calendar anywhere you are. We provide a seamless experience between your mobile phone, tablet, and computer.
***
What makes Artful Agenda special?
- View all of your calendars in one place! Syncs with major online calendar platforms, including Google, Apple and Outlook
- Personalize your pages with artfully curated cover designs and stickers
- Customize event colors, and choose your handwriting font
- Meal plan (daily and weekly), and track your water intake
- Check off/cross off monthly, weekly, and daily goals/tasks
- Create custom daily task, note and journaling categories
- Increase productivity with repeat, rollover, and “snooze” task functions plus the ability to assign tasks to certain days
- Keep track of important information with stylish, customizable lists and notes.
- Stay inspired with daily, weekly and monthly quotes (tablet and computer versions)
- Compatible with Apple Pencil and tablet styluses!
***
Artful Agenda also offers these important calendar features:
- Monthly, weekly, and daily calendar views that are easy to navigate and beautiful to look at
- Repeat scheduling for events
- Push notifications for event reminders
- Shareable calendars
***
Artful Agenda is not just an app on your smart device… It’s a companion to our amazing computer version, accessible via any web browser!
***
If you have any problems, please go to “tech support” in the top right menu of the app before writing a review. Our goal is to fix any issues in a timely manner to make the Artful experience great for everyone! You can also email us at hello@artfulagenda.com.
***
Artful Agenda Subscriptions:
Artful Agenda is a subscription based service, and we offer a two week free trial for new users because we know you’ll love us. Start planning your life in style for less than the cost of many popular paper planners!
Payment is charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at the end of your free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renewal in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase, or cancel your subscription at least 24 hours prior to the end of the trial or subscription period.
View our Terms of Service: https://www.artfulagenda.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00021467:ios.name: Lalabe: Kids Interactive Story
bluejetty:00021467:ios.summary:
Discover "Lalabe," a delightful interactive story perfect for kids and early readers! This enchanting anime-style story app provides valuable lessons about true friendship, making it ideal for bedtime and any time.
— KEY FEATURES FOR YOUN
bluejetty:00021467:ios.description:
Discover "Lalabe," a delightful interactive story perfect for kids and early readers! This enchanting anime-style story app provides valuable lessons about true friendship, making it ideal for bedtime and any time.
— KEY FEATURES FOR YOUNG READERS
* Interactive Storytelling: This picture book lets kids engage directly with the stories. They can tap, pull, pop, and drag objects, making storytime an interactive and hands-on activity. These interactivities turn each page into an engaging learning experience.
* Read-Aloud & Read-Along: With professional narration, children can listen as the audio tells the tale, use Read to Me to follow along, or learn to read along independently. The entire book features clear English voice narration and text.
* Offline Fun & Learning: Enjoy this storybook with no Wi-Fi needed! All activities, interactivities, and audio work completely offline, providing fun opportunities for engaging learning.
* Designed for Young Ages: Perfect for nursery, preschool, and kindergarten children, including early readers who are beginning to develop their reading skills.
* Kid-Safe Environment: "Lalabe" is 100% kid-safe, with no ads or in-app purchases, ensuring a secure and focused learning time for young children.
* Lessons of Love: Follow Lalabe the giraffe and her friend Perry as they learn about overcoming loneliness and making new friends through lessons inspired by Bible stories. The Christian Bible verse from John 4:13-14 teaches about the living water Jesus Christ offers, bringing eternal life.
* Bible Verse: Jesus said to her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will be thirsty again, but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never be thirsty again. The water that I will give him will become in him a spring of water welling up to eternal life.” (John 4:13-14, ESV)
* Perfect for Bedtime: Great for 5-minute bedtime stories or any moment when you want to enjoy engaging books together. You can even play it to help your little ones relax and sleep.
* Have fun and enjoy the game-like interactive experience!
— EDUCATIONAL BENEFITS
This app offers engaging activities and lessons that help young kids learn about friendship, overcoming sadness, and the power of love found in the Holy Bible. It's a wonderful book for learning English and fostering a deeper understanding of Christian teachings.
The combination of interactive stories, engaging books, and read-along features encourages children to participate rather than simply watch or listen. Young readers can enjoy the story at their own pace while developing early reading skills.
— AVAILABILITY
This delightful interactive storybook app is available on iPad, iPhone, and Mac, making it easy to enjoy these heartwarming tales of love and friendship with your child.
— WALA BEAR INC.
* https://www.walabear.com
* Please visit our site for more information.

bluejetty:00169783:ios.summary:

In a futuristic "light cyberpunk" world where animals have replaced humans, p
bluejetty:00169783:ios.description:
BROK is an innovative adventure mixed with beat 'em up and RPG elements. In a grim world where animals have replaced mankind, what kind of detective will you be?
In a futuristic "light cyberpunk" world where animals have replaced humans, privileged citizens live under a protective dome from the ambient air pollution while others struggle to make a living on the outside.
Brok, a private detective and former boxer, lives with Graff, the son of his deceased wife. Although he could never elucidate her accident, recent events may shed some light on an even more tragic outcome... one that may be linked to their own existence. Will they be able to withstand the threats of this corrupted world and face their own destiny?
--------------------
FEATURES
--------------------
- Solve puzzles with your wits... or muscles!
- Make choices impacting gameplay and/or story
- Relaxed mode for pure "Point & Click" gameplay (fights can be skipped)
- Level up to beat enemies and bosses
- Combine clues to uncover the truth!
- In-game hints
- Two playable characters, switch at any time
- 15 to 20 hours long on first playthrough 
- Multiple distinct endings to unlock 
- Fully voice acted (23,000 lines)
- Optimized for touch screens (fight using touch swipes or virtual buttons)
- Compatible with most Bluetooth controllers
- Play the adventure with friends in local co-op (up to 4 players)
- Text fully translated into 10 languages
---------------------------------
ACCESSIBILITY
---------------------------------
BROK is the first full-fledged adventure game to be fully playable by blind or visually impaired players!
- Fully narrated via quality text-to-speech and audiodescriptions (characters, locations and scenes.)
- Puzzles adapted for blindness.
- All puzzles and fights can be skipped.
- Adapted tutorials.
- Ability to repeat the last voice speech and instructions.
- Positional audio for fights.
- No online connectivity required (after the download).
- No specific device required

listings.description:
BROK is an innovative adventure mixed with beat 'em up and RPG elements. In a grim world where animals have replaced mankind, what kind of detective will you be?

In a futuristic "light cyberpunk" world where animals have replaced humans, privileged citizens live under a protective dome from the ambient air pollution while others struggle to make a living on the outside.

Brok, a private detective and former boxer, lives with Graff, the son of his deceased wife. Although he could never elucidate her accident, recent events may shed some light on an even more tragic outcome... one that may be linked to their own existence. Will they be able to withstand the threats of this corrupted world and face their own destiny?

--------------------
FEATURES
--------------------
- Solve puzzles with your wits... or muscles!
- Make choices impacting gameplay and/or story
- Relaxed mode for pure "Point & Click" gameplay (fights can be skipped)
- Level up to beat enemies and bosses
- Combine clues to uncover the truth!
- In-game hints
- Two playable characters, switch at any time

bluejetty:00138972:ios.name: Toad Sports: Prop Pick Finder
bluejetty:00138972:ios.summary: Toad Sports puts the numbers behind every player prop in one place, so you can stop guessing at what you are actually betting on. Pick any player. In about thirty seconds you can see a projected number for their line, how often they have go
bluejetty:00138972:ios.description:
Toad Sports puts the numbers behind every player prop in one place, so you can stop guessing at what you are actually betting on. Pick any player. In about thirty seconds you can see a projected number for their line, how often they have gone over/under, how they do against tonight's opponent, and which sportsbook has the best price on it. No paying someone else for their picks. No jumping between five tabs. You do the research, you make the call.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
- See a projected number for props across the full board
- Compare the same line across major sportsbooks in one tap
- Check how often a player has gone over or under, across recent games, the full season, or against this opponent
- Filter for the situations that actually matter, like home or away, rested or on a back to back, with or without a teammate in the lineup
- Work through a parlay one leg at a time with the same information behind every leg
PROJECTIONS
Every prop gets a projected number and a clear read on how that number lines up with the sportsbook price. You can see at a glance where the two disagree, then decide for yourself whether it is worth a bet.
THE MATCHUP MATRIX
A player's numbers change depending on who he is lined up against, and season averages hide that. The matchup matrix shows you how a player has actually performed against the specific opponent in front of him, so you are looking at tonight's matchup instead of an average built from forty other games. Season stats tell you who a player is - this tells you what the next matchup looks like. Containing advanced stats you won't find anywhere else, this is the heavy duty tool for serious research.
ODDS COMPARISON
Every book prices props differently, and most prices aren't worth taking. The app lines them up side by side and marks the ones that are, so you can see which book has odds worth your money and avoid the rest.
PLAYER RESEARCH LAB
Want to know how a player does when the starting player is injured? Or at home on three days of rest? Set the filters and you have the answer in seconds. This is the kind of thing that moves a line, and it usually takes forever to dig up by hand.
INSIGHTS
Everything you need to size up a prop in one view. Home and away splits, recent form, matchup history, and how the player performs with and without certain teammates. No piecing it together across five sites.
TRENDS AND HIT RATES
See which players have been hitting their lines and which runs are built on thin ground. Clear markers for recent games, the full season, and head to head history.
LEAGUE COVERAGE
NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, NCAA Football/Basketball. Something is always in season.
WHY I BUILT IT
Every feature in here exists because a user asked for it. When people said they felt buried in data, I made the important stats easier to analyze. When they said they were bouncing between five sites, I brought all the features into one app. The goal has never been to tell you what to bet, but to hand you the information and let you decide while making the research process easier. 
SUBSCRIPTION
Toad Sports is a monthly subscription app. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.
DISCLOSURE
All content in this app is for informational and entertainment purposes only. It is not gambling advice or financial advice, and nothing here is a prediction of an outcome or a guarantee of any result. Toad Sports is not a sportsbook. It does not accept wagers or real money deposits. You must be of legal age to bet in your area. If gambling is causing a problem for you, call 1-800-GAMBLER.
TERMS AND PRIVACY POLICY
Terms of Service: https://toadsports.net/termsofuse
Privacy Policy: https://toadsports.net/privacypolicy

PERIOD TRACKER

OVULATION PREDICTIONS
Viewing your ovulation predictions is fast and easy with our calculator. Gone are the days of information clutter.
IRREGULAR CYCLE SUPPORT
By default, the app defines cycles as irregular if the cycle has a length of less than 21 days or over 36 days but these values are easily personalized to fit your needs within Settings. 
MENSTRUAL HISTORY
The menstrual history was visually optimized to include thoughtful choices with an easy-to-read vertical orientation. 
CYCLE HISTORY 
The days of difficult-to-create reminders are over. Our cycle reminders are easy to create, modify, and set.
SYMPTOM TRACKER

bluejetty:00060822:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00060822:ios.description:
Discover a Smarter, Simpler Banking Experience.
The new ABK Mobile Banking App is designed to put you at the center of your banking journey. With a fresh look, enhanced features, and advanced security, it’s built to make your experience faster, easier, and more personalized than ever before.
What’s New?
• Personalized Themes: A unique design tailored to your banking needs and preferences.
• Enhanced Self-Service functionalities for enhanced convenience.
• A faster and more flexible banking experience.
• Redesigned, user-friendly interfaces.
In addition to the various features including:
• Log in to the app instantly with Touch or Face ID.
• Ability to share iBAN.
• Between Accounts, ABK to ABK, Local, and international transfers.
• WAMD for Simple, Fast, and reliable Payments. (Send & Receive).
• Bill Splitting & Receive Payments through ABKPay and ABK Split
• Onboard with Ease: Open an account as a new ABK customer in minutes.
• Open deposits.
• View Your deposit projections.
• Open AlFouz, Savings, Daily Investment Account.
• Calculate your AlFouz chances of winning.
• Ability to update your Phone Number and Email Address.
• Ability to Change your Login Password and Security Questions.
• Access Anytime: Locate branches, ATMs, and CDMs with just a tap.
• Ability to Manage your Devices, and Unlinking them.
• Ability to provide Feedback & Suggestions based on Branch visits, Facilities, Services, Appreciation, or Negative Responses.
• Ability to Submit an Official Complaint through the app.
• Ability to view Inbox, Sent Items and create a new message within Message Center.
• View history of transactions made on your accounts and cards.
• Download eStatements .
• Make Cardless withdrawals at ABK ATMs.
• Redeem your Credit Card Rewards (ABK Loyalty).
• Redeem your Cashback .
• Kuwait Clearing Company Registration to receive dividends from KCC.
• Credit Card Payments.
• Ability to Update your eKYC (Know-Your-Customer) details in the app, without the need to visit a branch, integrated with PACI.
• Ability to modify transfer limits.
• Cash Advance allows eligible ABK Credit Cardholders to transfer a specified amount of money from their Credit Card to their ABK bank account.
• Request Hub gives you the ability to manage and track all your banking requests in one place.
• Pause Card (temporary stop card) and have the ability to resume.
• Ability to Add a new beneficiary quicker using Call Me.
• Hide Bank Details: You now have the option to mask your account details such as your balance.
• Pay your telecom bills (Postpaid, and Prepaid).
• Release Hold requests.
• Notification Management .
• Go Ticketless by paying for your parked car through Mawqif and Pass, or get Gas, Digital Games, iTunes, and Shopping Cards directly from the app
• Light and Dark Mode is now available.
• Make your app even more personal by adding your own profile photo.
And much more!
The new ABK Mobile App is here to deliver smarter, simpler banking—tailored just for you, it is available in both languages English and Arabic.
Update now and start enjoying a banking experience that revolves around you.
For further assistance, please contact Ahlan Ahli at 1899899 , international +965 22907222 or chat with us through ABK WhatsApp 1899899—we’re here to help 24/7!

Let’s connect the stars together! 
Meet the charming Sorcerers in the mesmerizing place of Arcana Twilight!

bluejetty:00174569:ios.description:
Looking for a relaxing game? Dive into Tranquility: Unwind and Ascend with Zen Koi Classic (Free-to-Play)
Embark on a captivating journey of transformation and serenity in Zen Koi Classic, the enchanting mobile game where you experience the vibrancy and breathtaking beauty of the graceful Koi.
Immerse yourself in a calming atmosphere filled with soothing music and mesmerizing visuals as you nurture these magnificent fish, witnessing their growth and culminating metamorphosis into majestic dragons.
Unwind and Ascend: A Timeless Tale
Zen Koi Classic offers a unique experience that blends relaxation with strategic collection. Breed, collect and discover beautiful Koi: witness the captivating journey of your Koi as they evolve from tiny hatchlings into breathtaking creatures, each boasting unique colors and intricate patterns. Guide them through their life cycle, culminating in a stunning transformation that embodies the legend of the Koi's ascension into a dragon.
Features:
Free-to-Play: Enjoy the core gameplay experience without any purchase required.
Soothing and Intuitive Gameplay: Immerse yourself in a world of tranquility with simple controls and a serene environment.
Unique Flowing Action: Guide your Koi with a single touch, mimicking their graceful movements through the water.
A Calming Oasis: Find peace in the beautiful aquatic environment, enhanced by soothing music and sound effects.
Unveiling a Spectrum of Koi: Discover and collect hundreds of stunning Koi varieties, each boasting unique color combinations and patterns. Some rare specimens await the most dedicated collectors!
Share Your Passion: Share and gift magnificent Koi you have bred and collected with friends and fellow players.
Limited Edition Reward: Collect and complete all Koi and Dragon collections in Zen Koi Classic and claim unique decorations for your personal pond and aquarium in Zen Koi 2 as a special bonus!
Unveiling the Depths of Zen Koi Classic:
A Visual Symphony: Immerse yourself in an underwater world teeming with vibrant life with plenty of prey to catch.
The Calming Symphony: Escape the daily grind with a serene soundtrack by Kiat from System Sovereign featuring gentle melodies and calming ambient sounds. Soundscapes are designed by IMBA to further enhance the sense of tranquility.
The Emotional Connection: Witness the heartwarming growth and transformation of your Koi. Observe their vibrant colors and discover a progression of beautiful patterns, building a special bond with your pond companions. As they evolve into majestic dragons, experience a sense of accomplishment for nurturing them throughout their journey.
Download Zen Koi Classic today and embark on a captivating odyssey of transformation and tranquility!
Note:
Zen Koi is free to download and play. However, optional items are available via In-App Purchase within the game to expand upon your gameplay experience.
By downloading this game, you agree to our Terms of Service & Privacy Policy:
http://www.landsharkgames.com/terms-of-service/
http://www.landsharkgames.com/privacy-policy/
Rated 3+ by the Indonesia Game Rating System (IGRS).

bluejetty:00068977:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00068977:ios.description:
Totally FREE!
No ads or pop-ups!
How this App Works:
This app has 17 different electrical problems that are randomly selected to provide a fun and challenging learning experience. It is certain to help you become more proficient in troubleshooting with a voltmeter. The motor starter is animated so that you can SEE the different contact configurations between forward and reverse. Another unique feature of this app is the ability to instantly switch back and forth between the control schematic and the real time PLC logic. There is also a "Troubleshooting Assistant" to help test the control circuit and find the problems.
The app is initially in normal mode. This allows you to experience:
- How a reversing starter works.
- How to use the virtual voltmeter probes to measure voltages at various test points (small black squares, which turn red when the voltmeter makes contact with them) in the control circuit.
- Analyze the PLC logic, when the starter is in various control modes Run (FWD & Rev), Off and Auto (FWD & REV).
The HMI only has control in Auto. The selector switches work as indicated by control circuit.
After the you understand how the motor starter works in the various control modes, you can check your troubleshooting skills by going to "Settings" (touch the 'More' button (at the top of the app) and then the gear icon) and selecting troubleshooting mode. Touch the "Arrow Back" icon to return to the control schematic. You will notice that the screen background has turned a light green, indicating that it is in troubleshooting mode and has a problem that needs to be found. Use the "Troubleshooting assistant" at the top, right side of the control schematic to help set the operator switches for testing. Use the voltmeter probes and PLC logic screen to identify the problem. Once you believe that you have identified the problem, touch "Problem Identified" button at the top of the app. A list of possible problems will appear. If you cannot determine the problem, at the bottom of the list, there is an item to provide the answer. If you desire to put the control system back in to normal (Non Troubleshooting Mode - No electrical problems) to learn more about how it is suppose to work, go to the settings section and unselect "Troubleshooting Mode". 
It is truly a great learning tool for anybody that wants to be able to fully utilize a voltmeter to troubleshoot a control circuit.

bluejetty:00032548:ios.description:
Are you ready to challenge your mind and sharpen your vocabulary?
Look no further than our new word puzzle – Words Sort!
Associated Word Sort is a word puzzle that challenges you to categorize words and merge them together into one. You must carefully think about the categories and the connections in order to complete each level.
Gameplay:
1.Word classification: The words with the same category will be eliminated after being merged; you need to eliminate all words to complete the level.
2.Connecting lines: Connect the words of the same category by drawing lines with your finger.
3.Level-based gameplay: Each level contains multiple categories of words, and the difficulty increases as you progress.
Features:
-Exercise and train your brain while increasing your vocabulary.
-Massive number of levels, increasing in difficulty, with a certain level of challenge to clear.
-Strategy game – connecting the wrong lines may trigger a game over, making the gameplay more challenging.
-Rich variety of word categories, from simple names to complex insect species, covering a wide range of topics.
-Take your time and go at your own pace – there are no time limits.
So if you’re up for the challenge, download Words Sort now and test your skills and strategy!
