Command squadrons of more than 230 types of aircraft, from iconic warbirds like the A6M2 Zero and P-38 Lightning to less well-known types like the CAC Boomerang and Vickers Wellington. Control the seas with more than 280 types of warships including submarines, battleships and aircraft carriers.
Pacific Fire is powered by a detailed and realistic simulation of WW2 air, naval, and ground combat. Fight against an intelligent AI which constantly adapts its strategy to ensure every game is challenging and unique. Challenge a friend in hotseat multiplayer (pass-and-play).
Pacific Fire contains no in-app purchases or ads of any kind, and an internet connection is not required to play. Buy the game once and get access to all current and future content. 
The game features 18 campaigns, including:
- Pacific Fire: Fight the whole of WW2 month-by-month on a map spanning from India to the west coast of the US.
- Centrifugal Offensive: Command Imperial Japanese forces invading the Philippines, Singapore, and the Dutch East Indies at the beginning of WW2.
- Coral Sea: Fight the first battle between aircraft carriers in history, and experience the battles for Guadalcanal and the Kokoda Track.
- Yamamoto's Gambit: Devise a strategy to lure the US Pacific Fleet into a decisive battle with the Kido Butai, and change history at the Battle of Midway.
- Central Pacific: Lead the US Pacific Fleet and US Marine Corps seize strategic islands and liberate the Philippines in 1943 - 1944.
- Operation Downfall: Command a massive Allied invasion of the Japanese Home Islands in this alternate history campaign.

bluejetty:00140207:ios.description:
Antique Identifier - AI Expert
Transform your phone into a professional antique appraiser! Whether you're treasure hunting at estate sales, exploring flea markets, or discovering family heirlooms in the attic, Antique Identifier instantly reveals the hidden stories and values behind your vintage finds.
► Why Antique Identifier?
Our advanced AI technology, powered by cutting-edge machine learning, identifies antiques, collectibles, and vintage items with remarkable accuracy. From Victorian jewelry and Art Deco furniture to vintage cameras, rare coins, porcelain dolls, and retro toys - simply snap a photo and unlock a world of historical insights.
► Key Features:
- Instant AI Identification: Identify any antique in seconds! Our smart recognition engine analyzes your photos to reveal item names, origins, time periods, and historical significance. Perfect for antique dealers, collectors, and curious minds.
- Real Market Valuations: Get accurate price estimates powered by live market data. Compare your treasures with thousands of similar items online, see current market trends, and discover what collectors are paying today.
- Build Your Digital Collection: Organize identified antiques into custom collections. Track your finds, document provenance, and maintain a beautiful digital catalog of your treasures. Perfect for insurance documentation or sharing with fellow collectors.
- Snap History & Discovery Log: Never lose track of your antique hunting journey. Every identification is saved, creating your personal museum of discoveries.
- Educational Resources: Access curated articles about antique styles, periods, and collecting tips. Become an expert with our growing knowledge base.
► Perfect For:
- Antique collectors and dealers
- Estate sale enthusiasts
- Vintage shop owners
- History buffs and museum lovers
- Anyone inheriting family treasures
- Flea market and garage sale hunters
► Use Cases:
Identify that mysterious vase at a yard sale, appraise grandma's vintage jewelry, authenticate collectible stamps, value retro furniture finds, or simply satisfy your curiosity about historical objects around you.
Premium Features: Unlock unlimited identifications, advanced AI insights, priority chatbot access, and exclusive collecting guides. Start with free daily identifications, then upgrade to become a true antique expert!
► Start Your Antique Journey Today!
Download now and join thousands of collectors uncovering history, one treasure at a time. Your pocket antique expert is ready to reveal the fascinating stories behind every vintage find.
We would be excited to receive your suggestions for future features of the app or database additions or any feedback you may have!
Please email us at bkmobile.software@gmail.com

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/kien-hoang-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00146984:ios.description:
The official guide to Los Angeles, the Discover L.A. app gives urban exploration a whole new meaning. Sleekly designed and packed with contextually crafted content based on time, weather and location, you’ll want to come back daily in search of what to do next in the City of Angels. · Top daily events throughout Los Angeles
· Find the perfect meal based on weather, time and distance leveraging Discover L.A.'s own custom intelligence algorithm
· Wonderful activity guides for things to DO in L.A. -- discover awesome museums, parks, shops, and hidden gems
· Go On Location: find places throughout Los Angeles featured in film and television
· Locate places to STAY in neighborhoods based on your personal interests
· Go Metro with easily accessible public transportation directions
· Like a place? Tap the heart icon to save places to your Discover L.A. Passport
· Traveler Tools provide a weekly L.A. weather report, currency exchange calculator, and helpful visitor links
· Need Wi-Fi? Find available Hotspots across the entire city

bluejetty:00120288:ios.summary:

Bibi.Pet are cute, friend
bluejetty:00120288:ios.description:
Are you ready to discover the magic world of Bibi.Pet?
The funny little animals that live there have particular shapes and speak their own special language: the Bibi’s language, which only children can understand.
Bibi.Pet are cute, friendly and scatterbrained, and can’t wait to play with all the family!
You can learn and have fun with them with colors, shapes, puzzles and logic games.
In this episode the Bibi.Pet are taken up with running a restaurant. You can help our friends to cook the dishes, mix the ingredients like a real chef, put the plates scattered around the kitchen in order and taste the restaurant’s specialties.
Will the little piggy manage to bake all the cakes? Or will the donkey manage to wash the dishes without breaking any? And what’s that crazy cat doing jumping on the tables? Your help is desperately needed in this magic restaurant. Come and play with us!
Features:
- Associate colors
- Learn shapes
- Use logic
- Complete puzzles
- Educational games for children over 2 years of age
- Lots of different games for learning while having fun
--- DESIGNED FOR LITTLE ONES --- 
- Absolutely no adverts 
- Designed to entertain children aged from 2 to 6, from little to big!
- Games with SIMPLE rules for children to play alone or with their parents. 
- Perfect for children at play school. 
- A host of entertaining sounds and interactive animation. 
- No need for reading skills, perfect also for pre-school or nursery children. 
- Characters created for boys and girls. 
--- SHAPES AND COLORS ---
Our shape and color puzzles are made for infants and toddlers. Children from 0-3 years can start to learn and perceive colors and basic geometric shapes, interacting simply and intuitively.
--- ASSOCIATIONS AND LOGIC ---
Logical associations and puzzles are one of the best ways for small boys and girls to learn while having fun. Our association games enable kids to start identifying differences and group elements by shape, colors and type of object.
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
--- Bibi.Pet Who are we? --- 
We produce games for our children, and it is our passion. We produce tailor-made games, without invasive advertising by third parties. 
Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 
We create a variety of games based on: colours and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all! 
Our thanks to all the families who show their trust in Bibi.Pet!

Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 

We create a variety of games based on: colours and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all!

bluejetty:00040495:ios.description:
We’re two sides of the same coin. Why? You seem to be passionate about numismatics too! PriceCam will help you keep track of your collection and become a coin expert.
Have you always dreamed about an app that would organize your coins for you? Or maybe you want to take up a new non-trivial hobby? Well, meet PriceCam—your guide into the fun world of numismatics!
What is PriceCam?
Value Identifier
This app works like magic: take two snaps of the obverse and reverse sides of the coin, and boom—our smart AI will find you a match in mere seconds!
Coin Guide
Learn everything about your coins: their size, composition, weight, year of minting, country of origin, designer, and even fun facts from their history! The app will also tell you the current reference price of each coin to help you understand its value. Who knows, maybe you’re sitting on a fortune?
Coin Collection
Keep your coins well-organized; add newly identified pieces to your collection to keep track of them at all times. You can create multiple collections to sort your coins in whatever order you like.
Why PriceCam?
PriceCam has the right tools to make any numismatist happy. It offers:
● Fast and accurate coin recognition
● Extensive information about coins from all over the globe
● Possibility to keep record of added coins
● Tracker of the overall number of coins in your collection
● Up-to-date reference prices
● Ability to create multiple collections of coins
● Interesting facts about coins
● Easy-to-use interface
So, what are you waiting for? Discover a new hobby or dive deeper into the world of numismatics to become a coin expert. PriceCam will be at your side on this exciting journey!
A subscription is needed to use all the app’s features.
All personal data is protected in accordance with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
https://www.mindfusion.app/tos
https://www.mindfusion.app/privacy

bluejetty:00168550:ios.description:
Travelling is now even simpler with the new Trenitalia App!
Buying tickets, season tickets and carnets, tracking your train's status, and checking timetables and offers are now faster and more intuitive than ever with the new Trenitalia app.

• Search for trains and routes by entering specific addresses in all Italian cities: from where you are to where you want to go, in a single step and with geolocation you can instantly find trains departing from the nearest station.
• Choose your preferred payment method: Credit Card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Satispay, Amazon Pay, bank transfer, CartaFRECCIA/X-GO points, Bonuses, or Gift Cards, or register your payment method or PayPal account for one-click checkout!
• Need to anticipate or delay your journey? Discover the new feature that allows you to change your ticket time (±2 hours) in an instant.
• Get precise, real-time updates and news about your train.
• If you're a Trenitalia for Business client, switch between your personal and corporate profiles with a single tap, managing every journey quickly and seamlessly.
Enjoy your journey with the new app!

+ Walk your Pokipet

+ Give your Pokipet water
+ Pet your Pokipet
+ Put your Pokipet to sleep at night
+ Give your Pokipet toys
+ Customise your Pokipet
+ As your pet grows older, it will slowly learn to stand, walk, run, and also play!

+ Dogs
+ Puppies
+ Kittens
+ Earn coins for completing various tasks

+ Free to play

+ Talk with your friends with the in-game chat. 
+ Decorate your cat
+ Feed your cat
+ Poke your cat
+ Give your cat exercise
+ Unique mini games

+ Great for couples, play with your boyfriend or girlfriend.
+ Great for groups of friends, play with your best friend, group of friends, or all your school friends. 
+ Great for families, invite your parents, brothers, and sisters and play together. Perfect for kids, teenagers, parents, and grandparents. 
+ Great for solo too, don't want to share your cat or dog? You can also play on your own
+ Make every day an adventure with your cat
+ Free to play cat game

+ Two-player game

bluejetty:00061104:ios.description:
Eleman.net iş ilanları ile iş ara & iş bul! Eleman ilanlarına başvur, yeni bir iş senin olsun! Şimdi iş başvurusu yap, kariyer hedefine ulaş, 24 saatte işin olsun. İş ilanı ver hemen eleman bul.
İş Arıyorum veya Eleman Arıyorum diyorsanız Eleman.net'i hemen indirin!
İş ilanları uygulamanız eleman.net sizin için burada! 
Eleman.net İş İlanlarıyla Hemen İşin Olsun
Türkiye'nin iş ilanları platformu Eleman.net ile iş bulmak artık çok kolay. Eleman.net'te sana uygun iş fırsatlarını incele, hemen başvur, 24 saatte işin olsun, kariyer hedefine ulaş.
Binlerce Güncel İş İlanı Seni Bekliyor
Eleman.net uygulamasında mühendis, tekniker, teknisyen, güvenlik görevlisi, üretim elemanı, satış temsilcisi, ön muhasebe elemanı, kaynakçı, tornacı, aşçı, garson, şoför, kasiyer, depo elemanı ve temizlik görevlisi gibi birçok meslek için güncel iş ilanlarını bulabilirsin.
Firmalarla Mesajlaş
Firmalarla anlık mesaj sistemi üzerinden mesajlaşabilirsiniz. Başvuru yaptıktan sonra ilan sahibine anlık mesaj gönderebilir ve ilan sahibinden anlık mesaj alabilirsiniz.
Haritadan İş Ara
Harita üzerinden yakınınızdaki ilanları görün, hızlı başvuru yapın.
Yeni Bir İş, Yeni Bir Kariyer Fırsatı
İş ilanları arasında kolayca gez, pozisyon detaylarını öğren, başvurunu hemen yap. Özgeçmiş oluşturmadan da iş ilanlarına başvuru yapabilir, iş ilanı veren firmalarla hızlıca iletişime geçebilirsin.
Tüm Türkiye'den İş İlanlarına Kolayca Ulaş
İstanbul iş ilanları, Ankara iş ilanları, İzmir iş ilanları, Bursa iş ilanları, Antalya iş ilanları başta olmak üzere tüm şehirlerdeki iş ilanları tek tık uzağında.
Yapay Zeka ile Kariyerine Güç Kat
Eleman.net'in yapay zeka destekli özgeçmiş ve başvuru analiz sistemiyle başvurularını güçlendir, kariyer hedeflerine daha kolay ulaş.
Video Özgeçmişin Rahatlığını Yaşa
Video özgeçmiş oluşturarak firmaların seni daha iyi tanımasını sağla. 
Maaş Rehberi ile İş İlanları Arasında Doğru Tercih Yap
Eleman.net maaş rehberi ile hangi mesleğin ne kadar maaş aldığını öğrenerek kariyer planını yap.
Hesaplama Araçları ile İşini Kolaylaştır
Kıdem tazminatı, ihbar tazminatı, işsizlik maaşı, yıllık izin, gelir vergisi gibi hesaplamaları kolayca yap.
İşverenler İçin Personel İlanları
Eleman.net ile İş İlanı Ver, Aradığın Elemanı Bul
Eleman.net, mavi yaka ve ara kademe iş ilanları için en güvenilir ve hızlı çözümdür. Dakikalar içinde iş ilanı oluştur, adaylara ulaş, işe alım süreçlerini hızlandır, aradığın personeli bul.
Yapay Zeka Başvuru Değerlendirme Sistemi ile En Doğru Adayı Bul
Eleman.net'in yapay zeka destekli başvuru değerlendirme sistemi sayesinde iş ilanlarına gelen başvuruları daha hızlı ve daha etkili bir şekilde analiz edebilirsin. Başvuruları otomatik olarak değerlendiren sistem, pozisyona en uygun adayları sıralayarak işe alım süreçlerini büyük ölçüde kolaylaştırır ve zamandan tasarruf etmeni sağlar.
İşkur Onaylı İş İlanları Platformu
Türkiye İş Kurumu'nun 20.06.2023 tarih ve 606 sayılı izin belgesiyle faaliyet gösteren Eleman.net ile yasal ve güvenli şekilde iş ilanı yayınlayabilir, başvuruları kolayca yönetebilirsin.
Aday Takip ve Mülakat Sistemi ile İşini Kolaylaştır
Eleman.net'in gelişmiş Aday Takip Sistemi (ATS) ve Mülakat Takip Sistemi sayesinde iş ilanına gelen başvuruları kolayca değerlendirebilir, mülakat sürecini yönetebilir ve doğru adaya daha hızlı ulaşabilirsin.
İş İlanı Ver!
Dakikalar içinde işveren olarak iş ilanı verebilirsiniz. İş ilanı yayınlayarak işe alım yapabilir, iş başvurularını inceleyebilir, iş arayanları mülakata davet edebilirsiniz. İş ilanı ver, aradığın elemanı hemen bul.
İnsan Kaynakları Süreçlerinizde Yanınızdayız
Eleman.net iş ilanları uygulaması insan kaynakları süreçlerinizdeki personel alımı konusunda her zaman yanınızda. İş ilanı vermek, eleman bulmak hızlı ve kolay. Eleman arıyorum diyorsanız hemen iş ilanını yayınlayın.
İşkur Onaylı İş Bulma Sitesi
Türkiye İş Kurumu (İŞKUR) onaylı eleman.net ile iş ve eleman bulmak çok daha kolay ve hızlı.

bluejetty:00015814:ios.summary:
School types

- Customizable for any type of school
- From day care to high school to universities

- Music schools, sports schools, dance schools
- Can
bluejetty:00015814:ios.description:
School types
- Single teacher or multi-teacher
- Customizable for any type of school
- From day care to high school to universities
- From public schools to private schools & home schools
- Music schools, sports schools, dance schools
- Can also be used for summer camps, conferences
In-app messaging
- Supports text messages, photos and documents
- Teachers can message students and guardians
- Students and guardians can message teachers
- School teachers can message other teachers
- School admins can message teachers, students, guardians
Attendance
- Separate check-in & check-out
- Customize up to 5 attendance types for each
- Statistics per student and per class
- Create your own statistics periods
- Record student attendance by scanning student IDs with bluetooth scanner
- Take attendance with Apple Watch
Behavior
- Track points for up to 26 behavior items
- Customize behavior items per class
- Points range from -99 to +99 per behavior per day
- Statistics per student and per class
- Create your own statistics periods
Grading
- Track points & grades for up to 26 grading subjects
- Customize grading subjects per class
- Points per subject range from 0 to 999
- Define your own grading system
- Grades per subject & overall grades
- Statistics per student and per class
- Create your own statistics periods
Student reports
- Summary of student’s attendance, behavior & grading data
- Teacher’s notes per each daily recorded item
- Includes student notes, class notes
- History view shows all items in chronological order
- Statistics view shows all data in a graphical format
- View statistics by period, or data details by date
App communication
- Daily student-specific notes & photo
- Daily class-wide notes & photo
- Student reports condense all recorded data
- Complete history & full statistics
- Students & parents get a consolidated student report
- Private school-only student accounts (in lieu of email accounts)
Email communication
- Web-based email tool
- Customize message & include embedded images
- Include clickable links & file attachments
- Send emails to students, parents & teachers
- Email tool keeps track of bounced emails
- Both teacher & administrator can send emails
Notifications
- Students and parents can receive automatic notifications
- E.g. when student is marked as absent, parent receives text or email
- Three types of notifications: app, email, text
- Configure preferred notification method per student and per parent
- Customize notification message to be sent via email or text
Other features
- App works both online & offline (no internet)
- Automatic cloud backup when connected
- Real-time multi-device sync
- All data exportable as XLS or CSV

bluejetty:00162039:ios.summary: Hashtag Smart: AI Like Booster app utilizes AI(Artificial Intelligence) to find the trending hashtags for instagram, tiktok, youtube, X(twitter), linkedin, facebook, threads pinterest, and snapchat. Our app has many social media caption gen
bluejetty:00162039:ios.description:
Hashtag Smart: AI Like Booster app utilizes AI(Artificial Intelligence) to find the trending hashtags for instagram, tiktok, youtube, X(twitter), linkedin, facebook, threads pinterest, and snapchat. Our app has many social media caption generators. Firstly, we have auto writer as a main tool. You can use it as a caption generator for all social media platforms. The most popular ones are instagram caption generator, tweet generator, linkedin post generator, facebook post caption generator, instagram threads generator, youtube video description generator.
Our app also has AI social media assistant where you can use it as a social media seo tool. The most popular ones are instagram seo tool and tiktok seo tool. You can also use it as social media username generators. The most popular ones are instagram username generator, and tiktok username generator, and youtube username generator. It is a hashtag generator for expert ig, tiktok, and all other social media followers. Expert users need the best hashtags for likes and followers. Our app generates trending and viral hashtags with AI to increase likes and followers with trending hashtags!
Our app has 29+ fonts, 69k+ captions and 500 most used emojis. Fonts, captions, emojis are the organic tools users use to increase their likes and followers for instagram, tiktok, and all other social media. You can also use our AI assistant as social media bio generators. The most popular ones are instagram bio generator and youtube channel description generator. We have other free AI tools such as: emoji translator, emoji adder, creative idea generator. Hashtags ai can be used as a follower booster app.
Hashtags are the most important part of the social media platforms like Instagram and Tiktok in 2024. To be an expert on Instagram and Tiktok, you need to utilize trending and hot hashtags. It will boost your likes and followers on instagram, tiktok, youtube, X(twitter), linkedin, facebook, threads, pinterest, and snapchat. Hashtag Smart has advanced hashtag generator and quick hashtag generator. Advanced hashtag generator lets you choose multiple popular hashtags. Quick hashtag generator quickly generates the most related hashtags for your main hashtag. The most popular social media hashtag generators are instagram hashtag generator and tiktok hashtag generator.
Information about the auto-renewable Pro Subscription:
- To access pro features, you should have an active subscription. Subscription periods are 1 month, 6 months and 1 year. Subscription renews every month, 6 months or year respectively. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can cancel your subscription via this url: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
- Privacy Policy: https://thecreativemobile.com/privacypolicy
- Terms of Use: https://thecreativemobile.com/termsofservice

bluejetty:00005958:android.summary:
IMPORTANT NOTICE: ESET Parental Control will be discontinued on June 30, 2026.
As more parents rely on built-in parental controls, we’re focusing on delivering even more comprehensive security through our subscription plans.
Key dates to k
bluejetty:00005958:android.description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE: ESET Parental Control will be discontinued on June 30, 2026.
As more parents rely on built-in parental controls, we’re focusing on delivering even more comprehensive security through our subscription plans.
Key dates to keep in mind:
- End of Sales: June 30, 2025
New purchases of ESET Parental Control will no longer be possible.
- End of Life: June 30, 2026
The ESET Parental Control Android app and web portal will no longer be available for installation, activation, or use.
We know how hard it is to set boundaries for your kids on the internet. Our goal is to give you the confidence that they are protected while using smartphones and tablets.
1. Given the opportunity, most kids would be glued to their phones at every waking hour. With App Guard, you can set up the daily limit for gaming and limit playtime at night or during school hours. It automatically controls apps and games and allows kids to use only the age-appropriate ones.
2. When kids are online, they can come across web pages with fake news or violent or adult content. Web Guard ensures your kids’ internet safety by keeping them away from inappropriate pages.
3. If your child didn’t come from school yet and doesn’t pick up the phone, Child Locator locates your child’s phone’s current location. Additionally, Geofencing allows you to get the notification if your child enters or steps out of the default area on the map.
4. Do you worry about your child’s phone’s battery dying and not being able to contact them? Set up Battery Protector that will limit playing games if the battery level drops below the default level.
5. Does your child have a crucial task to finish, and you are afraid they will play on their phone instead? Use Instant Block for a temporary ban on games and entertainment. If your child has some free time, you can also temporarily suspend the time limit rule through Vacation Mode.
6. Are the rules too strict? Has a newly installed app been blocked? Children can ask for an exception, and parents can instantly approve or deny requests.
7. Do you want to change the rules settings? Sign in to my.eset.com on a PC or mobile phone and change them remotely. If you, as a parent, also use an android smartphone, install our app on your phone in parent mode, and you will receive instant notifications.

Developed by PAMP (‘Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux’), one of the world’s most renowned bullion brands.

bluejetty:00037807:ios.name: Samsung Smart TV remote myTifi
bluejetty:00037807:ios.summary:
Control your Samsung Smart TV with gestures from your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
Launch your favorite TV apps instantly with customizable remote buttons.
Use the touchpad and keyboard to control the TV's web browser.
myTifi uses the rev
bluejetty:00037807:ios.description:
Control your Samsung Smart TV with gestures from your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
Launch your favorite TV apps instantly with customizable remote buttons.
Use the touchpad and keyboard to control the TV's web browser.
myTifi uses the revolutionary Smart Control; one screen to control all basic functions of your TV:
• Swipe gestures to change the volume and channel.
• Configurable buttons with the network logo; just press a logo and your TV goes to the matching channel (e.g. 28) directly! This even works with digital media boxes via the IR extender on the F-Series and H-Series TV.
• Start TV apps on a Samsung H-Series (model year 2014) or later TV.
• Directly switch to a source (like HDMI-1) with customizable buttons (like "PlayStation")
• Tap with 2 fingers to mute.
• Macros; record a series of commands to easily replay them later. E.g. the volume 10 levels down during commercial breaks.
• Auto-Mute; on an incoming or accepted phone call, the Mute command is send to suppress the audio. When the call is finished it is send again to restore the audio.
• Auto-Zap; let myTifi cycle through your favourite channels, to search for an interesting broadcast or populate your EPG quickly.
• iCloud; share your settings between all your devices.
The tab 'Navigate' can launch the TV web browser directly. Control the cursor with your finger with the touchpad.
Send text to your TV with the iOS keyboard, e.g. a web address.
myTifi supports all Samsung Smart TVs from model year 2010 (C-Series) up to the latest 2026 models.
Try myTifi and you will be amazed. It's downloaded by over 9 million of users:
Geepee1952: "It just simply works. It finds the TV quickly every time and has been 100% reliable."
London Tony: "Easy and fast to set up. Channels sync perfectly between iPhone and iPad. Excellent developer support."
Dudeman0990: "Great app! Works much more quickly than factory remote and lets me use the keyboard on my smart tv so I dont have to scroll thru letters when navigating my tv. Thanks!"
NOTE
When you use an external set-top Box (STB) to watch television (such as Xfinity or Sky), you need to configure the function 'Universal Remote' in your TV Menu. The TV will then transmit the commands from myTifi to the STB, so it will switch channels.
For more info, see our manual at https://imkapps.com
Premium
During the first 25 connections to your TV you can evaluate all Premium features:
• myTifi on Apple Watch
• switch on TV (K-Series or higher)
• Smart Source & Smart Control
• customisable buttons & starting TV apps
• keyboard and touchpad
• no advertisement
After the evaluation period, the standard version will apply.
You can easily become a Premium user by a one-time purchase.
Privacy
The sections "Data used to track you" and "Data linked to you" are only used for advertisement in the Standard version.
When purchasing the Premium or Ad-free version, only "Data not linked to you" is applicable for our internal diagnostics.
This makes myTifi the most privacy aware remote control app in the App Store.
Disclaimer
This is an unofficial third-party remote control app designed for Samsung TVs.
Brand names are used solely to indicate compatibility, as the app only works with products from this manufacturer.

At badrgo, we're not just a taxi app; we're your dedicated travel companion, committed to making every journey extraordinary. With us, convenience, safety, and affordability meet seamlessly, ensuring that your ride is nothing short of exceptional.
Your Destination, One Tap Away!
Experience the unmatched convenience of badrgo. Just launch the app, input your destination, and a driver will be at your service, guaranteeing a reliable and comfortable journey to your chosen location.
 Choose Your Perfect Service Class
Whether you're in a rush and need a swift Economy ride, prefer comfort and relaxation with our Comfort class, or want Opulence with our Premium option, we've got you covered. Customize your ride to match your needs, ensuring the level of comfort and speed that suits you best.

At badrgo, we prioritize your safety above all else. Our app offers complete transparency – you'll have access to essential information about your driver, including their name and rating, as well as details about the vehicle coming to pick you up. For added peace of mind, you can share your journey route with trusted contacts, so they always know your whereabouts.

 Monthly Deals: Unlock Incredible Savings

 Your Journey Starts Here!
Download the badrgo app now and embrace a future where convenience, reliability, and affordability seamlessly come together. Your journey begins with us. Join the badrgo community today!

bluejetty:00024392:ios.name: Join Blob Clash 3D — Crowd Run
bluejetty:00024392:ios.summary: Get ready for an epic survival run in Join Blob Clash. Collect and upgrade your army of colorful blobs, overcome dangerous obstacles and defeat the blob boss at the end of each level. This is a fun casual game with lots of different levels,
bluejetty:00024392:ios.description:
Get ready for an epic survival run in Join Blob Clash. Collect and upgrade your army of colorful blobs, overcome dangerous obstacles and defeat the blob boss at the end of each level. This is a fun casual game with lots of different levels, dangerous traps and vibrant graphics.
In the game, you will manage your own blob. Control your character with a simple tap of your finger, collecting other blobs along the way and forming an invincible army out of them.
The game's objective is to guide your army to the end of the level, defeat the biggest blob boss, and win the race. But be warned, the boss is tough and his punches pack a punch. You can collect a crowd of blobs, overcome obstacles, grab coins, and break through opponents to face giant bosses.
Each level is carefully designed to offer a unique set of challenges, including obstacles, traps, and enemies. As you progress through the game, you'll face increasingly difficult challenges that require quick reflexes, strategic thinking, and the ability to adapt to new situations. With every level, you'll have the chance to collect new blob skins and upgrade your existing ones.
The game's intuitive interface and easy-to-use controls make it accessible to players of all skill levels, whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to the mobile gaming world. And with its bright and colorful graphics, Join Blob Clash is a visual feast for the eyes, immersing you in a world of adventure and excitement.
As you progress through levels, you'll get coins that you can use to customize your blob army with cool costumes. Want to make your army look like secret agents, ninjas or other unique characters? No problem! In Join Blob Clash, the possibilities are endless.
So if you're ready to take on the ultimate survival challenge, start your epic journey to victory. With its many features, challenging levels, and addictive gameplay, Join Blob Clash is the perfect game to keep you entertained for hours on end. Don't wait – join the race and see if you have what it takes to come out on top!

Total Files supports DropBox, Google Drive, OneDrive and iCloud Files and offers iOS Files app integration to download and upl
bluejetty:00075620:ios.description:
Total Files is the one stop file manager for iOS, with powerful PDF reader, cloud storage support and much more!
Total Files supports DropBox, Google Drive, OneDrive and iCloud Files and offers iOS Files app integration to download and upload to any cloud from any app! 
You'll not need to install a separate app for each storage provider that you want to use from your device! Link all cloud accounts in Total Files and enjoy the full integration with iOS. For example, thanks to the iOS “Files” integration, you can directly save files to one of the cloud linked in Total, simply using the "Save in files” feature available in any apps on your device.
Virtual folders allows to group files that come from different sources (cloud or local). 
The Spotlight indexing of all local contents allows to immediately find and open the file you're looking for, without opening the app!
Our powerful PDF viewer offers annotation capabilities and automatically recognise common shapes and gestures to highlight paragraph 
Main features: 
- iOS 11 Files app integration for ALL clouds linked to the app in read write mode.
- Supports Dropbox, GDrive, OneDrive, iCloud services for remote file storage.
- Search between all contents in the app and in the linked cloud storages thanks to the advanced search 
- Compression and decompression features (zip)
- Spotlight indexing
- PDF editor with annotation, shape recognition 
- Simultaneous linking of multiple Cloud accounts and management of folders shared with other users. 
- Bookmarks and history management. 
- URL autocomplete
- Quick search bar, and enhanced search within all cloud and local files.
- PIN to hide and secure folders.
- Multi-tab browser

bluejetty:00084801:ios.description:
Welcome to Sadhana, a virtual world of ancient Vedic glory.
Learn, practice and experience the power of Vedic rituals with guided mantra japa, nitya puja, yajnas, abhishekam or mystical sadhanas.
Set in the mystical land of Siddhashrma, hidden deep in the Himalayas, the Sadhana App recreates the sacred place where some of the greatest sages, transcendental rishis invoked such deities as Lord Shiva, Lord Vishnu, and Mother Goddess with the most sublime Vedic rituals.
EXPERIENCE THE SACRED WORLD OF SADHANA.
Sadhana is not just an app. It's an entire ancient world in your hands so you may reap the immeasurable rewards of daily Vedic practice.
Choose self-guided or fully guided daily practices in English or Hindi, and discover perfect inner balance and harmony through Mantra Sadhana.
HERE’S HOW IT WORKS
Follow the path of the Vedas through these 5 interactive rituals:
JAPA
Chant mantra, count your rounds or use the timer.
YAJNA
Perform guided fire offerings to the deity of your choice in the beautiful ancient Himalayas.
ABHISHEKAM
Anoint the deity of your choice with the purest ingredients and Vedic chants.
NITYA PUJA
Do daily worship at your own personal shrine dedicated to the god of your choice. Fully guided and interactive.
SADHANA
Awaken the power of any mantra with this ancient Vedic practice. Fully guided with the ability to select the deity of your choice.
PLUS ENJOY THESE KEY FEATURES
* Enjoy custom music across the 5 elements that is specific to deity and location
* Achievements board to record your progress across the 5 rituals
* Choose from 10 Temple locations for each ritual
* Leaderboard to share your daily practices
* Panchang (Indian Vedic Calendar)
* Available in English and Hindi
A WORD FROM OUR FOUNDER OM SWAMI
“Based on my personal experience of Vedic sadhana spanning more than three decades, I have created an entire virtual world for you in this Sadhana App.
The legendary Siddhashrma that our scriptures refer to, has been created for you once again. This is the same place where our sages meditated and performed penance.
If you wish to experience the Vedic glory and opulence that our ancestors thrived in, then Sadhana offers you the opportunity to get started. This has been done to serve the beautiful Sanatana Dharma and to revive the Vedic culture.
Sadhana App is my humble offering in your service and our dharma.”
~ Om Swami
DOWNLOAD FREE
Created to serve humanity, Sadhana is 100% free. There’s no subscription, no paywall, no restrictions and no advertisements.
Download free now and awaken yourself to the healing power of the Vedic traditions.
ABOUT US
Sadhana has been developed by Om Swami and a world class team.
Om Swami learned Vedic chanting when he was eleven years old. Mesmerized by the mellifluous verses, mantra sadhana became the basis of his spiritual journey. Over the next three decades, he experimented with numerous mantras and invoked many of them. Om Swami has touched the lives of millions around the world through his talks and writings. He is the bestselling author of more than fifteen books on meditation, wellness, and spirituality with best-sellers like Kundalini, The Ancient Science of Mantras, A Million Thoughts, and If Truth Be Told.
The Sadhana team includes some of the best artists and digital creators from France, Germany, Hungary, Argentina, Brazil, Ireland, Spain, Canada, England, Indonesia, Taiwan, Australia and of course, India, all coming together to give shape to the world of Sadhana.
VISIT OUR WEBSITE TO LEARN MORE
www.sadhana.app

bluejetty:00119282:ios.description:
SmartHQ: Your Connected Home Command Center 
Effortlessly control your smart appliances from GE Appliances, Profile, Café, Monogram, Fisher & Paykel, and Haier – all in one app. 
KEY FEATURES:
• REMOTE CONTROL – Monitor and control your appliances from anywhere, ensuring peace of mind and convenience. 
• STAY INFORMED - Receive timely notifications about your appliances, including alerts and updates. 
• SOFTWARE UPDATES - Keep your appliances running smoothly with the latest software updates and access new features as they become available. 
• PERSONALIZED EXPERIENCE - Create shortcuts for frequently used functions and download new appliance modes.
• VOICE INTEGRATION – Add your appliances to Amazon Alexa and Google Home hubs for voice control.
• MONITOR ENERGY & WATER USAGE - Gain insights into your appliance's energy and water consumption, helping you make informed choices. 
• ENHANCED COOKING EXPERIENCE - Generate cooking recipes using Flavorly AI. Monitor your oven's progress with the built-in camera and pair accessories such as smart cookware and probes.
• CONVENIENT PRODUCT REGISTRATION - Register all your GE appliances, even non-Wi-Fi models, for quick access to manuals, specs, and support. 
• GET EXPERT HELP - Access the SmartHQ Assistant for answers to your appliance questions. 
• PROACTIVE SERVICE - Receive service alerts when your appliance needs attention and use the diagnostics tool to troubleshoot issues. 
• SCHEDULE SERVICE - Schedule a technician visit or access appliance support contact information. 
*Note: Features may vary depending on your appliance model and country of residence. 
REMOTE CONTROL REQUIREMENTS: 
Requires a compatible SmartHQ-enabled appliance or SmartHQ Connect module. SmartHQ Connect modules can be purchased online: https://www.geapplianceparts.com/store/parts/spec/PBX23W00Y0?SpecType=SpecType. 
OPTIONAL APP PERMISSIONS:
• Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth/BLE
 - Used for commissioning nearby appliances. 
• Notifications
 - Used for product updates and status notifications.
• Camera/Media Files 
 - Used for Flavorly Picture to Recipe feature. 
 - To scan QR codes to add appliances.
 - To scan product barcodes and provide recipes. 
• Precise Location 
 - Used for enabling Automation feature (i.e. Home/Away mode).

bluejetty:00044172:ios.summary:
Characters from the hit anime series "Puella Magi Madoka Magica" come together!

bluejetty:00044172:ios.description:
Characters from the hit anime series "Puella Magi Madoka Magica" come together!
Featuring an all-new story setting and characters from the original ideas of Gekidan Inu Curry (Doroinu), experience the action alongside Magical Girl memories in this battle RPG!
Now go. Unveil the memories of these Magical Girls.
◆ Puella Magi Madoka Magica Magia Exedra Features
・Dive into the 3D world of Madoka Magica!
・Includes all-original stories!
・Play turn-based command battles with easy controls and powerful, cinematic skill animations!
・Explore Witch Labyrinths and relive Magical Girl memories!
◆ Enter a Realm of Magical Memories! ◆
A place where the memories of Magical Girls illuminate the dark...
The Lighthouse.
Now a girl who's lost everything has wandered into its sanctum.
Who am I...?
How did I get here...?
She will relive key moments of countless Magical Girls by opening windows into their memories...
Trusting she'll one day find her own lost light of remembrance.
◆ Dive into the World of Puella Magi Madoka Magica Fully Recreated in 3D! ◆
Magical Girls from throughout the series will appear as you relive their various stories from the anime "Puella Magi Madoka Magica" (Madoka Magica), the "Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story" (Magia Record) mobile game, and more!
◆ Enter Witch Labyrinth worlds like no other, fully recreated in 3D!
Guide characters through treacherous Witch Labyrinths to collect the light of Magical Girl memories, items, and more.
Dive deep into Witch Labyrinths that recreate the series' worldscapes for a fully immersive experience.
◆ Featuring a layered battle system with easy controls invoking series all-star Magical Girls!
Mix and match Magical Girls from throughout the series to create your dream team.
Play strategic command battles with easy controls and a key break feature for turning the tide of victory.
Optimize your Magical Girls' battle strengths through their roles and elemental affinities to take on powerful Witches lurking in Labyrinth lairs.
◆ Staff ◆
Planning and Distribution: Aniplex Inc.
Development: Pokelabo, Inc. / f4samurai, Inc.
Management: Pokelabo, Inc.
◆ Voice Cast ◆
Akari Komiyama, Ayana Taketatsu,
Aoi Yuki, Chiwa Saito, Kaori Mizuhashi, Eri Kitamura, Ai Nonaka, Emiri Kato,
Momo Asakura, Sora Amamiya, Shiina Natsukawa, Ayane Sakura, Yui Ogura, Manaka Iwami...
...and many more!

Preview images, documents, PDFs, and media files. Transfer files to your computer via Wi-Fi. Upload and manage your files.
Download big files in the background, and manage files .

● Private and Safe web surfing
● Play video with supported formats:
- MP4, MOV, M4V, AVI, MKV, 4K videos

- create playlists

- watch videos

- Google search
- Search auto-completion
- History support

- HTTP basic authentication

- In-app utility notification
● File manager

- Move, rename, and delete files

bluejetty:00160541:ios.description:
Simple and accurate determination of the optimal PV tilt angle. Make your PV System generates maximum electricity for your desired location. The wrong position of your PV System can cause losses in electricity generation and your project feasibility may be a question.
With this App you will obtain:
- Solar Data charts (elevation, azimuth, sunrise, sunset time, noon time, sunlight duration, etc.)
- Tilt vs azimuth optimization (find the ideal tilt angle for any chosen azimuth)
- Optimal Tilt angle for any desired location on the map
- Optimal orientation
- Optimal monthly tilt angle
- Optimal daily tilt angle
- Optimal hourly tilt angle
- On-site inclinometer for measuring angles
The tilt angle of the panels is one of the most important parameters for your PV system. It is the angle at which the photovoltaic panels are set to face the sun relative to a horizontal position. The panels must have appropriate tilt angle, set for gaining maximum possible electricity from your PV system for your location. PV Solar Tilt is using optimization model for obtaining the most appropriate tilt angle of your panels in order to gain maximum electricity generation from your system.
The model is based on sophisticated simulations for maximizing energy yield for a given location. 
If you need any assistance or clarification, please let us know at support@pvsolcast.com. For more information, please visit our website: www.pvsolcast.com.
For super accurate PV Solar Forecasting with unlimited PV Plants in your portfolio, please visit our solar platform: https://elex.mk/solar-forecast
Privacy policy link: https://sites.google.com/view/pvstilt/home

bluejetty:00120178:ios.name: Hearoes
bluejetty:00120178:ios.summary:
Empower your hearing today!
Hearoes is an interactive auditory training platform for those with Cochlear Implants, Hearing aids and hearing loss to help familiarise different environmental sounds, and vocabulary (such as Ling's Sounds, Vow
bluejetty:00120178:ios.description:
Empower your hearing today!
Hearoes is an interactive auditory training platform for those with Cochlear Implants, Hearing aids and hearing loss to help familiarise different environmental sounds, and vocabulary (such as Ling's Sounds, Vowels and Consonants) to improve auditory feedback with a clear understanding of how progress is being made.
We've collaborated with different audiologist and speech pathologist at hospitals to help bring engaging interactive auditory training different stages of their hearing journey to help hear new sounds and confidence today.
It combines proven assessments used in rehabilitation sessions and on-going training with gamified activities and interactions to create an aesthetically engaging and user-centric experience for recipients. Hearoes helps this critical stage of on-going training become less of a chore for those with hearing aids, cochlear implants, and hearing loss.
It features dynamic pathways covering 5 key proven modules and 30+ fun activities focused on learning a specific part in the hearing journey of new sounds. 
Some of the key modules featured in Hearoes are: 
- Environmental Sounds: Combination of daily sounds, such as in the kitchen, rural and farm, and music. Immerse yourself in different environments and hear the sounds around the theme.
- Introduction to Words: Featuring Ling's Sounds, High/Low Pitches and a wide range of different Syllables
- Singleton Vowels: Featuring a range of activities and difficulties around vowel sounds.
- Common Consonant Confusions: Helping to be familiar with common consonant sounds in initial, final and mix position.
- Understanding Sentences: Progressive narratives in common day scenes. Ranging from video clips (for visual cues like lip-reading) to audio with background noise to help learn in a comfortable notion.
We also have a feedback option built-in and would love to hear your thoughts, so we can continue to build a great product to help those with hearing loss feel comfortable in different environments.

bluejetty:00174865:ios.name: Scope Nights Astronomy Weather
bluejetty:00174865:ios.summary:
Clearer Nights Ahead with Scope Nights Astronomy Weather...
Scope Nights helps stargazers, astronomers, and astrophotographers find the clearest, darkest skies. Instead of analysing conventional weather forecasts yourself, Scope Nights doe
bluejetty:00174865:ios.description:
Clearer Nights Ahead with Scope Nights Astronomy Weather...
Scope Nights helps stargazers, astronomers, and astrophotographers find the clearest, darkest skies. Instead of analysing conventional weather forecasts yourself, Scope Nights does the work for you, showing exactly when and where conditions will be best for observing the night sky.
"Every amateur astronomer yearns for clear, dark skies, and this exhaustive app helps you find them." - Sky At Night Magazine
"Scope Nights has become my favorite… it does a fine job of summarizing the data in a clear and understandable fashion." - Sky & Telescope Magazine
Plan Your Observing
• Smart stargazing ratings with animated weather icons
• Custom thresholds for moon phase, wind, humidity, and temperature
• Compare conditions across your favourite observing sites
Find Dark Sky Sites
• Detailed light pollution map from NASA satellite data
• Certified dark sky places, observatories, and robotic telescopes
Detailed Global Forecasts
• Long‑range forecasts worldwide (up to 7 nights, 7 locations)
• Local forecasts for UK & USA direct from Met Office & NOAA
• Night‑time specific data: cloud cover, moon phase, humidity, wind, temperature, sunrise/sunset, moonrise/moonset
Notifications & Sharing
• Custom alerts for good observing conditions before sunset
• App badge showing tonight’s best sites
• Share astronomy weather reports with friends or observatories
Requirements
• iOS 15 or later
• Internet connection (Wi-Fi or cellular)
• Location Services to provide local stargazing forecasts and notifications. No personal data is collected, and no tracking occurs.
• Background Services for local notifications. Notifications are used only to alert you about good stargazing conditions, they are not used for advertising or tracking.
Scope Nights is independently developed. Your reviews and ratings help sustain future updates for the stargazing community.

bluejetty:00179062:ios.description:
MiniGames is a collection of new, retro and modern games. You can play on your Apple Watch, iPhone or iPad with no Ads!
It's like your own personal games arcade on the go.
This collection of 28 games includes:
■ GLIDE
Help the red bird fly. Use the hills to gain speed and soar high to score points.
■ CIPHER
Crack the code. Guess the 4 color code from the clues you get per turn.
■ SHAPES
Fun puzzle game where you drop shapes to merge them into new shapes.
■ TIC TAC TOE
Classic game of noughts and crosses. Play single player or against a friend.
■ PONG
Play one of the first video games ever created. This simple tennis like game is an absolute classic. 
■ BRICK BREAK
A fun retro falling brick game. Stack the bricks together to clear a line and score some points.
■ INVADERS
Classic arcade action. Shoot all the space invaders before they get you. Hit the mothership for bonus points.
■ 2048
Enjoy the addictive 2048 game on your watch or phone. Swipe the number tiles around to join them. Join the tiles to reach 2048.
■ TUBE TWIST
Guide your runner down an endless tube. Twist the tube to avoid the holes and spikes. Collect the yellow power orbs, the more you collect the longer you can speed boost. Tap your player to activate your speed boost. Hit the red jumps while boosting to get your bonus score. 
■ BUBBLE
Classic match 3 puzzle game. Connect the bubbles by color to clear them.
■ MISSILE
How long can you survive a deadly onslaught of homing missiles? Maneuver your fighter plane to avoid the missiles and make them crash into each other. 
■ HOP
Jump from platform to platform to gain more height and points. Shoot the winged baddies along the way.
■ Drift
Enjoy high octane drifting down a treacherous road. One false move and down you go. Try and survive as long as you can to get the top score.
■ Cong
It's like pong, but in a circle. Use the digital crown to move the paddle around the circle and keep the ball in play.
■ Tower
Build your Tower by stacking colourful blocks on top of each other. Place them perfectly for bonus points.
■ FLAP
Guide the bird through a never ending forest by flapping your wings.
■ FROG ROAD
Help the cute frogs avoid the cars and cross the road. A 3D update to the classic Frogger game.
■ BLOCK RUN
Feel like going for a a run? Help the voxel guy avoid the colourful obstacles by jumping, rolling and turning around the corners.
■ MATCHTRIS
A mashup of Tetris and Dr. Mario. Move the falling blocks to match 4 or more colors to clear them. Setup the blocks to fall and match for combos and extra points.
■ DRONE
Pilot your drone down the never ending corridors of an Alien spaceship.
■ THRUST
Strap your rocket boots on and zoom down a dark cave. Thrust combines a classic cave flyer game with elements of flappy bird.
■ SUPER JUMP
We’ve taken the fun of the humble platformer game and mashed it with an endless runner. Keep your player running by jumping over holes, ditches and enemies. Collect fruit to score points and the more you score the faster you run. 
■ RETRO RACER
Inspired by pseudo 3d racing games like Outrun and Pole Position but with modern graphics. Enjoy the surreal, exhilarating sense of speed while you race to beat the clock.
Please note this game requires a watch series 4 or newer.
■ CONTRA PANG
A mashup of Contra’s shooting action and the bubble popping fun of Pang.
■ CIRCLE INVADERS
A new twist to the classic Space Invaders. With a unique circular design and lots of power-ups.
■ MOON SNAKE
We took the classic fruit eating snake and put him on the moon. Avoid the bombs and your own tail to survive. 
■ DUAL BREAK
What could be better than the classic paddle game Breakout? How about power-ups and an extra paddle to control.
■ CIRCLE BREAK
It’s like Pong in a Circle meets Breakout. Keep the ball from leaving the circle and break all the obstacles to finish the stage.
Features:
• No ads!
• Apple Watch support
• Screen shake
• Vibrations
• Sound Effects 
• Music
• Leaderboards

bluejetty:00095319:ios.description:
VitalBeat: All-in-One Health Tracking App 
VitalBeat is a comprehensive health tracking app integrating heart rate, blood pressure, blood glucose, and blood oxygen monitoring. With a simple, intuitive interface and powerful features, it helps you build healthy habits every day and better understand your physical condition.
Whether you want to record post-exercise heart rate, manage blood pressure data for hypertension, monitor blood glucose levels, or track blood oxygen trends, VitalBeat makes your health records efficient and reliable.
[Main Features]
• Heart Rate Tracking 
Detect your heart rate through the app and view historical records to understand your cardiovascular health. Suitable for monitoring heart rate at rest, during exercise, or recovery.
• Blood Pressure Recording 
Record systolic and diastolic values and add notes (such as stress, sleep, or exercise condition). Trend analysis supports your health goals and medical tracking.
• Blood Glucose Monitoring 
Log daily blood glucose readings and easily track fluctuation trends. Helps with diabetes management or overall health improvement.
• Blood Oxygen Recording 
Newly added blood oxygen saturation recording helps you monitor blood oxygen level changes. Suitable for users concerned about respiratory health, exercise recovery, or high-altitude environments. Track blood oxygen trends via charts, prevent abnormal fluctuations, and safeguard your health.
• Trend Reports & Visualized History 
Discover daily, weekly, and monthly health patterns easily through charts and graphs. Gain valuable insights into your health progress and ensure comprehensive information.
• Secure Data Storage 
All data is stored locally, ensuring your personal health information is private and completely under your control.
[Who is it for?] 
• People managing hypertension, diabetes, or needing to monitor blood oxygen health 
• Users who want to track vital signs 
• Fitness and health enthusiasts 
• Anyone looking to establish consistent healthy habits
[Why Choose VitalBeat?] 
• No extra devices needed: measure and record directly with your phone. 
• Quick logging: simple design saves time. 
• Clear and intuitive interface: easy to operate, no complex learning required. 
• No registration: start tracking your health data instantly, no tedious steps.
[Important Notice] 
VitalBeat is for health tracking purposes only and does not provide disease diagnosis or treatment. Always consult a professional healthcare provider before making medical decisions.
Download VitalBeat now and start paying attention to your health—track your daily health data today!
Privacy Policy: https://as.vitalbeat.codejoys.net/privacy_policy.html 
Terms of Use: https://as.vitalbeat.codejoys.net/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00020923:ios.description:
Connect dots, relax with fun puzzle games, collect hidden objects, play exciting mini-games, and adventure through the universe with Two Dots: a premium brain puzzle game experience that will connect you to endless fun. Whether you want to turn your brain off to unwind or turn your brain on to solve challenging levels, that depends on the puzzle! Join millions of players who have already discovered the soothing joy of connecting colors.
Join two brave dots on their epic, fun adventure as they explore mysterious landscapes, flow through a wide variety of puzzle games, and collect hidden treasures in the beautiful world of Two Dots. Enjoy relaxing music and soothing sound effects as you carefully connect a line, or form a square! and let your brain soak up the vibrant colors. Connect with friends to share your fun adventures, compare games, and line up your hard-earned trophies. Alternatively, just relax on your own while you train your brain with solo puzzle challenges. Some limited-time events in Two Dots, like our incredibly popular Scavenger Hunt, are world-famous for their beautiful, intricate art. 
Form a line and try to make a square to defeat brain-teasing puzzles, or find hidden objects carefully tucked away within the delightfully detailed Scavenger Hunt maps. Remember, making one single square clears all dots of that color and could connect you directly to victory! 
Two Dots offers multiple fun puzzles and mini-games to keep your mind sharp and entertained. Explore the expansive Scavenger Hunt or beat the clock in the Arcade. Connect every color in the Flip mode, have fun hunting for rewards in the Treasure Hunt, and even replay the classic, original Two Dots events with our Rewind puzzles! You'll collect stunning objects and badges from your Two Dots puzzles and games in all colors of the rainbow. If you're ever stuck in your Two Dots game, save some stress and blast through the board with an awesome Power-Up!
WHY YOU'LL LOVE TWO DOTS
● FREE to play: Two Dots puzzle games are fun and completely FREE to play! Zero cost to connect and enjoy.
● ADVENTURE through over 5000 relaxing puzzle levels: Connect dots in a line or a square to win a level. Satisfy your brain with consistently updated, relaxing, and fun puzzle games.
● ENJOY hallmark art: Dive into fun puzzle games featuring Two Dots' beautiful, minimalist art style, including the legendary, highly detailed Scavenger Hunt. 
● PUZZLES, PUZZLES, PUZZLES: Connect with 5 distinct fun game modes, plus tons of special features, exciting seasonal events, and much more!
● COLLECT rewards: Gather hidden objects, play the Scavenger Hunt game and collect them all to complete your gallery!
● ANYONE can play: These puzzles are great brain training for players of all ages. It's a fun way to play puzzle games with the whole family!
● RELAXING PUZZLES: Let yourself flow into the perfect game! Make a line, connect the colors and form a square. 
● WIN Power-Ups: Ensure you can collect every fabulous Two Dots reward by utilizing unique boosts!
● CHALLENGE your friends: Connect on social media and see how your Two Dots games match up! Who can get the highest score in all our puzzle games? Where are all the Scavenger Hunt hidden objects? 
Colorblind mode in Two Dots is free and available to all. 
Problems? Suggestions? We'd love to hear from you! Contact Customer Support at https://dots.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-two-dots/
Two Dots is free to download and includes optional in-game purchases (including random items). Information about drop rates for random item purchases can be found in-game. If you wish to disable in-game purchases, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet’s Settings.
Do Not Sell My Personal Information: https://www.take2games.com/ccpa/
Our Terms of Service are changing. See https://zynga.support/T2TOSUpdate for more info.

bluejetty:00112103:android.description:
*For Switzerland only!*
The search.ch app IDs incoming calls and unsolicited advertising calls for you, and even lets you block them:
 • Thanks to caller ID, you always know who’s contacted you, even if their number isn’t in your address book.
 • The app can also automatically block known and verified advertising callers if desired.
The search.ch app also offers other helpful features:
 • Live Search: find locations such as petrol stations, restaurants and ATMs near you, wherever you are. You can also see departure times for the nearest public transport stop.
 • Timetable: find the fastest public transport connections – by train, tram, bus, PostBus or boat – and see any delays in real time.
 • Telephone directory: find the telephone numbers and addresses of individuals and companies in Switzerland and Liechtenstein, including their locations on the map.
 • Weather: always stay informed with local forecasts featuring rain maps, a five-day forecast, water temperature forecast, rain radar and written forecast.
 • Map/route planner: benefit from the most detailed map of Switzerland with information about public transport, museums, car parks, restaurants, hiking routes and campfire sites. Our car, bike and pedestrian route planners will take you directly to your destination without any unplanned diversions.
 • TV and cinema schedules: see the current schedule – a straightforward overview at any time.

bluejetty:00022070:ios.description:
Get all the information you need to explore Australia’s greatest national parks including Blue Mountains, Kosciuszko, and Sydney Harbour.
Use free, downloadable maps and park guides to plan your next NSW national parks adventure. Find the nearest places to stay, activities, and attractions, then create a list of your favourites.
Discover beauty and diversity in over 225 NSW national parks. Explore coastal lookouts and beaches, picturesque campgrounds, or outback walking tracks.
Download interactive maps -
● Comprehensive, interactive maps.
● Locate parks, things to do, and places to stay.
● Download maps before you visit, then navigate safety when you’re in a park, even if there's no reception, internet or Wi-Fi.
Discover things to do -
● Explore activities and attractions like a local
● Easily find things to do that are close to your current location
● Plan ahead, using information about distances, accessibility, and facilities.
Find unique places to stay -
● Locate campgrounds and caravan sites nearby.
● Discover cabins, homesteads and lighthouse cottages for your next trip away.
Your local national park is closer than you think -
● Use your location to find the NSW national parks closest to you
● Find parks all over NSW using the map or the search tool
● Check the location of toilets, picnic areas and other facilities at a glance
Save your favourites -
● Add and remove your favourite parks, things to do, or places to stay.
● Quickly access them later via your collection of favourites.
Notes:
● Internet coverage is often unavailable in NSW national parks
● Before you visit a park, download it to your phone so you can access information and maps offline.

bluejetty:00022530:ios.description:
Explore your photos in a new brand way. Giftr creates magical animated memories with your pictures. Designed to be the most advanced GIF maker for iOS. Giftr is also very easy to use and packed with editing tools. It’s the ideal App for advanced and novice users.
Experience the new generation & world’s fastest stop motion editor with real-time rendering.
Create your own memories:
- Add, remove, re-order frames on the fly while you’re editing.
- Adjust speed, duration & play mode
- Add music to your memories
- More than 200 stickers, Bitmoji & GIPHY animated stickers
- Powerful & highly customizable text tool
- Crop, straighten, rotate, skew
- Contrast, saturation, brightness, vignette, exposure, temperature, tint, shadows, highlights, selective HSL, sharpen, hue, fade, …
- Grain, color shift, double exposure, color & gradient overlay
- More than 7 million filters to discover
Browse your memories:
- Listed in chronological order
- Highlights of the past years
- Favorites & recents
- Plotted on a map
- In 3D with Augmented Reality
Save your memories:
- To your library as Videos, Live Photos, Animated GIFs
- Or to your Files
Share your memories:
- Snapchat, TikTok, GIPHY
- WhatsApp, iMessage, Email
- Facebook, Instagram Story
- And many more...
Enjoy Giftr's smart algorithm, powered by Artificial Intelligence. It will keep on surprising with animated and engaging memories.
Feel secure about your privacy:
- All processing is done locally on your device
- We never upload or look at your photos
If you love taking pictures, we think you’ll agree Giftr is a must-have app. We invite you to try it out and drop us a line at hello@giftr.cool and let us know what you think!
Privacy Policy: www.giftr.cool/privacy

You'll find a unique twist on the classic color by number experience, as you get to bring animated pictures to life with your artistic touch.
The gameplay is simple and intuitive. Just select a color from the palette and tap the corresponding numbered area on the picture. As you fill in the colors, the animation unfolds, revealing hidden surprises and delightful transformations. 
Features:
- probably the first and only animate-by-number game!
- hundreds of amazing pictures waiting to be brought to life. Unleash your creativity!
- paint with the swipe of your finger! Use two fingers to zoom in on a picture, slide across the color palette, pick one and start painting! 
- family-friendly content - "Live Colors" is designed for all ages
- free to play - probably the best feature :) Hundreds of pics are waiting to be revealed
- the best coloring game: works great even on older phones or tablets.
Unleash your creativity and witness the captivating effects of your artistry in real-time!

bluejetty:00178684:ios.summary: The Real Piano provides all the tools necessary to master the art of playing piano and electronic keyboard on your smartphone or tablet. Now you can easily play any music, anywhere! Feel the sensation of playing piano or electronic keyboard
bluejetty:00178684:ios.description:
The Real Piano provides all the tools necessary to master the art of playing piano and electronic keyboard on your smartphone or tablet. Now you can easily play any music, anywhere! Feel the sensation of playing piano or electronic keyboard in a real band!
What is a piano?
A piano is a musical instrument that produces sound by striking strings with hammers. It's known for its wide range and versatility, making it suitable for various music genres.
Haven't learned to play the piano yet?
Real Piano offers multiple video lessons to support you, along with a variety of loops for interactive play-along experiences.
Don't have access to a grand piano or an electronic keyboard? No problem! 
Real Piano provides a diverse range of instruments with high-quality sounds, enabling you to play any song you desire!
You don't need a physical piano or a digital keyboard to learn to play!
Real Piano is an ideal choice for practicing or playing the piano quietly, without causing disturbance or requiring extensive space. Enjoy the freedom to practice piano anywhere you like!

Just woke up and want a break? Need a place to work quietly for half a day? A pool or a spa for the afternoon? A room to rest between flights? Open the app, pick the hotel you like, build your experience and book in 30 seconds.
WHAT YOU CAN BOOK
• Hotel rooms by the hour, with early check-in available
• Day Spa, rooms with jacuzzi
• Pools (indoor and outdoor, seasonal and year-round)
• Lunch or dinner in quality hotel restaurants
• Meeting rooms and business spaces for remote work
• Hotels near airports for layovers and waiting times
• Bundles room + breakfast, room + spa, room + lunch
HOW IT WORKS
1. Search for city, date and times you need
2. Compare available hotels, filter by services and price
3. Book from the app — pay at the hotel
4. Show your confirmation at reception and enjoy your day use experience
WHY DAYBREAKHOTELS
• 8,000 hotels handpicked in the US and worldwide
• Only verified properties, reviewed by real guests
• Free cancellation on most bookings
• No upfront payment on most hotels
• Day use rates up to 75% off, no surprises
• Customer support in English
MAIN CITIES IN THE US
New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Chicago, Las Vegas, San Francisco, Boston, Washington DC, Atlanta, Dallas, Seattle, Houston, and many more.
AND BEYOND THE US
Rome, Paris, Berlin, Madrid, Barcelona, Vienna, Amsterdam, Brussels, Lisbon, Prague, Dubai and 1,500+ other cities.
DAYBREAKHOTELS KNOWS THE RIGHT PLACE
We're not a travel agency. We're the app that helps you find the right place for a few hours — when you need it, where you need it. To rest, to work, to enjoy a spa, to check in earlier than usual, or to spend time with someone you care about. Without paying as if you'd booked the night.
Try DayBreakHotels. Open the app and search your city.

تسوق اكثر و عزز تجربتك لتحصل على العديد من الامتيازات مع تطبيق برنامج الولاء الخاص بـ Wish

bluejetty:00045733:ios.name: PAM PROMobile
bluejetty:00045733:ios.summary: PAM PROMobile delivers services to PAM Transport, Inc. drivers. It allows drivers to send and receive messages, scan documents, view their Driver Scorecard as well as a host of other features. Get notified of available loads and accept or d
bluejetty:00045733:ios.description:
PAM PROMobile delivers services to PAM Transport, Inc. drivers. It allows drivers to send and receive messages, scan documents, view their Driver Scorecard as well as a host of other features. Get notified of available loads and accept or decline them right on your smartphone or tablet. We have included the ability to view destinations on a map as well as truck stops and weather along the way to better help you plan your day. In addition, you can avoid truck stop scanning with this app! You can take pictures of the documents you need to scan and electronically route them to the home office right from your smart device.
You will need a Fleet ID to access these features. A Fleet ID can be obtained from your driver manager or office personnel.
Features and Functionality:
• Optimized image quality
• Crop, rotate, lighten, or darken an image for better image quality
• Allow multiple documents to be scanned and sent together
• Quality Check – automatically evaluates, scores the image quality before submission. If the user captures an image of questionable focus or is not legible, the app prompts the user to review or re-take the image
• Accept or reject loads
• Two-way communication directly with the home office
Required Device:
Designed for iPhone 5 or above. Works with iPad 4, IPad Air, and iPad Mini but user MUST have sufficient light to take photographs. Does not work with iPad 2 or older or iPod Touch because the camera resolution is too low for capturing typical POD’s and trucking documents.

FANTASTIC HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME FROM THE CREATORS OF ENIGMATIS AND GRIM LEGENDS!
Demon Hunter: Chronicles from Beyond is a thrilling mystery hidden objects type of game set in 1930s America. Learn the story of Dawn Harlock, a red-eyed woman shrouded in mystery, who must return to her family estate on Iowa Island to investigate the death of her mentor, Professor Ashmore.
29 mini games and 21 hand painted hidden objects scenes! 
During her detective investigation, Dawn begins to suspect that there’s more to the story than meets the eye. Something mysterious has crossed over into our world from another dimension and her own past plays a large role in these disturbing events.
41 hand drawn locations on a mystery island! 
A captivating adventure in an eerie mansion will lead her to discover the traces of mysterious experiments and come face to face with an ancient evil.
Test your detective skills against 29 puzzles and challenges! 
She will unravel the mystery of a grotesque experiment and find out what happened years ago, when the Professor found her wandering across the island.
An immersive story full of fun mini games and HO scenes! 
Will Dawn’s true identity prove to be the key to defeating the ancient evil?
 A dreamland bonus adventure from the Collector’s Edition! 
The additional content with an an immersive bonus adventure that will pull you deeper into the game!

Optimized for phones and tablets, filled with hidden objects, perfect for playing while traveling. No - wifi required for this offline game!

bluejetty:00120414:ios.summary: Notes Writer brings handwriting, PDF annotation, rich text, Math Notebooks, voice recordings and AI writing tools into one workspace for iPad and iPhone. Capture a lecture, mark up a paper, plan a project or turn a rough draft into somethin
bluejetty:00120414:ios.description:
Notes Writer brings handwriting, PDF annotation, rich text, Math Notebooks, voice recordings and AI writing tools into one workspace for iPad and iPhone. Capture a lecture, mark up a paper, plan a project or turn a rough draft into something ready to share.
WRITE AND MAKE IT YOURS
Create beautifully formatted notes with headings, lists, colors and highlights. Work with Word documents, RTF, Markdown and plain text. Open documents in tabs and move between your ideas and reference material without losing your place.
WRITE ON PDFs WITH APPLE PENCIL
Take handwritten notes, sketch in the margins and highlight what matters. Choose from pens, pencils, markers, fountain pens and watercolor tools. Use the eraser, lasso and ruler to refine your work. Add text, shapes, images, signatures and audio to PDF notes. Fill forms, organize pages and keep your reading and annotations together. Measure distances and areas on scaled drawings, and apply text redactions in supported PDFs.
GIVE YOUR WRITING AN AI ASSIST
Rewrite a passage, simplify difficult language, fix spelling and grammar, or adjust the tone. Summarize, translate and explore ideas with AI tools and chat. Keep control of what goes into your notes and documents.
CAPTURE VOICE, FIND THE WORDS
Record lectures, meetings and ideas while they are fresh. Play recordings back at your pace and generate transcripts to revisit the details. Add recordings to your PDF notes and whiteboards for more context.
THINK BEYOND THE PAGE
Build visual whiteboards with notes, images and recordings. Capture quick thoughts on sticky notes. Structure ideas in Outline Notes with nested branches, rich text and images. Collapse sections, rearrange your thinking, and import or export outlines in OPML format.
WORK THROUGH THE NUMBERS
Combine explanations and calculations in Math Notebooks. Explore formulas with the built-in calculation tools and run Python cells when you need more. Create charts, write LaTeX documents and preview the finished PDF alongside your source.
ORGANIZE YOUR STUDY AND RESEARCH
Bring your notes, readings and research together in Study Projects. Organize subjects, lectures and sources in the Binder, plan ideas on the Corkboard and keep reference material beside your notes. Study Projects give everything a place as your understanding grows.
TAKE BIG WRITING PROJECTS FURTHER
Organize writing projects into sections in the Binder, plan with a Corkboard and review your writing as a manuscript. Keep research beside your draft, save snapshots and compile your work into a finished document or ebook.
ORGANIZE, SCAN AND SHARE
Keep notes and documents in folders with recognizable covers. Scan paper documents, import files and find what you need with search. Export supported documents to formats including PDF, DOCX, RTF, HTML and EPUB. Use the Files app and supported cloud locations to bring your work with you.
LOOK AFTER YOUR WORK
Autosave, document recovery and automatic backups help protect your progress. Use app and folder passcodes for an extra layer of privacy. Continue opening your existing Notes Writer PDF notes and outlines as you move to the new workspace.
From your first handwritten idea to your final document, make room for the way you think.
Privacy Policy
http://www.noteswriter.com/Kairoos_Privacy_Policy.html
Terms of Use
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

- You often impulsively buy new clothes when you're in a good mood, only to realize later that you already have several similar styles in your closet.
- You want to organize your closet properly but don't know where to start, feeling torn between what to keep and what to discard.
- ...
If you are facing these frustrations, let SimpleCloset be your caring dressing and styling assistant, helping you create your own digital closet that suits you perfectly.

- Fashion enthusiasts
- Fashion learners

- Organizing and storage enthusiasts
- Professionals in the fashion industry
- ...

- Rich properties to comprehensively manage all clothing items
- Customizable categories for each item to have its own place
- Quick input to reduce the burden of usage
- Efficient background removal for easy outfit collage
2. Outfit Gallery
- Free combination of clothing items to create creative collages
- Freedom to define occasions for each outfit to have its exclusive stage
- Quick photo tagging of items by importing from the gallery
- Set random rules to stimulate outfit inspiration

- Write outfit diaries with snapshot sharing support

- Reference celebrity street styles to improve fashion taste and styling skills
- Capture fashion inspiration and take notes for future implementation
5. Statistical Charts
- Multidimensional analysis to have a comprehensive understanding of closet data
- Intuitive charts for easy data visualization
6. More Advanced Features
- Multiple closets to manage wardrobes for loved ones
- Passcode protection to safeguard personal privacy
- Data backup to ensure important data is never lost
With SimpleCloset, maximize your closet and simplify your life.
