bluejetty:00089295:ios.description:
Book a taxi in under 10 seconds and experience exclusive priority service from All Island Transportation.
You can place the booking directly on our map, and see how many available cars there are.
No standing in the rain. Track your car as it arrives on a map, or call the driver when they are nearby. No more guessing where your cab might be.
Place bookings hours, days or weeks in advance. Whenever it's convenient for you.
If necessary, cancel your booking at any time. It takes seconds to place a new booking directly from the handy favourites list.
Having integrated SMS booking, we've now launched this intelligent iPhone App so you can book a taxi within 3 screen taps.
All Island Transportation is FREE to download and it costs you nothing to register.
----------------------------------------
It's so easy and quick to use. Download the App and register just once. Our intelligent software will suggest your favourite Pick Up locations, and you're ready to book your a car.
When you make a bookings, we'll notify you by Push Notification as your car is dispatched. We'll also inform you when your car is 2 minutes away, giving you additional details such as registration number, make, model and vehicle colour.
----------------------------------------
We value feedback and take all reviews very seriously. So please leave us feedback about your journey using the App. This helps us continually improve our service.

Try to beat the community in the weekly highscore list!

bluejetty:00123868:ios.summary:
ดัมมี่ทุย แอปรวมเกมไพ่และคาสิโนโซเชียลยอดนิยม เล่น ดัมมี่ ป๊อกเด้ง โป๊กเกอร์ ไพ่แคง เก้าเก สล็อต และเกมยิงปลา ครบจบในแอปเดียว ระบบเสถียร เล่นง่าย สลับเกมได้ทันที แข่งขันกับเพื่อนและผู้เล่นทั่วประเทศได้ตลอด 24 ชั่วโมง
รวมเกมยอดฮิตในแอปเดียว
bluejetty:00123868:ios.description:
ดัมมี่ทุย แอปรวมเกมไพ่และคาสิโนโซเชียลยอดนิยม เล่น ดัมมี่ ป๊อกเด้ง โป๊กเกอร์ ไพ่แคง เก้าเก สล็อต และเกมยิงปลา ครบจบในแอปเดียว ระบบเสถียร เล่นง่าย สลับเกมได้ทันที แข่งขันกับเพื่อนและผู้เล่นทั่วประเทศได้ตลอด 24 ชั่วโมง
รวมเกมยอดฮิตในแอปเดียว
■ ดัมมี่ เกมไพ่ที่ใช้ทักษะ ความจำ และการอ่านใจคู่ต่อสู้ ลุ้นระทึกไปกับการกินมืดและน็อกมืด
■ ป๊อกเด้ง เกมไพ่คลาสสิก กติกาเข้าใจง่าย ดำเนินเกมรวดเร็ว ลุ้นแต้มป๊อก 8 ป๊อก 9 รู้ผลทันใจ
■ โป๊กเกอร์ เกมไพ่ระดับสากล ใช้ศาสตร์แห่งการคำนวณความน่าจะเป็นและไหวพริบในการบลัฟคู่แข่ง
■ ไพ่แคง เกมไพ่พื้นบ้านของไทย ทายใจคู่แข่งและทำแต้มในมือให้น้อยที่สุดเพื่อคว้าชัยชนะ
■ เก้าเก เกมไพ่สำหรับสายปั่น วัดใจด้วยไพ่ 3 ใบ ประชันไหวพริบและจังหวะหลอกล่อคู่แข่ง
■ สล็อต ฟีเจอร์หลากหลาย ลุ้นสนุกทุกการหมุน
■ เกมยิงปลา เกมล่าปลา ล็อคเป้าแม่นยำ จับปลาได้ดั่งใจ สะสมเหรียญทองได้ทั้งวันไม่มีเบื่อ
จุดเด่นของแอปดัมมี่ทุย
■ แจกชิปฟรีทุกวันเพียงแค่ล็อกอินเข้าเกม
■ กิจกรรมและภารกิจอัปเดตใหม่ทุกเทศกาล รับรางวัลมากมาย
■ ระบบเกมเสถียร กราฟิกสวยงาม ลื่นไหล โต้ตอบกับเพื่อนร่วมโต๊ะได้ทันที
หมายเหตุ
- เกมนี้ออกแบบมาสำหรับผู้เล่นที่เป็นผู้ใหญ่ อายุ 18 ปีขึ้นไป
- เกมให้บริการเพื่อความบันเทิงเท่านั้น ไม่มีส่วนเกี่ยวข้องกับการพนันเพื่อเงินจริง
- ความสำเร็จในเกมคาสิโนโซเชียลไม่ได้การันตีความสำเร็จในการเล่นการพนันด้วยเงินจริงในอนาคต

bluejetty:00069257:ios.description:
Welcome to Chaos Drink Sort: Water Puzzle, the ultimate tap sort puzzle and drink puzzle game! If you love relaxing water sort, magic sort puzzle, and bottle sort puzzle challenges where you sort into correct order, this is the perfect order sequence puzzle for your brain.
Dive into a world of colorful drinks, satisfying pours, and ranking and ordering puzzle challenges. In this magic sort water sort puzzle experience, every tap matters: just taptap the bottles to pour, sort into correct order, and become a true drinking order crazy master.
How to Play – Simple Tap Sort Puzzle Fun
Tap a bottle to pick up the colored drink (tap sort puzzle controls).
Tap another bottle to pour the liquid and sort into correct order.
Continue until each bottle has only one color.
Use logic to solve each order sequence puzzle and ranking and ordering puzzle.
Stuck? Think like a magic sort and water sort puzzle pro and try a different sequence.
Game Features
Addictive drink puzzle game combining water sort, magic sort, and bottle sort puzzle mechanics.
Hundreds of tap sort puzzle levels, from easy to pro, that challenge your brain.
Satisfying animations and colorful drinks for fans of aesthetic puzzles like i love hue–style color challenges and cozy wool crush–style relaxation.
Enjoyable order sequence puzzle gameplay where you carefully sort into correct order to win.
Pure logic: no timers, no rush, just you and your ranking and ordering puzzle strategy.
Play offline anytime—perfect for quick taptap sessions or longer water sort puzzle marathons.
Why You’ll Love Chaos Drink Sort
If you enjoy:
Relaxing water sort and magic sort puzzle games
Satisfying bottle sort puzzle challenges
Smart order sequence puzzle and ranking and ordering puzzle mechanics
Simple tap sort puzzle controls that anyone can pick up and play
…then Chaos Drink Sort: Water Puzzle will quickly become your favorite drink puzzle game.
Fans of colorful logic experiences (similar in feel to i love hue or soft, cozy puzzle vibes like wool crush) will love the way each level lets you sort into correct order and create a perfect sequence of drinks. Every pour is a small, satisfying taptap moment, turning chaos into harmony in this magic sort water sort puzzle adventure.
Download Chaos Drink Sort: Water Puzzle now and start your journey through hundreds of tap sort puzzle, water sort puzzle, magic sort puzzle, and bottle sort puzzle levels. Master every order sequence puzzle, climb your own ranking and ordering puzzle skill ladder, and prove you can handle any drinking order crazy challenge!

Identify plants in seconds. Diagnose diseases, get expert care tips, and manage your garden with ease.
Turn your phone into a powerful plant identifier app and personal garden assistant. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced plant lover, Plant Identifier – Plant Snap helps you recognize and care for any plant effortlessly.

Take a photo or upload one from your gallery to instantly identify plants, flowers, trees and leaves with high precision. Perfect for houseplants and outdoor discoveries.

Is your plant showing signs of stress or illness? Get instant results with the built-in plant disease identifier and receive expert care recommendations.

Never forget to water, mist, or fertilize. Set personalized plant care reminders to keep every plant in top condition.

- Get accurate watering and fertilizing advice

bluejetty:00178772:ios.description:
Meet Weather, The most beautiful weather app. 
Don't let bad weather take you by surprise! Whether it is cloudy, raining, snowing or even stormy outside, Weather will provide you with current weather conditions and forecasts in your city and multiple locations all around the world.
Get everything you need to stay weather-ready with your free Weather & Radar app:
• Accurate weather forecast
• Innovative weather, temperature and wind radar 
• Weather alerts + storm tracker
• Local air quality forecasts
• 15-minute forecast details
• Advanced 72-Hour Future Radar
• Check weather forecasts up to two weeks in advance!
• New personalized weather tracking for wherever you are including, UV index, pollen count, humidity & more
Weather App
Be ready for all weather conditions with Weather & Radar’s free app, giving you accurate weather reports and forecasts at your exact location in the US and around the world.
Weather Forecast
The latest forecasts for temperature and wind, chance of rain or snow, sunshine duration and UV levels. Detailed data on air pressure, dewpoint, feels-like temperature, wind chill and air pollution. Plan further ahead with the 14-day weather trend. 
Weather Map
Discover our industry-leading weather radar, including high-resolution rain, snow, wind and lightning areas. The enhanced weather maps allow you to track real-time meteorological conditions down to city and county levels.
Weather Alerts
Using the latest weather modelling and storm tracking technology, our weather alerts and push notifications keep you updated about inclement or dangerous conditions in and around your area.
In addition to providing reliable weather information, our app is user-friendly and easy to navigate. Whether you're an avid weather enthusiast or just looking for a simple, reliable weather app, Weather is the perfect choice for you.
Download Weather today and stay ahead of the weather!
About the In-App Subscription:
--Subscription period: "Weather Premiere - Monthly" (continuous monthly subscription product), "Weather Premiere - Yearly" (continuous annual subscription product), "Weather Premiere - Permanently"
--Payment: After user confirms the purchase and pays, it will be billed through your Apple ID account
--Cancel renewal: If you need to cancel the renewal, please manually turn off the automatic renewal function in the iTunes/Apple ID setting management 24 hours before the current subscription period expires
--Renewal: Apple’s iTunes account will be deducted within 24 hours before expiration. After the deduction is successful, the subscription period will be extended by one subscription period.
--Privacy Policy: http://privacypolicy.oss-us-west-1.aliyuncs.com/Dreeam_Room/privacy.txt

bluejetty:00082841:ios.name: Quizzix - Word Puzzle Game
bluejetty:00082841:ios.summary: Do you enjoy word games and brain teasers? If yes, then you're in for a delightful challenge with Quizzix, a timeless jumble game designed to keep you entertained for hours. Tailored for adults who love pushing their mental limits, this gam
bluejetty:00082841:ios.description:
Do you enjoy word games and brain teasers? If yes, then you're in for a delightful challenge with Quizzix, a timeless jumble game designed to keep you entertained for hours. Tailored for adults who love pushing their mental limits, this game will put your cognitive skills to the test.
Quizzix is an exceptional word puzzle game that offers a fun way to sharpen your mind. Success requires you to draw upon your knowledge, vocabulary, and problem-solving abilities. By solving a variety of word puzzles and riddles, you’ll unlock hidden phrases and reveal the mysteries within each level.
But how does this fascinating Quizzix puzzle work? Each level presents you with a concealed phrase, and your goal is to guess every word in that level. Once you've figured out the words, you'll combine them to uncover the secret phrase. The further you progress, the more challenging and intricate the puzzles become, pushing your logic and creativity to the limit.
The charm of Quizzix lies not only in its entertainment value but also in how it enhances your mental agility. Best of all, it’s completely free to play, offering endless hours of fun while stimulating your brain.
And there’s more – Quizzix has a unique twist. Each level is accompanied by vibrant, engaging images, making the game visually appealing as well as intellectually stimulating. These beautiful pictures aren't just there for aesthetics; they include clever riddles and puzzles you must solve to advance, blending visual beauty with mental challenge.
As you progress, you will:
Hone your logical reasoning;
Expand your vocabulary;
Discover new words along the way.
Quizzix delivers an immersive and addictive experience that keeps you motivated to tackle the next challenge. With its sleek design, easy-to-use interface, and compelling gameplay, it's a top choice for word puzzle enthusiasts. Whether you're a seasoned puzzle pro or new to the game, Quizzix provides a fun and engaging experience for all.
If you’re ready for an exciting adventure filled with word puzzles and mind-bending challenges, give Quizzix a try. Download it today and let the world of word games unfold before you. Get set to flex your brain and enjoy every moment!

Face Yoga™ is a non-invasive facial exercise routine designed to reduce double-chin, wrinkles, and improve overall attractiveness.
By creating a personalized Face Yoga™ plan, the application helps to reduce visible age by targeting skin imperfections with high-impact exercises, tailored to your needs.
Features:
- Daily personalized Face Yoga™ workout consisting of 5 exercises tailored to your desired goal.
- High-quality tutorial videos with professional voice and text explanations.
- Camera mirror to track progress.
- Ability to skip or return to your favorite exercises.
- Exclusive access skin care tips provided by leading industry experts.
- Water intake calculator, designed to optimize your skincare inside and out.
Our Face Yoga™ exercises are scientifically designed to work on the various objectives:
- Double-chin and facial fat
- Facial asymmetry
- Sagging skin and drooping eyelids
- Anti-aging and wrinkle reduction
- Skin firmness and relaxation
Does Face Yoga™ really work?
- Yes! Facial exercises are scientifically proven to reduce visible age!
HOW DOES IT WORK?
After you decide to begin your growth with Face Yoga and download the app, you can start your journey by choosing your subscription plan.

bluejetty:00127829:ios.description:
Stats is an advanced companion app for Tesla owners who want deeper insight into battery health, charging, range, efficiency, phantom drain, and driving history.
Track your Tesla over time:
o Battery health and estimated battery capacity
o Driving efficiency and range trends
o Charging history and charge reminders
o Phantom drain by day, week, month, and location
o Miles driven and cost savings compared with gas
o Firmware distribution across Stats users
Plan charging and climate:
o Schedule charging for the days and times you choose
o Stop charging at a specific time for time-of-use electricity plans
o Warm up the battery on your schedule
o Schedule climate control for selected days and times
o Receive reminders when your car is parked at home, unplugged, and below your chosen battery level
Stay informed:
o Get notifications if doors, trunk, or frunk are left open
o Get notifications if the car is left unlocked
o Optionally lock the car automatically when it is left unlocked
o Receive a reminder if climate is turned on remotely and you are not in the car
Use powerful Tesla tools:
o View recorded dashcam videos by connecting your storage device to your iPhone or iPad
o Export your stats to spreadsheets for analysis on your computer
o Compare your car's max range with similar cars
o Compare your driving efficiency with other Stats users
o Review detailed graphs for battery, charging, driving, and phantom drain
Use Stats without opening the app:
o Home Screen widgets for battery level, door status, and charging time remaining
o Siri Shortcuts for common actions such as climate control and opening the charge port
o Apple Watch support
o Multiple vehicles under the same account
o Metric and imperial units

bluejetty:00018899:ios.summary:
Enjoy fast-paced, realistic baseball game, featuring compact gameplay and informative stats.
Play BASEBALL NINE to become the Legend League Champion!
* Game Features
- Lean and fast gameplay!
- Casual characters and serious game mechanics
bluejetty:00018899:ios.description:
Enjoy fast-paced, realistic baseball game, featuring compact gameplay and informative stats.
Play BASEBALL NINE to become the Legend League Champion!
* Game Features
- Lean and fast gameplay!
- Casual characters and serious game mechanics!
- Pitching and fielding as fun as batting!
- You can play base running manually!
- Comprehensive player stats!
- Improved Autoplay with selective automation of player, inning, watching, and quick result.
- Rename, gear up, and customize your players!
- Offline mode available!
* Fast, compact gameplay!
- Enjoy a speedy, streamlined playing experience.
- Hit massive dingers and get thrilling strikeouts.
- Specialized auto functions by game, by inning, and by player are a given!
* Enjoy realistic baseball!
- Experience gameplay with realistic baseball rules.
- Simulated results based on actual game stats.
* Recruit and develop your roster!
- Recruit players and develop them by raising stats of your choice
- Equip and upgrade skills to develop them into specialists.
- Raise the player tiers to turn them into hall of famers.
* Customize your players!
- Rename them and set them as left-handed or right-handed batters or pitchers.
- Change their faces, pick body types, and choose different batting and pitching motions.
- Try equipping a range of bats, gloves, cleats, guards, and glasses to customize your players in unique ways.
* Manage your team and get promoted to higher leagues!
- Rename your team and change its emblem and uniform.
- Expand into new stadiums and manage the team’s cumulative stats.
- Advance to the postseason and win for promotion to a higher league.
* Supports tablets.
Indonesia Rating:
This game has been rated IGRS 3+ by the Indonesia Games Rating System (IGRS).

bluejetty:00074443:ios.description:
Get fast cash advances to your B9 wallet or directly to your bank account by becoming a member*. 
The B9 App is a mobile banking app where cash advances are built around your paycheck. Become a member, set up direct deposit, and get fast cash advance before your payday. No credit checks. No interest. Repay when you get paid. Once you’re a member, connect your paycheck and once it arrives on your account, request cash advances to be sent to your B9 account or send it to your bank. Need money immediately? We’ll expedite delivery within minutes for an additional fee. 
First time members may qualify for an advance range from $10-50. Not all members will qualify, and many will not qualify for a maximum amount right away. Consistent paycheck deposit will help access higher advances over time. Many members advance up to $150-$250 after their third paycheck. 
Unlike apps with daily cash-out caps, eligible B9 members can cash out their full available advance amount at once — no forced daily limits. 
Available advance amounts may increase over time based on recurring direct deposits and account activity. Qualifying income may include W-2 payroll, gig work, part-time income, and benefits such as SSI. 
Qualifying income may include W-2 payroll, gig work, part-time income, and benefits such as SSI. 
With over 1.5 million users, B9 is trusted to make everyday banking simpler, faster, and more rewarding. 
HOW TO GET YOUR B9 ADVANCE 
• Download the B9 App and open an account 
• Direct your paycheck to your B9 account 
• Access starts with your paycheck 
• Cash out the full available advance amount 
• Recurring paycheck deposits may increase your available advance amount. 
Repayment happens automatically with your next pay. 
WHY CHOOSE THE B9 APP? 
Cash out the entire available advance whenever you need it. 
Taking a break? We save your progress! Return within 35 days to start from where you left off. 
Easy banking 
Open your B9 Account and use your B9 Visa® Debit Card for everyday spending. 
Get up to 5% cashback on purchases with your B9 Visa® Debit Card. 
Earn real cash in the app with B9 Play & Earn. 
*MEMBERSHIP PLANS 
Basic — $9.99 
• Fast cash advances up to $250 per pay period [1] 
• Withdraw anytime, including Cash App and Venmo transfers 
• Up to 5% cashback with the B9 Visa® Debit Card 
• Send money instantly 
• Earn real cash 
Basic plan provides access to B9’s full suite of financial tools and services. Membership auto-renews monthly but can be canceled anytime in the app or by contacting support. 
Premium — $19.99/month or as little as $6.99 (if paid yearly) 
• Fast cash advance up to $1,000 per pay period [1] 
• Immediate access to advance funds 
• Up to 5% cashback with the B9 Visa® Debit Card 
• Credit monitoring tools 
• Send money instantly 
• B9 Play & Earn real cash 
• Priority customer support 
All Premium plans provide access to B9’s full suite of financial tools and services. Membership auto-renews monthly but can be canceled anytime in the app or by contacting support. 
IMPORTANT NOTES 
• B9 membership is required to request cash advances 
• Advances are not loans, not payday loans, and not personal loans 
• No credit checks 
• No interest 
• No late fees 
• Instant transfer fees are optional and not included in the membership price 
COMPANY INFORMATION 
B9 launched in 2021 with a mission to help Americans achieve financial stability by bridging cash gaps. B9 is not affiliated with Credit Karma, Brigit, Earnin, Dave, Cleo, Beem, Chime, MoneyLion, Venmo, Cash App, or similar services.

GIVE Yoga in Columbus, Ohio, exist to build community around yoga, for the good of the individual and the good of the world. 
We believe that receiving more than you imagine begins with giving everything you have. GIVE Yoga is a Baptiste Yoga Affiliate Studio with a thoughtfully curated schedule. Our vibrant yoga schedule offers class opportunities such as Power Vinyasa, Restorative, Yin, Ashtanga, Kundalini, Prenatal, Youth and Family Yoga, and Meditation, Sound Healing and so much more! With more than 100+ classes per week, multiple locations, a community of the best yoga teachers in the city on a mission to share yoga, GIVE Yoga is a place and space for all. 
And just by coming to class, you’re making a difference. Every time you practice, we donate $1 to the GIVE Yoga Fund. As an organization, we are deeply committed to making the tools of yoga and mindfulness available to all regardless of socioeconomic status or background. This fund and your support allow us to be in action in our community - sharing and giving yoga - and making an impact. We appreciate you!
Thank you for downloading the GIVE Yoga app! It's the best way to learn about our class schedule, reserve a spot for your mat in classes, book private lessons with our experienced teachers, and access exciting promotions - all while you're on the go. Ready to join the GIVE Yoga community? Learn more at https://www.giveyoga.com/ and find us on Facebook and Instagram @giveyoga. We look forward to practicing with you!

bluejetty:00036248:ios.description:
Saigon Meditation Project mobile app is a free app for everyone with library of dharma talks, and some suggested guided meditation and relaxation scripts. Most of the content is from Sayadaw U Jotika’s teaching. Please note that in order to seriously learn and practise Vipassana meditation, you need to attend formal classes with meditation masters. All the information shared in this app should be only your pure source of reference, inspiration and motivation in order for you to find your mindfulness way, the one and only one way to completely liberate your mind from suffering.
If you can regularly practise short relaxation sessions (10-20 minutes) each day, it would certainly let your mind rest in the most effective manner. That’s when your mental energy is refilled, re-charged, and renewed. You can directly experience those benefits by yourself. That would encourage you to invest more into relaxation and Vipassana meditation by attending formal meditation classes with official guidances from meditation masters. For Vipassana tradition, you can look up Theravada meditation centers nearby and see if you can find suitable retreats there to attend.
Besides those dharma talks and guided scripts, SMP app also provides meditation bells with different time intervals, as well as the reminder bells in between. It’s useful for meditators to use at home.
Hope this small app can be beneficial to everyone as well as can be the source of inspiration and motivation to all meditators. May all of peace and mindfulness stay with you.

Why buy a webcam since you already have an iPhone/iPad?
iVCam turns your iPhone/iPad into an HD webcam for Windows PC. You can also replace your old USB webcam or integrated webcam with it which has a better quality. At the same time it's also a perfect baby monitor, spy-cam, security camera and pet-cam.

- Background replacement - Blur, Bokeh, Mosaic, Green Screen and more
- Audio supported, use your smartphone as a wireless microphone for PC
- Completely replaces USB webcam or integrated webcam, compatible with most applications using webcam
- Preview video, take pictures and record video files with our Windows client software

bluejetty:00166916:ios.description:
Coin Scanner & Value Checker is a powerful mobile app — your all-in-one AI-powered coin identifier and coin values checker app — for fast, reliable coin value lookups.
What it does
Snap a photo (both sides) or upload an image — our AI coin scanner matches it against a large catalog to return the coin identification value, current coins prices and values, and key details (mintage, metal, year, mint mark). It’s an easy app to value coins whether you’re sorting finds, doing a quick coin appraisal, or managing a collection.
Identification process
1. Select or shoot: Choose from gallery or photograph the coin (obverse & reverse).
2. AI match: The app recognizes type, year, and mint, then estimates coin value.
3. Details & trends: View specifications, rarity notes, and pricing history to evaluate rare coins worth considering.
Why collectors love it
• Instant recognition: Point, scan, and identify rare coins and common issues alike — see which coins worth money.
• Pricing insights: Review up-to-date coin value ranges, including mint coins value and market comps.
• Pro tooling: Handy for coin collection valuation and quick checks (a true coin checker / coin value app).
Instant Professional Grading
Meet Grading—the ultimate tool for assessing coin condition instantly. Just snap a clear photo to receive a precise grade estimate and discover how preservation impacts its market price. It’s the easiest way to understand the exact state of your coins and maximize the value of your entire collection.
Numismat Chatbot
Ask anything about any coin — history, origin, metal, rarity, or current market value — and get instant answers from a true AI coin expert. Our smart chatbot helps you discover hidden treasures, learn fun facts, and understand what makes each coin unique.
Useful Articles
For those who are just getting acquainted with the world of numismatics, a section with useful articles has been created. The materials are designed for different levels — from beginners to professionals. The articles are updated regularly, making it a great way to expand your knowledge.
Premium Subscription
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. 
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be specified. 
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable. 
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://telegra.ph/Privacy-Policy-12-30-114
Terms and Conditions: https://telegra.ph/Terms-Of-Use-12-30-3

bluejetty:00164030:ios.description:
Loc365 offers a reliable solution for tracking the location of your loved ones. Our app ensures you can stay connected and informed about the whereabouts of your family and friends, providing peace of mind regarding their safety.
Key Features:
Location Tracking: Stay updated with map views of your loved ones' current locations.
Precise GPS Tracking: Pinpoint the exact whereabouts of family members and friends in real-time.
Location History: Review detailed past location data to see their movements.
Geofence Alerts: Set up notifications for entries and exits from designated zones.
Device Locator: Locate lost or stolen phones using another family member's registered device.
Place Notifications: Receive alerts when family members arrive at or depart from specific locations like home or school.
Privacy and Consent: Location sharing is strictly based on mutual consent to respect privacy.
How It Works:
Add your family members' phone numbers to the app.
They accept the invitation and share their location.
Track their real-time location on the map effortlessly.
Why Loc365?
Simple Setup: Add family members by phone number and start tracking immediately.
Peace of Mind: Ensure the safety of your children, elderly parents, and loved ones at all times.
Lost Phone Recovery: Effortlessly locate your lost or stolen phone using our app.
Please be aware that continuous use of location services may impact battery life.
Subscription Details:
Loc365 offers a premium subscription plan featuring unlimited location alerts, extended location history, and an ad-free experience. Choose from weekly, monthly, or yearly subscription plans. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscriptions in your account settings.
By using Loc365, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
Privacy Policy: https://map.rcosoft.com/ios/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://map.rcosoft.com/ios/terms.html

bluejetty:00119742:ios.summary: RealVNC® Viewer from RealVNC® gives you instant remote access to your Mac, Windows and Linux computers from anywhere in the world. You can view your computer's desktop, and control its mouse and keyboard as though you were sitting down in f
bluejetty:00119742:ios.description:
RealVNC® Viewer from RealVNC® gives you instant remote access to your Mac, Windows and Linux computers from anywhere in the world. You can view your computer's desktop, and control its mouse and keyboard as though you were sitting down in front of it.
Download RealVNC Connect to each computer you want to control. Then sign in to RealVNC Viewer on your device using your RealVNC account credentials. You'll see your computers automatically appear; simply tap to connect.
RealVNC Connect password-protects each computer out-of-the-box. You may need to enter the same user name and password you use to log in to your computer. All sessions are then encrypted end-to-end. 
During a session, your device's touch screen serves as a trackpad to give you precise control. Drag your finger to move the remote mouse cursor and tap anywhere to left-click (other gestures such as right-click and scroll are explained in-app). 
As the original inventors of VNC remote access technology, we're confident you'll love what RealVNC Viewer has to offer. If you're still not convinced, check out our reviews! 
===Key features=== 
- Connect with ease via our cloud service to computers running RealVNC Connect.
- Backup and sync your connections between all your devices by signing in to RealVNC Viewer on each one.
- A scrolling bar above the virtual keyboard includes advanced keys such as Command/Windows.
- Support for Bluetooth keyboards. 
===Contact===

twitter.com/RealVNC
facebook.com/realvnc 
Better still, leave us a review!

bluejetty:00030805:ios.description:
聖經研讀本 - Best bible for China
--------------------------------
* 免費版，可硏讀四福音書，亦可選購升級至研讀全本聖經以及所有聖經研讀工具功能
* 支援繁,簡中文使用者介面; Universal app(可同時安裝在iPhone以及iPad); 直向以及橫向顯示;所有資料庫已附上,不需要internet連接. 
＊ 聖經採用新譯本, 並有和合本，及英文 KJV
* 目前市面上的聖經App,僅能有主視窗閱讀聖經,注釋,或字典.不能同時閱讀聖經與這些參考資料.本app提供了相當獨特的功能,可以同時打開每一個聖經,個人筆記,注釋,以及字典視窗,這些視窗是獨立的,浮動的,可移動的,並可放大或縮小.讓你可以同時對照閱讀經文及這些參考資料. 
* 目前市面上唯一app可打開至多4個聖經視窗（別的App只能打開至多2個） - 每個聖經視窗可以調整視窗大小和指定聖經文本。此外，你可以指定某一聖經視窗為“多本聖經文本並行顯示“。這些功能允許在同一屏幕上查看所有的聖經譯本,而無需來回翻轉。加上上面所提的“浮動”的注釋，字典，個人筆記和聖經搜索彈出視窗，等於你可以在同一屏幕上查看所有的研經內容. 
* 另一有別於其他聖經App的功能,所有資料是以SQL數據庫儲存,搜索經文或你的個人筆記中的任何字串.可設定舊約,新約,整本聖經,或限定那些經卷,也可以使用“AND“或“OR”來縮小搜索範圍。效率, 功能強大的SQL數據庫查詢, 能在幾秒鐘內搜尋到你要找的經文.而且搜索結果可顯示所有包含該字串的經文以及該字串出現在各書卷的頻率.目前市面上大部分的聖經軟件,只能一頁一頁的查詢,無法一次及一目瞭然地顯示所有的查詢結果. 
* 超強的筆記編輯功能: 目前市面上唯一支援“豐富文字編輯功能”以及可插入任何研經內容或web Link. “豐富文字編輯功能” ，包括“粗體” ， “斜體” ， “劃底線” ， “刪除線” ， “字體顏色/加亮/大小” ， “有序或無序列表”等，此外，你可以貼上“註記”link，可以快速連接任何研經內容到您的筆記。此外，您可以複製網頁鏈接然後貼上到您的筆記。
* “註記”筆記: 不像聖經筆記必須與經文連結，“註記”筆記可以作為以“專題”方式表達的筆記。 “註記”筆記也擁有如上述的豐富文字編輯功能。
* 同一視窗可選擇顯示多至四本聖經文本,輕輕一按切換聖經圖標,即可輕鬆地切換到不同的聖經文本 
* 除了可透過Navigation Bar上的切換聖經圖標,輕輕一按即可輕鬆地切換到不同的主要聖經文本,另外增加一浮動聖經視窗,可以總是有不同聖經文本經文可閱讀及比較. 
* 註釋: 包含 新譯本研讀版聖經註釋(數萬條中文註釋，西敏宣言,大小問答,多特法典,比利時宣言,海德堡問答，八十多篇"神學專文"，經文用新譯本，附書卷導論,簡介，百多幅圖表，請注意:因版權,不能用於"搜尋注釋") 以及 MHCC(Matthew Henry's Concise Commentar).如同"個人筆記",若該節經文帶有注釋,該注釋圖標會顯示在該節經文旁邊.此注釋視窗是浮動的,半透明和可移動的,這樣可以同時閱讀聖經經文和個人筆記以及注釋. 
* 研讀工具: 
--- 經文合參:在同一視窗顯示所有不同經文版本,以便對照比較. 
--- 搜尋字典:包含 Easton, Nave 以及 “西敏宣言”,“大小問答”,“多特法典”,“比利時宣言”,“海德堡問答”，八十多篇"神學專文". 可任意搜尋整個或部分關鍵字詞. 
--- Strong Number原文字典(包含英文及繁,簡中文)查詢:包含舊約希伯來文/新約希臘文原文定義,並列出參考到該原文的經文. 
--- 聖經加註Strong Number查詢:包含KJV以及和合本(繁,簡)加註Strong Number.浮動, 半透明和可移動的視窗, 顯示該Strong Number的定義,並列出參考到該原文的經文. 
--- 聖經地圖史畫: 新譯本圖表， 新譯本研讀版圖表
--- 讀經計畫: 可以按照個人讀經進度來建立在多少週/月/年之內來研讀多少聖經書卷的每日讀經計畫.內附四個讀經計畫以供參考. 
* 所有以上功能均可複製或email出去

* 除了可透過Navigation Bar上的切換聖經圖標,輕輕一按即可輕鬆地切換到不同的主要聖經文本,另外增加一浮動聖經視窗,可以總是有不同聖經文本經文可閱讀及比較. 

* 註釋: 包含 新譯本研讀版聖經註釋(數萬條中文註釋，西敏宣言,大小問答,多特法典,比利時宣言,海德堡問答，八十多篇"神學專文"，經文用新譯本，附書卷導論,簡介，百多幅圖表，請注意:因版權,不能用於"搜尋注釋") 以及 MHCC(Matthew Henry's Concise Commentar).如同"個人筆記",若該節經文帶有注釋,該注釋圖標會顯示在該節經文旁邊.此注釋視窗是浮動的,半透明和可移動的,這樣可以同時閱讀聖經經文和個人筆記以及注釋. 

* 研讀工具: 
--- 經文合參:在同一視窗顯示所有不同經文版本,以便對照比較. 

--- 搜尋字典:包含 Easton, Nave 以及 “西敏宣言”,“大小問答”,“多特法典”,“比利時宣言”,“海德堡問答”，八十多篇"神學專文". 可任意搜尋整個或部分關鍵字詞. 

--- Strong Number原文字典(包含英文及繁,簡中文)查詢:包含舊約希伯來文/新約希臘文原文定義,並列出參考到該原文的經文. 

--- 聖經加註Strong Number查詢:包含KJV以及和合本(繁,簡)加註Strong Number.浮動, 半透明和可移動的視窗, 顯示該Strong Number的定義,並列出參考到該原文的經文. 

--- 聖經地圖史畫: 新譯本圖表， 新譯本研讀版圖表

--- 讀經計畫: 可以按照個人讀經進度來建立在多少週/月/年之內來研讀多少聖經書卷的每日讀經計畫.內附四個讀經計畫以供參考. 
* 所有以上功能均可複製或email出去

bluejetty:00145602:ios.description:
The Oxygen Advantage® app is designed to be your virtual breathing instructor.
Control your breathing with a fully customizable daily breathing plan that combines key breathing exercises, guided meditations, paced breathing, and mindfulness coaching to deliver a tailored approach to improve your physical and mental well-being.
Use the OA™ App to learn functional nasal breathing as a foundation for health & performance:
● Breathe easy, even during exercise
● Achieve deep, restful sleep
● Reduce anxiety and panic attacks
● Feel happier, healthier and stronger
● Recover faster after training
● Stop gassing out before the finish line
● Boost oxygen delivery and enhance performance
● Calm your mind for laser focus
● Push past your personal best
● Open your airways for efficient breathing
● Strengthen your breathing muscles
● Strengthen your core
● Stimulate the vagus nerve
Stay focused, energized, and calm with a variety of breathing exercises suitable for beginners and intermediate users, regardless of age, fitness or state of health. These exercises include:
● Breathing light
● Paced and slow breathing
● Diaphragm activation
● Vagus nerve stimulation
● Light and strong breath holds
● Voluntary hyperventilation
● Physical movement
● Using the OA™ breathing accessories
OA™ APP FEATURES
● Choose your challenge and measure your BOLT score to get a personalized daily breathing plan. Each day, you will receive scientifically tailored exercises based on your specific health requirements.
● Enjoy a variety of meditations and breathwork exercises with guided support from Patrick McKeown.
● Improve your breathing skills with our instructional videos. The app has a library of over 100 videos covering various topics to help you optimize your breathing.
● Follow the breathing pacer and adjust the speed to create the perfect breathing exercise for you.
● Choose the perfect sound from our music library. Guided sessions that feature impactful sounds make it easier for you to find your rhythm and relax.
● Track your progress with detailed charts and graphs and build healthy habits. With our progress tracking feature, you will find it easy to set goals, track your progress regularly and measure how much time you invested since the very beginning.
● Easily manage your daily routines. Stay on top of your day-to-day tasks with our reminders feature that lets you set multiple alarms per day. Our custom notifications will remind you to breathe correctly.
● Share accomplishments with friends through social media and encourage them to take the journey with you.
● Develop positive breathing habits early with the Buteyko Breathing Method program for kids.
With regular practice, the OA™ App will help you achieve healthier and more productive days with less stress and more focus. The app comes with a day-by-day plan of 30 minutes per day: meaning it’s perfect for people with busy schedules.
Download the Oxygen Advantage® free breathing app and discover why breathing is the foundation of health and performance.
*Disclaimer: If you have a serious medical condition, DO speak to your doctor or a certified breathing instructor before you begin using the app.

Welcome to our special restaurant! 
There are cute and lovely animals waiting for your order!
Mr. Bear was sick of making bread, so he decided to open a food restaurant.
All the animal's friends in the forest hear that Mr. Bear is opening his new food restaurant.
And now.. cute and lovely animal friends have started flocking to the restaurant!
Please help our busy Mr. Bear to run his food restaurant!

- Feeling fun of merging food to make perfect food! Look at the happy faces when our animal customers eat our food.
- Be careful with your food not to be burned! Try to make your food more flavorful.
2. Our impatient animal customers hate to wait for their food!
- Do not let our animal customers leave the restaurant empty-handed. Make sure to serve the food to our customers within a limited time.
- If our animal customers leave empty-handed, there is no earned! Please help Mr. Bear's restaurant not be ruined.

- Look at the fashionable outfits, and try to customize our animal customer's outfits!
- After changing customers' outfits, you will be excited to meet stylish customers in the restaurant. 
4.Climb to higher stages!
- More various foods and drinks will appear after reaching higher stages! 
- At every specific stage, the restaurant theme will be changed. Hurry to come see our brand-new restaurant!
In our Zoo restaurant, there are many delicious foods and things to see.
Please come to our healing merge restaurant simulation with our animal friends in the forest!

bluejetty:00200015:ios.name: Siri
bluejetty:00200015:ios.summary: Siri is the personal assistant that helps you get things done, while protecting your privacy. The new version of Siri, Siri AI, is now more conversational, so you can have rich conversations across the system. And for moments when you want
bluejetty:00200015:ios.description:
Siri is the personal assistant that helps you get things done, while protecting your privacy. The new version of Siri, Siri AI, is now more conversational, so you can have rich conversations across the system. And for moments when you want to go back to a conversation, you can turn to the new Siri app.
Your conversations, everywhere. Launch the Siri app to see an overview of your past conversations, organized by recency. The app brings conversations together from across your devices — privately synced using iCloud — so you can start on iPhone, continue on iPad, and finish on Mac or Vision Pro. You can search to find past conversations, and pin ones you revisit often so they show at the top of the app.
Find what you need. With personal context understanding, Siri can search across supported apps like Mail, Messages, Photos, Notes, Reminders, Journal, and Calendar to surface what you're looking for. And developers can add support for their apps so that Siri can search across them too.
Get answers. Siri can provide detailed, up-to-date answers on virtually any topic. And because it understands your personal context, it can answer questions like “What’s the closest beach to Tom’s house?"
Get things done. Siri can take action across your apps, like drafting an email, adding photos to a shared album, getting directions with a stop along the way, and importing a set of events to your calendar.
Siri is available across platforms, including iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro, and CarPlay.

bluejetty:00077958:ios.description:
► Hellcopter – Blast them all to hell!
Ready for some hardcore helicopter action? Rain down fiery hell on the bad guys in this fast-paced, all-action mobile shooter. Soar into battle in your hellacious helicopter and let rip on buildings full of heinous villains, blasting your way to victory with a huge arsenal of awesome guns. The sound of your whirring blades will soon inspire abject terror in the criminal underworld, so get shooting and put the fear of god into them in Hellcopter!
► Here comes a chopper…
• Whirling, swirling, swooping, shooting action—from your helicopter vantage point, you storm into the attack, circling buildings infested with vicious villains ready for you to destroy. Grab your guns and take out every one of them before they have the chance to shoot back. But watch out for hostages—they’re the ones you need to save, so shooting them will send you right back to the drawing board.
• One hell of a shot—depending on the type of gun you prefer, use trick shots to take out two, three, or even more enemies with a single well-placed bullet that you’ll get to watch in slo-mo all the way along its deadly trajectory. Or aim for the exploding objects and send multiple enemies flying in all directions. It’s your action-adventure, so you choose how to play the game. Just as long as you don’t hit the hostages…
• Who’s the boss in hell? Get through game levels and complete maps to access epic boss fights where you’ll need all your wits about you and fast fingers to make sure you take down these extra-tough, heavily-armed criminal masterminds. Send them all to hell and get extra rewards for your exploits.
• Guns galore and then some more—a huge range of different weapons will help you destroy even the toughest and most heavily-armored enemies. Build up an awesome arsenal by completing levels and earning cash for exploits, then unlock everything from simple six-shot revolvers to massively destructive RPGs and more as you progress through the game. 
• Guns are only half the fun—as well as weapons, you’ll also get a host of other goodies for progressing through the game. Unlock new heroes, new outfits, new tech, and special levels crazy levels where you take on all sorts of unusual opponents or get guns that fire everything from rainbow bombs to attack cats.
• Sounds like hell—action-movie camera angles, simple but stylish graphics, and a thumping backing track with spectacular sound effects. Love the sound of breaking glass? What about the thud of blades, the crashing explosion of propane tanks, and the strangled cries of your enemies? You’ll get all that and more in Hellcopter!
► Apocalypse any time…
Got five minutes to spare? Then unleash the hounds of hell and dive straight into Hellcopter for a blast of gun-toting action at your fingertips. Download Hellcopter now for a hell of a good time!

Soar into battle in your hellacious helicopter and let rip on buildings full of heinous villains, blasting your way to victory with a huge arsenal of awesome guns. The sound of your whirring blades will soon inspire abject terror in the criminal underworld, so get shooting and put the fear of god into them in Hellcopter!

► Here comes a chopper…

• Whirling, swirling, swooping, shooting action—from your helicopter vantage point, you storm into the attack, circling buildings infested with vicious villains ready for you to destroy. Grab your guns and take out every one of them before they have the chance to shoot back. But watch out for hostages—they’re the ones you need to save, so shooting them will send you right back to the drawing board.

• One hell of a shot—depending on the type of gun you prefer, use trick shots to take out two, three, or even more enemies with a single well-placed bullet that you’ll get to watch in slo-mo all the way along its deadly trajectory. Or aim for the exploding objects and send multiple enemies flying in all directions. It’s your action-adventure, so you choose how to play the game. Just as long as you don’t hit the hostages…

• Who’s the boss in hell? Get through game levels and complete maps to access epic boss fights where you’ll need all your wits about you and fast fingers to make sure you take down these extra-tough, heavily-armed criminal masterminds. Send them all to hell and get extra rewards for your exploits.

• Guns galore and then some more—a huge range of different weapons will help you destroy even the toughest and most heavily-armored enemies. Build up an awesome arsenal by completing levels and earning cash for exploits, then unlock everything from simple six-shot revolvers to massively destructive RPGs and more as you progress through the game. 

• Guns are only half the fun—as well as weapons, you’ll also get a host of other goodies for progressing through the game. Unlock new heroes, new outfits, new tech, and special levels crazy levels where you take on all sorts of unusual opponents or get guns that fire everything from rainbow bombs to attack cats.

• Sounds like hell—action-movie camera angles, simple but stylish graphics, and a thumping backing track with spectacular sound effects. Love the sound of breaking glass? What about the thud of blades, the crashing explosion of propane tanks, and the strangled cries of your enemies? You’ll get all that and more in Hellcopter!

► Apocalypse any time…

Got five minutes to spare? Then unleash the hounds of hell and dive straight into Hellcopter for a blast of gun-toting action at your fingertips. Download Hellcopter now for a hell of a good time!

bluejetty:00130993:ios.description:
The first and only remote assessment tool for quantitative monitoring of Multiple Sclerosis disease progression. We rely on objective data as well as patient-reported symptoms.
This free, easy-to-use mobile app is an indispensable tool for more informed care. 
By engaging with game-like activities on your mobile phone from home or anywhere you are, the app detects the slightest changes in your clinical status. Unlike other MS apps, BeCare MS Link provides validated neurologic and cognitive data that you can share with your physician. If you detect an oncoming flare, use the app to generate an updated assessment, and immediately alert your healthcare provider so you can get immediate care, even if their clinic appointment schedule is full.
An invaluable app for anyone dealing with MS, and their caregivers, which includes:
· Schedule reminders to do activities
· Follow your MS progress over time
· Available in several languages
· Comprehensive printable physician assessments
About BeCare Link
BeCare Link is a digital technology company that harnesses unique data solutions, AI, and technology platforms to supplement, augment and facilitate traditional clinical therapy.
Our mission is to transform the treatment of chronic disease through science, digital engagement, and proven outcomes.
The BeCare Link team wants to learn your story and your ideas! Share them via support@becare.net.

bluejetty:00162218:ios.description:
Doseful is designed to streamline your medication management, ensuring you never miss a dose and stay on top of your health regimen. With a user-friendly interface and a suite of powerful features, Doseful is your reliable partner in maintaining your medication schedule and achieving your health goals.
Doseful offers robust tools for tracking and managing your medications. Easily input your prescriptions, vitamins, and supplements, and let Doseful handle the rest. The app provides timely reminders and allows you to monitor your intake, ensuring you adhere to your prescribed regimen without hassle.
Stay informed about your medication habits with Doseful's detailed usage and success reports. These reports provide valuable insights into your adherence patterns, helping you understand your progress and make informed decisions about your health management.
Doseful understands the importance of discretion and personalization. Customize your notification settings to suit your preferences, and enjoy the option of silent notifications that remind you of your medication schedule without disrupting your day. 
For those crucial medications that require extra attention, Doseful offers critical notifications. These alerts ensure that you never miss a dose of your most important medications, providing peace of mind and safeguarding your health.
Start your day right with Doseful's morning notifications, reminding you to take your medications with you as you head out. This feature is perfect for busy individuals who need a gentle nudge to keep their health priorities in check.
Keep a personal record of your health journey with Doseful's diary notes feature. Jot down observations, side effects, or any other relevant information, and have it securely stored within the app for easy reference.
Your privacy is paramount. Doseful offers an app passcode feature, ensuring that your medication data and personal notes are protected from unauthorized access. Rest assured that your information remains confidential and secure.
Doseful prioritizes your privacy by storing all data locally on your device. No medication details are sent to or stored on external servers, giving you complete control over your personal health information. Enjoy peace of mind knowing that your data is safe and private.

Terms of Use: https://gentlemens.tech/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00022881:ios.description:
CANADA INCOME TAX FILING, CRA NETFILE AND REVENU QUEBEC-CERTIFIED SINCE 2011
File your tax return online easily with our eFile Canadian tax return calculator app
• Answer a few simple questions in plain English
• CRA Auto-fill My Return connects to your CRA account and updates your personal information
• Review your tax return summary before submission
• efile your income tax return to Canada Revenue Agency and/or Revenu Quebec
• Get your tax refund within 10 days
KEY FEATURES THAT MAKE FILING YOUR INCOME TAX SIMPLE, FAST, AND EASY
• Ideal for first-time tax filers
• No tax accountant needed
• File your tax in just 30 minutes
• Inbuilt help texts makes tax filing easy
• Switch seamlessly between phone, tablet, and computer
• Covers all kinds of Canadian tax returns (RRSPs, charity donations, medical expenses, etc.)
• Free to use if your income is less than $20,000
• Free customer support
• 100% satisfaction guaranteed or your money back
EXCEPTIONS: WHAT IS NOT SUPPORTED FOR INCOME TAX CALCULATIONS
If you are eligible to NETFILE with the Canada Revenue Agency, you can use FastNEasyTax.com’s app for all kinds of complex tax returns with some exceptions. 
DOES NOT SUPPORT
• Income tax returns for Northwest Territories, Yukon, and Nunavut
• Income tax returns incorporating AgriStability/AgriInvest programs (Forms T1163 and T1273)
• Income tax returns with self-employed business statements or with limited partnership, including tax shelters
• Logging tax credit
HOW IT WORKS: A STEP-BY-STEP GUIDE TO FILING YOUR INCOME TAX RETURN
• Just answer a few simple questions in plain English in the tax refund calculator
• CRA Auto-fill My Return connects to your CRA account and updates your personal information
• Review your income tax return summary before submission
• efile your income tax return to Canada Revenue Agency and/or Revenu Quebec
• Most people get their tax refund within 10 days
FREE CANADA TAX CALCULATOR: QUICKLY ESTIMATE YOUR INCOME TAX
Use our simple and quick income tax return calculator for free to find your tax refund amount if you live in Alberta (AB), British Columbia (BC), Manitoba (MB), New Brunswick (NB), Newfoundland and Labrador (NL), Nova Scotia (NS), Ontario (ON), Prince Edward Island (PEI), Quebec (QC), and Saskatchewan (SK).
You can calculate your full tax refund amount by entering all applicable income tax deduction and Canadian tax credits you might be eligible for. A CRA notice of assessment shows your RRSP contribution limit for the tax year, which is required to claim the RRSP deduction amount for the year.
App supports tax filing for students, newcomers, seniors, common-law and everyone else.

bluejetty:00100533:ios.description:
Enter the world of Slide Puzzle: Jigsaw Fun, a relaxing yet engaging puzzle game where you slide, swap, and twist pieces to complete charming jigsaw scenes. 
Experience the deeply satisfying puzzle moment when a piece fits perfectly into jigsaw after a clever slide or a strategic swap—you won't want to put it down!This puzzle game is enjoyable for everyone, especially the seniors.
Why You'll Love Slide Puzzle: Jigsaw Fun
-Satisfying Puzzle Action: Feel a wonderful sense of achievement as you solve each challenging puzzle. The core slide mechanic is simple to learn, it’s a cozy challenge for your mind.
-Slide & Swap Controls: Simply slide pieces with controls. Use the strategic swap function to exchange two jigsaw, and feel the thrill when a smart swap unlocks the entire puzzle.
-A Creative Gameplay: Feel the excitement of a fresh twist on the traditional jigsaw! The unique twist mechanic allows you to rotate pieces, slide puzzle & have fun!
-Cozy Escape: Whether you're a beginner or a puzzle master, find your rhythm in this cozy atmosphere. The charming art slide puzzle offer a perfectly cozy jigsaw experience for everyone. 
-Engaging Brain-teaser: This game is a masterful blend of a jigsaw and a slide puzzle. It's a full-brain workout disguised as pure fun! Download Slide Puzzle: Jigsaw Fun for a cozy mental retreat.
Features about Slide Puzzle: Jigsaw Fun
-Relaxing & Rewarding : Perfect for unwinding. The cozy wooden-world aesthetic and satisfying slide puzzle action make for a truly calming yet engaging puzzle experience.
-Smart & Strategic: Think ahead! Every slide and swap matters. Plan your moves to solve the jigsaw efficiently. The added twist mechanic demands creative thinking for every slide puzzle.
-Tons of Puzzle Content: From adorable animals to serene landscapes, we add HD-jigsaw packs, offer many slide and swap puzzle challenges.
-Designed for All Devices: Enjoy smooth performance and cozy games. Every HD-jigsaw image is crafted to look crisp and beautiful on both phones and tablets.
-HD Pictures: Immerse yourself in stunning, HD-jigsaw pictures and the pictures will move after you complete the slide puzzle! What an amazing gaming experience!
-Eye-friendly: Enjoy this slide puzzle and relaxing experience with our swap puzzle games. Eye-friendly design, especially for seniors, with large puzzle pieces and simple slide puzzle gameplay.
How to Play Slide Puzzle: Jigsaw Fun
Slide to Move: Drag and slide jigsaw pieces across the board to find their home.
Swap for Strategy: Can't slide a piece? Use the swap function to exchange the positions of two jigsaw pieces. Use strategy and solve puzzle!
Twist to Fit: Sometimes the right jigsaw piece is in the right place, but needs a twist! Rotate pieces to make them snap into place.
Complete the Jigsaw: Use all your skills—slide, swap, and twist—to complete the beautiful image and earn beautiful HD-jigsaw! Let's play Slide Puzzle: Jigsaw Fun now!
Whether you're a jigsaw enthusiast, a slide puzzle lover, or simply seeking a relax, cozy, and zen puzzle game - Slide Puzzle: Jigsaw Fun is your next obsession!

bluejetty:00083925:ios.description:
Lost data doesn’t always mean it’s gone forever.
Tiger Data Recovery is a powerful iOS data recovery, backup, transfer, and device management solution—the perfect companion to our award-winning desktop application. Recover accidentally deleted data from your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch in just three simple steps.
Tiger Data Recovery supports a wide range of iOS devices and data types, including messages, photos, videos, audio files, contacts, documents, passwords, and chat data from WhatsApp, WeChat, LINE, Kik, KakaoTalk, and Viber.
KEY FEATURES
• iOS Data Recovery
Recover deleted messages, photos, videos, audio files, contacts, call history, documents, and supported social app data from your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch.
• Recovery for Common iOS Issues
Retrieve your data when your device is stuck on the Apple logo, displays a black screen, repeatedly restarts, or encounters other startup problems.
• Chat History Export
Export chat records to PDF or Excel for easier viewing, organization, and archiving. You can also edit message content and timestamps before creating your export.
• PDF Unlock
Quickly unlock supported password-protected PDF documents with fast decryption and a simple workflow.
• AI Old Photo Restoration
Bring treasured memories back to life. AI-powered restoration helps repair aged, faded, scratched, or damaged photographs.
• AI Photo Enhancer
Turn blurry or low-quality photos into clearer, sharper images with intelligent AI enhancement.
• Long Screenshots
Capture and combine scrolling content into one seamless long screenshot—ideal for conversations, webpages, documents, and more.
• Live Photo Converter
Convert Live Photos into GIFs or standard video files for easier sharing, editing, and storage.
• Smart Clean
Our AI-powered cleaning tool identifies duplicate and similar photos, blurry images, duplicate videos, and unnecessary files, helping you reclaim valuable storage space while preserving important memories.
• Contact Backup and Restore
Back up contacts as vCard (VCF) or CSV files for Gmail and Excel. Restore supported contact backups to your iPhone or iPad whenever needed.
• Photo and Video Management
Import, export, organize, and manage photos and videos on your iPhone with ease.
• Easy File Transfer
Transfer files between your iPhone or iPad and a Windows PC or Mac while the devices are connected.
• Flexible Data Backup
Back up your entire device or select specific data, including photos, videos, messages, contacts, and supported social app conversations such as WhatsApp, LINE, and WeChat.
• WhatsApp Transfer, Backup, and Restore
Transfer supported WhatsApp data between iOS devices, create backups on your computer, and restore your conversations whenever needed.
• Bluetooth Device Finder
Locate nearby Bluetooth devices, including wireless earbuds and headphones, using signal-strength guidance.
• Password Recovery
Recover, view, and export supported saved credentials, including mail accounts, website and app logins, Apple ID information, and Wi-Fi accounts stored on your device or in supported backups.
• Backup Compatibility
Works with supported encrypted iTunes backups and iCloud backups, including accounts protected by two-factor authentication.
• No Ads
Enjoy a clean, distraction-free experience with no advertisements.
Whether you need to recover deleted data, back up important files, restore old photos, enhance blurry images, export conversations, manage storage, or locate your wireless earbuds, Tiger Data Recovery puts essential iOS utilities in one convenient app.
• Subscription Information
This app offers an auto-renewing subscription. You can manage or cancel it at any time in your Apple ID account settings.

Lost data doesn’t always mean it’s gone forever.

Tiger Data Recovery is a powerful iOS data recovery, backup, transfer, and device management solution—the perfect companion to our award-winning desktop application. Recover accidentally deleted data from your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch in just three simple steps.

Tiger Data Recovery supports a wide range of iOS devices and data types, including messages, photos, videos, audio files, contacts, documents, passwords, and chat data from WhatsApp, WeChat, LINE, Kik, KakaoTalk, and Viber.

KEY FEATURES

• iOS Data Recovery
Recover deleted messages, photos, videos, audio files, contacts, call history, documents, and supported social app data from your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch.

• Recovery for Common iOS Issues
Retrieve your data when your device is stuck on the Apple logo, displays a black screen, repeatedly restarts, or encounters other startup problems.

• Chat History Export
Export chat records to PDF or Excel for easier viewing, organization, and archiving. You can also edit message content and timestamps before creating your export.

• PDF Unlock
Quickly unlock supported password-protected PDF documents with fast decryption and a simple workflow.

• AI Old Photo Restoration
Bring treasured memories back to life. AI-powered restoration helps repair aged, faded, scratched, or damaged photographs.

• AI Photo Enhancer
Turn blurry or low-quality photos into clearer, sharper images with intelligent AI enhancement.

• Long Screenshots
Capture and combine scrolling content into one seamless long screenshot—ideal for conversations, webpages, documents, and more.

• Live Photo Converter
Convert Live Photos into GIFs or standard video files for easier sharing, editing, and storage.

• Smart Clean
Our AI-powered cleaning tool identifies duplicate and similar photos, blurry images, duplicate videos, and unnecessary files, helping you reclaim valuable storage space while preserving important memories.

• Contact Backup and Restore
Back up contacts as vCard (VCF) or CSV files for Gmail and Excel. Restore supported contact backups to your iPhone or iPad whenever needed.

• Photo and Video Management
Import, export, organize, and manage photos and videos on your iPhone with ease.

• Easy File Transfer
Transfer files between your iPhone or iPad and a Windows PC or Mac while the devices are connected.

• Flexible Data Backup
Back up your entire device or select specific data, including photos, videos, messages, contacts, and supported social app conversations such as WhatsApp, LINE, and WeChat.

• WhatsApp Transfer, Backup, and Restore
Transfer supported WhatsApp data between iOS devices, create backups on your computer, and restore your conversations whenever needed.

• Bluetooth Device Finder
Locate nearby Bluetooth devices, including wireless earbuds and headphones, using signal-strength guidance.

• Password Recovery
Recover, view, and export supported saved credentials, including mail accounts, website and app logins, Apple ID information, and Wi-Fi accounts stored on your device or in supported backups.

• Backup Compatibility
Works with supported encrypted iTunes backups and iCloud backups, including accounts protected by two-factor authentication.

• No Ads
Enjoy a clean, distraction-free experience with no advertisements.

Whether you need to recover deleted data, back up important files, restore old photos, enhance blurry images, export conversations, manage storage, or locate your wireless earbuds, Tiger Data Recovery puts essential iOS utilities in one convenient app.

• Subscription Information
This app offers an auto-renewing subscription. You can manage or cancel it at any time in your Apple ID account settings.

https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Privacy Policy:
https://www.tigerdr.com/about/privacy

Customer Support:
customer_service@tigerdr.com

bluejetty:00172090:ios.description:
The Daily Grace Co. app is designed to equip women to know and love God's Word. Created to help you cultivate your daily walk with God through intentional Scripture study and encouraging community, our app combines the beauty of theologically rich Bible studies with intuitive tools for your quiet time rhythm.
Whether you are diving into your digital study, listening to an encouraging podcast, or looking back at your personal study growth, everything you need is thoughtfully arranged in one peaceful space.
Key Features:
Your Digital Bible Study Library: Access your digital studies in a clean, beautiful reader. Visual progress indicators help you seamlessly pick up right where you left off.
Seamless Notes & Highlights: Highlight key passages, record study notes, and bookmark across both your digital studies and the Bible.
The Daily Grace Podcast & Blog: Stream podcast episodes seamlessly while you are on the app, and enjoy instant access to daily articles on an assortment of topics including theology, prayer, Christian living, and so much more.
Personal Quiet Time Tracking: Keep track of all your active studies, view your app activity on your profile, and celebrate your consistency in Scripture over time.
Encouraging Community : Connect with a global community of women. Share prayer requests, swap study insights, and encourage one another along the way!

bluejetty:00116071:ios.description:
Moto Wheelie Dirt Bike Racing is a skill-based motorcycle racing game designed for players who love balance, timing, and precision riding.
Ride powerful dirt bikes and test your control by performing smooth wheelies across challenging off-road tracks. Each level pushes your riding skills further with different terrains, slopes, and obstacles that demand focus and control.

• Realistic dirt bike physics
• Smooth and responsive controls
• Challenging wheelie-focused gameplay
• Multiple off-road racing tracks
• Progressive difficulty for skill improvement
• Optimized performance for iOS devices
Moto Wheelie Dirt Bike Racing is perfect for players who enjoy stunt riding, off-road bike racing, and physics-based challenges. Jump in, ride smart, and master the wheelie.

bluejetty:00024394:ios.summary: Coloring book for kids and babies aged 2, 3, 4 years and older. Kid games not only entertains the child, but also help them with growing and education. Especially if game is coloring book. Coloring apps are suitable for both girls and boys.
bluejetty:00024394:ios.description:
Coloring book for kids and babies aged 2, 3, 4 years and older. Kid games not only entertains the child, but also help them with growing and education. Especially if game is coloring book. Coloring apps are suitable for both girls and boys. By drawing and coloring pages your child not only develops fine motor skills and wrist, which affects the intellection, but also learns this world getting acquainted with the shapes of various objects. In our kids coloring book you will find 130+ pictures.
All coloring pages are separated into 8 categories:
- Pets
- Wild animals
- Transport (service cars, vehicles, planes)
- Dinosaurs
- Undersea
- People(professions, princesses)
- Creatures (halloween, aliens, robots)
- Food
For convenience, the coloring book is made in such a way that the child will not be able to go beyond the boundaries of the contour, which he began to paint.
Various drawing tools, such as a marker, pencil, magic brush and others will reveal the artistic potential of your kid.
Texture painting will make your painting process trully exciting. With this tool, your child can easily draw clouds, stars, grass and other elements.
Our coloring game opens the world of visual arts for kids of all ages.

bluejetty:00140735:ios.name: UK ETA
bluejetty:00140735:ios.summary:
Use the UK ETA app to apply for an electronic travel authorisation (ETA) to come to the UK.
Who can apply
Find out if you need an ETA to travel to the UK at: https://www.gov.uk/electronic-travel-authorisation. 
How to apply on the UK ETA
bluejetty:00140735:ios.description:
Use the UK ETA app to apply for an electronic travel authorisation (ETA) to come to the UK.
Who can apply
Find out if you need an ETA to travel to the UK at: https://www.gov.uk/electronic-travel-authorisation. 
How to apply on the UK ETA app
1. Take a photo of your passport.
2. Scan the chip in your passport.
3. Scan your face.
4. Take a photo of yourself.
5. Answer some questions about yourself.
6. Pay for your application.
It should only take 10 minutes to apply.
You do not need to enter your travel details.
Before you start
To apply you will need:
• an iPhone 8 or newer with IOS 16 or later
• the passport you will use to travel to the UK
• a credit card, debit card or Apple Pay
• access to your emails
If you're applying for someone else they must be with you. If they are not, you should apply online at: https://www.gov.uk/electronic-travel-authorisation.
After you apply
You’ll get a decision by email from UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI), usually within a day. Allow up to 3 working days (Monday to Friday) to get a decision, but it may arrive much sooner.
The email will contain your 16 digit ETA reference number.
You must wait until you get an email confirming you have an ETA before you travel to the UK.
If you have not received a decision after 3 working days, check your spam or junk email folder before contacting UKVI.
You may get decisions at different times to other people you applied for.
Your ETA will be linked to the passport you applied with. You only need to show your passport when you travel to the UK.
Privacy and security
The app is safe and secure. No information is stored on the app or your phone after you close it. You can delete the app after you have completed your application.
For information on staying safe online visit the UK Cyber Aware website: https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/cyberaware/home
Accessibility
You can read our accessibility statement at: https://confirm-your-identity.homeoffice.gov.uk/register/eta-app-accessibility

bluejetty:00166877:ios.description:
Lower your handicap, fix your swing, and train like a pro with Performance Golf - the leading golf improvement coaching and training app built for players of all skill levels. 
PG1 delivers our most personalized golf improvement experience yet. With smarter AI swing analysis, guided practice, personalized drills, refreshed training content, and easier GPS score tracking, PG1 helps you understand what to work on next and improve with purpose. 
Whether you struggle with consistency, distance, or accuracy, Performance Golf gives you a step-by-step system to improve your swing, sharpen your short game, and lower your scores. The Strategic Improvement System combines personalized coaching, targeted training, and AI-powered swing analysis to identify the root flaw of your biggest issues and recommend the right next steps. 
A SMARTER, MORE PERSONALIZED PATH TO BETTER GOLF 
- NEW & IMPROVED SWING SCAN AI: Get instant 3D swing analysis that identifies the root cause of your swing issues and delivers personalized guidance to help you improve faster. 
- SMART PATH: Follow a personalized journey with coaching, drills, lessons, and recommendations based on your goals and progress, delivered at the right time. 
- UPDATED TRAINING EXPERIENCE: Explore 100+ training programs, lessons, tips, and training content from some of the world’s best golf coaches in a refreshed training hub. 
- PERSONALIZED SWING REVIEWS: Get personalized swing reviews and feedback from certified PGA instructors. 
- GPS SCORE TRACKING: Track scores faster, gain performance insights, and measure progress across every part of your game, including practice, coaching, and on-course performance. 
WHY ATHLETES TRUST PERFORMANCE GOLF COACHING
- STRATEGIC IMPROVEMENT SYSTEMS that helps you improve every area of your game and shave 5+ strokes off your handicap in 30 days 
- ACCELERATOR TRAINING gives you the most effective drills and lessons, hand-picked by top coaches and organized in the order you would learn them on the range
- SKILL CHALLENGES let you test and apply each technique in real on-course situations for maximum impact on your game
- SWING SCAN AII uses your smartphone camera and 3D motion-capture to analyze 17 swing data points, pinpoint flaws, and provide drills to fix them
- GOLF MASTERCLASSES & TRAINING LIBRARY giving you instant access to learn from world-class instructors anytime, anywhere. 
- COMMUNITY CLUBHOUSE connects you with golfers for motivation, learning, and accountability. 
UNLOCK THE NEW PG1 PREMIUM EXPERIENCE
- 1-ON-1 COACHING: Work with certified golf instructors who review your swing, create training plans, and guide your improvement. 
- UNLIMITED ACCESS: Explore an expanding library of lessons, masterclasses, and drills. 
- PG1 MEMBERSHIP: Join a community of dedicated golfers for learning, challenges, and accountability. 
HERE’S HOW IT WORKS! 
1. Answer a few questions about your game so our coaches can understand your goals
2. Choose to get your swing reviewed for personalized feedback from a pro—this is the fastest and most effective way to improve
3. Select a specific area of your game to improve and follow the personalized plan
Forbes magazine claims we are "flattening the instructional curve in golf" and INC named us the fastest-growing online golf instruction company in the world.
SUPPORT
Don’t see your course in our database, have a question, or want to share feedback? Email support@performancegolf.com.
PAYMENT INFORMATION
All subscriptions automatically renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the selected subscription period. For more information, review the Performance Golf Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
TERMS OF SERVICE

Download today and experience America's greatest battle as you've never seen it before!

bluejetty:00040844:ios.description:
A Calm, Mindful Approach To Pilates & A Healthy Lifestyle
The Pilates By Kerstin method is designed for longevity, meaning it will teach you how to have a fitness routine that lasts a lifetime and makes you love working out. This program will transform your body with low-impact workouts you look forward to, and create a healthy relationship with exercise, food, and your body. With Kerstin’s method, you will be stronger within 4 weeks, will have longer leaner muscles within 8 weeks, and see an overall change in your body within 12 weeks. 
The workouts - Pilates by Kerstin workouts combine the classical style of pilates with Kerstin’s own signature movements, designed to give you a well-rounded workout every time. Her low-impact, at-home workouts incorporate intentional & controlled movements for a strong, toned, and sculpted body. Start with her 30-Day Signature Program and begin to develop a balanced movement routine that can last you a lifetime. 
Nutrition - Kerstin believes in creating a healthy relationship with food and your body. Pilates By Kerstin offers healthy recipes that encourage mindful, intuitive eating. You will not feel deprived or restricted from your favorite foods, but will have healthy options to choose from that are easy to make at home, and will seamlessly blend into your routine. 
Stretch + Restore - Pilates By Kerstin includes yoga routines, stretch videos, and calming sound bowl meditations to enjoy pre/post workout or on your days off.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Pilates by Kerstin on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://pilatesbykerstin.vhx.tv/tos
Privacy Policy: https://pilatesbykerstin.vhx.tv/privacy

Embark on your learning journey with BrainDeck—your intelligent study partner powered by AI. Whether you're a high school student, a university scholar, or a lifelong learner, our app is designed to help you study smarter, remember longer, and perform better.
Study Smarter, Not Harder
With BrainDeck, dive into an efficient study experience using custom flashcards tailored to your learning needs. Create flashcards quickly with our AI-powered tools, and watch as BrainDeck adapts to your learning pace, ensuring you focus on areas that need attention.
Learn with Precision
Plan and schedule your study sessions with BrainDeck's smart scheduling feature, ensuring you keep up with your learning without feeling overwhelmed. Set reminders for each deck and stay on track with your educational goals. Whether you’re preparing for an exam or just brushing up on a subject, BrainDeck helps you manage your time effectively.
Build Knowledge
Education is about growth. BrainDeck not only offers a personalized study experience but also helps you track your progress with detailed insights into your learning patterns. Join a community of motivated learners, and take your knowledge to the next level.
Create and Personalise
Make your study decks uniquely yours with customisable front covers. Choose from a variety of symbols and colors to personalize the look of your flashcards and make studying a more enjoyable experience. While BrainDeck keeps your sessions organized, you bring your personal style to every learning session.
Get ready to elevate your study habits with BrainDeck and transform how you learn and remember. It’s not just about studying—it’s about excelling.
