bluejetty:00089412:ios.name: Meowtel: In-Home Cat Sitting
bluejetty:00089412:ios.summary:
Find a loving and patient cat sitter with Meowtel.
Meowtel is the only cat-sitting app built just for cats. We connect cat parents with independent, background-checked sitters offering in-home cat care - all supported by the Meowtel Promis
bluejetty:00089412:ios.description:
Find a loving and patient cat sitter with Meowtel.
Meowtel is the only cat-sitting app built just for cats. We connect cat parents with independent, background-checked sitters offering in-home cat care - all supported by the Meowtel Promise, which means responsive, world-class customer support whenever you need help.
Whether you’re traveling or just out for the day, Meowtel is designed to make cat care feel easier, more personal, and less stressful - for both you and your cat.
Why Choose Meowtel?
- Cat Care, Designed for Cats: We exist to serve all kitties - including kittens, seniors, and even special needs cats who may need medications or diabetic monitoring. Cat sitters on Meowtel offer purr-sonalized care to suit your cat’s individual needs. Services can include feeding, refreshing water, litter box maintenance, medication administration (if required), and lots of cuddles, playtime, and company!
- Trusted Sitters, Real Reviews: Each sitter on Meowtel is required to complete a background check and you can read real reviews from other cat parents on each sitter’s listing. The cat sitter you reserve may offer a free Meet & Greet to ensure it’s a purr-fect fit before you travel!
- Stay Updated: Enjoy peace of mind - your sitter may offer text updates, photos, and videos, keeping you connected to your cat’s activities and well-being.
- World-Class Support You Can Count On: Meowtel’s Bellhop Support team is known for being responsive and deeply compassionate. From booking questions to last-minute changes, our support team is here to assist as part of the Meowtel Promise.
Booking a Reservation is Easy:
- Choose a sitter who matches your cat’s specific needs and enjoy a seamless experience. You can choose from drop-in visits lasting 20-, 45-, or 60-minutes as well as overnight stays - where your sitter will stay the night in your home with your kitties. 
- Once your request is confirmed, you may coordinate a Meet & Greet with your sitter to review care instructions, home logistics, and confirm it’s a purr-fect match.
- If it’s not the right fit, reach out to our Bellhop Support for easy assistance with rebooking a new sitter.
Become a Cat Sitter on Meowtel:
Love cats and want to connect with cat parents in your area? Joining Meowtel is a simple way to showcase your experience and offer care on your own terms. Getting started begins with creating your sitter listing and completing a third-party background check as part of the onboarding process.
Sitters on Meowtel are independent service providers who run their own businesses. You choose your rates, availability, and the services you'd like to offer. Once your listing is active, you can continue to build trust with cat parents by adding photos, testimonials, and personal details that highlight your approach to cat care!
Your cats deserve the best. Download Meowtel today to meet your next compassionate care provider who truly understands cats!

bluejetty:00031859:ios.description:
DayPass™ – Your Country Club, Everywhere
Experience refined leisure on your own terms with the DayPass App, your access point to select hotel pools, all-inclusive resorts, distinguished beach clubs, elevated fitness centers, and serene spa environments.
With the DayPass App, any day can become a premium escape.
Top Destinations at Your Fingertips
Americas & Caribbean
Orlando, Cancún, Cabo San Lucas, Punta Cana, Costa Rica, Saint Lucia, Martinique, Guadeloupe, The Bahamas, St. Maarten.
Europe, Middle East & Africa
Sicily, Marbella, Mallorca, Ibiza, Marrakesh, Albufeira, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, Doha, Canary Islands, Bodrum.
Asia Pacific
Singapore, Bangkok, Phuket, Koh Samui, Bali, and additional sought-after destinations.
Effortless Process
Discover - Search your destination or explore curated suggestions.
Explore - View participating venues with real-time availability.
Book - Reserve seamlessly with Apple Pay or Card.
Receive - Get instant confirmation through the app.
Manage - Reschedule, Cancel
Relax – Enjoy your selected venue and make the most of your day.
About the DayPass App.
Whether you want to unwind by a quiet pool, enjoy a beachfront retreat, immerse in a wellness escape, or stay active at a premium fitness center, the DayPass App connects you to elevated amenities for the day.
For cruise travelers, nearby guests, or explorers looking to enhance their downtime, the DayPass App provides access to all-inclusive resorts and refined leisure spaces through a simple, flexible platform.
Connect
Facebook: https://facebook.com/daypassapp
Instagram: https://instagram.com/daypassapp
Twitter: https://twitter.com/daypassapp
Support and Feedback
Your feedback is valued. For questions, visit our FAQ at http://daypassapp.com/faq or contact a Concierge directly through the app.
Here’s to discovering meaningful, memorable leisure moments.
The DayPass Team

Experience, conception, pregnancy and motherhood with your personalized AI health companion. Baby2Body offers smart, trimester-specific guidance for fitness, nutrition, and mental wellness. Track your pregnancy, access safe workouts, and get expert advice tailored just for you.

• AI-Powered Pregnancy Tracker: Stay informed about your baby's development week by week with our smart pregnancy tracker.
• Personalized Prenatal Fitness: Access safe, trimester-specific workout plans designed by experts and customized for your fitness level.
• Customized Nutrition Guide: Receive daily meal plans and recipes optimized for your pregnancy stage and dietary preferences.
• Mental Wellness Support: Enjoy guided meditations and mindfulness exercises to reduce stress and prepare for motherhood.
## Smart Postpartum Recovery
• Fourth Trimester Care: Get personalized guidance for your postpartum recovery, including gentle exercises and self-care tips.
• Breastfeeding Support: Access expert advice and tracking tools to support your breastfeeding journey.
• Baby Development Tracker: Monitor your baby's growth milestones with our intelligent development tracker.
## Advanced AI Features
• Symptom Checker: Input your symptoms and receive instant, AI-powered insights and recommendations.
• Daily Health Tips: Get personalized daily tips based on your pregnancy stage and health profile.

## Expert-Backed Content
• Evidence-Based Information: All content is created and verified by maternal health experts, ensuring you receive accurate, up-to-date guidance.
• Video Library: Access a vast collection of instructional videos for workouts, nutrition, and wellness techniques.

Virtual Health Assistant: Chat with our AI assistant for immediate answers to your pregnancy and postpartum questions, ask Bella anything, anytime.

• Unlimited access to all features- personalised weekly fitness, nutrition and wellbeing plan for every stage of your journey • Exclusive deals with our partners 
• Advanced tracking tools and personalized experience 
Download Baby2Body now and embark on a healthier pregnancy and post partum journey. Our AI-powered app adapts to your changing needs, providing personalized support from conception to postpartum and beyond.

bluejetty:00141609:ios.name: Photone - Grow Light Meter
bluejetty:00141609:ios.summary: Turn your iPhone or iPad into a PAR meter. Measure PPFD, DLI, lux, foot-candles, and color temperature (kelvin) to give your plants exactly the light they need. Trusted by millions of growers, Photone is the only accurate plant light meter
bluejetty:00141609:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a PAR meter. Measure PPFD, DLI, lux, foot-candles, and color temperature (kelvin) to give your plants exactly the light they need. Trusted by millions of growers, Photone is the only accurate plant light meter app.
How much light do your plants really get? Are your lamps hung too high, dimmed too low, or on for too long? Whether you grow houseplants or use a grow tent, greenhouse, hydroponics system, or aquarium, Photone answers these questions and more.
Photone is more than just a PAR meter: it gives you the tools and guidance to understand the numbers.
MEASUREMENTS
⎷ Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) as PPFD in µmol/m²/s
⎷ Daily Light Integral (DLI) in mol/m²/d
⎷ Illuminance in lux or foot-candles
⎷ Correlated color temperature (CCT) in kelvin *
⎷ Extended PAR (ePAR) including far-red light (ePPFD, eDLI) *
FEATURES
⎷ Industry-leading accuracy
⎷ Heatmaps — Create PAR maps, PPFD maps, DLI maps, lux maps, and export them as images
⎷ Logging — Track measurements over time as an interactive chart, Auto-Log sessions, and export or import them
⎷ Projected DLI — Get the daily light your plants receive instantly by entering how long your lamps are on ← perfect for grow lights
⎷ Actual DLI — Leave your device in place and use Auto-Log to sum up the light throughout the day ← perfect when measuring sunlight
⎷ In-app guides
⎷ Light calculators and recommendations
⎷ Excellent low light sensitivity to detect light pollution for plants
⎷ Custom calibration option to align readings to another meter
⎷ No Bluetooth and location permission required
⎷ No ads
⎷ All grow light sources supported (Natural sunlight, LEDs, HPS, MH, etc.) *
⎷ Photone for Apple Watch — monitor live readings from your wrist *
⎷ Average and peak readings *
⎷ Hands-free "read aloud" function *
⎷ Special underwater measurement mode *
⎷ Pro support by real human experts *
* These features require an in-app purchase to fully unlock
HOW ACCURATE IS PHOTONE?
Photone matches the accuracy of professional handheld PAR quantum sensors costing hundreds of dollars. Here's how:
⎷ RAW sensor data — capture true light intensity using the camera, the most precise sensor in your device
⎷ Pre-calibrated per device model
⎷ Developed according to the ISO/CIE 19476 standard for light measurement
⎷ Continuously tested — we regularly calibrate and test on new devices
DIFFUSER REQUIRED
Like every real light meter, Photone requires a diffuser to measure accurately. A diffuser scatters incoming light evenly on the sensor and prevents hotspots. While it may sound complex, the solution is surprisingly easy. You have two options:
1) Easily build a diffuser yourself in less than a minute using standard printer paper. This is accurate enough for most use cases.
2) Get the dedicated Diffuser Accessory (free worldwide shipping) for best accuracy and convenience. More details on https://lightray.io/diffuser/
(!) Do not rely on apps that do not require a diffuser. They are inaccurate because they ignore the basic physics of light measurement.
UPGRADE OPTIONS
Photone is free to download and use, with no ads or hidden costs. To unleash its full potential, it offers two types of upgrades:
→ Lifetime unlocks — one-time purchase, always restorable via your Apple Account
→ Pro subscription — full access for as long as you subscribe, cancel anytime
Photone took 7+ years of R&D to develop. Upgrading unlocks powerful features and keeps the app ad-free for everyone. As a member of 1% for the Planet, we donate at least 1% of all revenue to environmental non-profits — so every purchase helps both your plants and the planet.
Terms and Conditions: https://growlightmeter.com/terms/

⎷ Excellent low light sensitivity to detect light pollution for plants
⎷ Custom calibration option to align readings to another meter
⎷ No Bluetooth and location permission required
⎷ No ads
⎷ All grow light sources supported (Natural sunlight, LEDs, HPS, MH, etc.) *
⎷ Photone for Apple Watch — monitor live readings from your wrist *
⎷ Average and peak readings *
⎷ Hands-free "read aloud" function *
⎷ Special underwater measurement mode *
⎷ Pro support by real human experts *

* These features require an in-app purchase to fully unlock

HOW ACCURATE IS PHOTONE?

Photone matches the accuracy of professional handheld PAR quantum sensors costing hundreds of dollars. Here's how:

⎷ RAW sensor data — capture true light intensity using the camera, the most precise sensor in your device
⎷ Pre-calibrated per device model
⎷ Developed according to the ISO/CIE 19476 standard for light measurement
⎷ Continuously tested — we regularly calibrate and test on new devices

DIFFUSER REQUIRED

Like every real light meter, Photone requires a diffuser to measure accurately. A diffuser scatters incoming light evenly on the sensor and prevents hotspots. While it may sound complex, the solution is surprisingly easy. You have two options:

1) Easily build a diffuser yourself in less than a minute using standard printer paper. This is accurate enough for most use cases.

2) Get the dedicated Diffuser Accessory (free worldwide shipping) for best accuracy and convenience. More details on https://lightray.io/diffuser/

(!) Do not rely on apps that do not require a diffuser. They are inaccurate because they ignore the basic physics of light measurement.

UPGRADE OPTIONS

Photone is free to download and use, with no ads or hidden costs. To unleash its full potential, it offers two types of upgrades:
→ Lifetime unlocks — one-time purchase, always restorable via your Apple Account
→ Pro subscription — full access for as long as you subscribe, cancel anytime

Photone took 7+ years of R&D to develop. Upgrading unlocks powerful features and keeps the app ad-free for everyone. As a member of 1% for the Planet, we donate at least 1% of all revenue to environmental non-profits — so every purchase helps both your plants and the planet.

bluejetty:00120102:ios.description:
YourTurn is Erie Insurance’s rewards-based telematics program for drivers. The program is designed to incentivize good driving behaviors through rewards and provide advice on improving driving habits.
The program will allow drivers to track their driving behaviors using a mobile application and earn rewards that can be cashed in for gift cards or pre-paid Visa cards, or donated to charity! All just for displaying good driving behaviors. 
The application determines how well drivers are doing by giving them a score based on their performance in the categories of phone distraction, speeding, acceleration, braking, and cornering – with higher-risk behaviors, such as distraction and speeding, weighted more heavily. Scores are captured and reset at the end of each two-week scoring period. 
Rewards are of course great, but there are other fun features too! Leaderboards allow you to see how you’re doing compared to your peers, trends let you see how you do over time, streaks let you see how many consecutive trips you’ve gone without a negative event, and badges track achievements over time – number of miles without a speeding incident, etc.
A valid mobile number and email address are required to use this application..

bluejetty:00149504:ios.name: Kiva - Lend for Good
bluejetty:00149504:ios.summary: Dreams are universal - opportunity is not. You can unlock opportunity for people without access to a bank - whether they’re an entrepreneur, a student, a farmer, a single mom or a refugee. Lend as little as $25 to a microfinance loan on Kiv
bluejetty:00149504:ios.description:
Dreams are universal - opportunity is not. You can unlock opportunity for people without access to a bank - whether they’re an entrepreneur, a student, a farmer, a single mom or a refugee. Lend as little as $25 to a microfinance loan on Kiva and make an exponential impact by re-lending your money over and over again. Join our community of 1.9 million people who have crowdfunded $1.4 billion in loans to 3.4 million borrowers in over 90 countries.
How Kiva works:
1. Choose a borrower – Browse by category and find an entrepreneur to support.
2. Make a loan – Help fund a loan with as little as $25. 
3. Get repaid – Kiva borrowers have a 96% repayment rate historically. 
4. Repeat – Relend your money or withdraw your funds. 
We envision a financially inclusive world where all people hold the power to improve their lives.
More than 1.7 billion people around the world are unbanked and can’t access the financial services they need. Kiva is an international nonprofit, founded in 2005 in San Francisco, with a mission to expand financial access to help underserved communities thrive.
We do this by crowdfunding loans and unlocking capital for the underserved, improving the quality and cost of financial services, and addressing the underlying barriers to financial access around the world. Through Kiva's work, students can pay for tuition, women can start businesses, farmers are able to invest in equipment and families can afford needed emergency care.
By lending as little as $25 on Kiva, you can be part of the solution and make a real difference in someone’s life. 100% of every dollar you lend on Kiva goes to funding loans.
IT'S A LOAN, NOT A DONATION
We believe lending alongside thousands of others is one of the most powerful and sustainable ways to create economic and social good. Lending on Kiva creates a partnership of mutual dignity and makes it easy to touch more lives with the same dollar. Fund a loan, get repaid, fund another.
YOU CHOOSE WHERE TO MAKE AN IMPACT
Whether you lend to friends in your community, or people halfway around the world (and for many, it’s both), Kiva creates the opportunity to play a special part in someone else's story. At Kiva, loans aren’t just about money—they’re a way to create connection and relationships.
PUSHING THE BOUNDARIES OF A LOAN
Kiva started as a pioneer in crowdfunding in 2005, and is constantly innovating to meet people’s diverse lending needs. Whether it’s reinventing microfinance with more flexible terms, supporting community-wide projects or lowering costs to borrowers, we are always testing and learning.
LIFTING ONE, TO LIFT MANY
When a Kiva loan enables someone to grow a business and create opportunity for themselves, it creates opportunities for others as well. That ripple effect can shape the future for a family or an entire community.
Learn more about how Kiva works here: https://www.kiva.org/about/how

bluejetty:00017945:ios.description:
Exclusivo para participantes, o aplicativo da Funpresp traz mais comodidade e agilidade no acompanhamento do seu plano de previdência complementar.
Com ele, você pode:
- conferir extrato de suas contribuições
- acompanhar a rentabilidade da reserva
- conferir o valor contratado da Parcela Adicional de Risco
- simular e contratar empréstimo consignado*
- gerar boletos bancários e QRCode PIX de pagamentos
- receber notificações importantes sobre seu plano
Para acessar, basta utilizar a mesma senha da Sala do Participante, do portal da Funpresp!
*Sobre a contratação de empréstimos:
Para contratação de empréstimo é necessário que o participante possua, no mínimo, 6 meses de contribuições consecutivas. É preciso ter idade entre 18 e 64 anos. Os participantes com mais de 57 anos de idade precisam observar a regra que combina a idade o tempo de concessão de empréstimo. Os participantes devem, ainda, estar adimplentes em relação a outros empréstimos e/ou contribuições previdenciárias e não possuir litígio judicial contra a Funpresp
Período mínimo de contratação é 6 meses e o máximo para quitação é de 96 meses.
Taxa percentual anual máxima (APR): 20,98% ao ano
Exemplo representativo do custo total do empréstimo, incluindo o valor inicial e todas as taxas aplicáveis (por exemplo, amostra de pagamento mensal e cálculo de juros).
Exemplo:
Valor solicitado R$ 10.000,00 – Prazo: 12 meses
Taxa de juros: 1,063%/mês
IOF: R$ 217,90
Taxa de Administração: R$ 55,00
Fundo de Quitação por Morte: R$ 5,82 (cobrança única)
Valor Líquido: R$ 9.721,28
Valor da Prestação: R$ 892,03 (fixa)
Maiores detalhes sobre a regulamentação de empréstimos estão disponíveis publicamente no endereço: https://www.funpresp.com.br/planos-e-produtos/emprestimo.
A Política de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados está disponível publicamente no endereço: https://www.funpresp.com.br/politica-de-privacidade-e-protecao-de-dados.
A Fundação de Previdência Complementar do Servidor Público Federal do Poder Executivo – Funpresp-Exe foi criada pelo Decreto nº 7.808/2012, com a finalidade de administrar e executar planos de benefícios de caráter previdenciário complementar para os servidores públicos titulares de cargo efetivo da União, suas autarquias e fundações.
A Funpresp é uma fundação sem fins lucrativos, de direito privado, com natureza pública e autonomia administrativa, financeira e gerencial. A Funpresp está sujeita à Lei nº 13.303/2016 (licitações das estatais) e aos órgãos de controle e fiscalização, e realiza concurso público para provimento de quadro de pessoal técnico/administrativo.
Além disso, a Funpresp é fiscalizada pela Superintendência Nacional de Previdência Complementar (Previc), autarquia vinculada ao Ministério da Economia.

bluejetty:00018704:ios.description:
Magic Guide® – Your Essential Disney World Companion
Experience Disney World like never before with real-time wait times, interactive park maps, comprehensive dining guides, and GPS navigation.
INTERACTIVE PARK MAPS Navigate all Disney World parks with stunning high quality maps for Magic Kingdom, Epcot, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, and Disney Springs. See live wait times and next show times directly on the map, pinpoint your exact location with GPS and compass, and quickly find attractions, restaurants, and restrooms with intuitive search and zoom controls.
COMPLETE DINING GUIDE Browse menus and details for over 300 Disney World dining locations, from table-service restaurants to quick-service stands. Discover options by location, meal offerings, GPS proximity, or your saved favorites. Access discount information for Annual Passholders, DVC members, and Disney Dining Plan participants. Premium users can search across all menus to find specific foods and dietary options.
REAL-TIME WAIT TIMES Stay informed with crowd-sourced wait times updated by park guests throughout the day. View wait times organized by park, proximity, or favorites. Set up notification alerts for your must-do attractions and contribute your own wait time reports when you're in the parks.
PARK SCHEDULES & EVENTS Plan your perfect day with up-to-date operating hours for all six Disney World parks, plus showtimes for parades, fireworks, and special events.
PLANS Build your own Calendar Plans and share them with friends and family.
WEATHER Park specific weather including per minute rain forecasts.
PREMIUM MAGIC GUIDE+ FEATURES
* Wait Time Forecasts per ride
* Daily Crowds Forecasts for the next year
* Looking Glass augmented reality viewer
* VIP Tour ride recommendations
* Wait Time Notification Alerts
* Wait Times and Park Hours on Apple Watch
* Advanced food search across all menus
* Ad-free experience
* Apple Family Sharing
Whether you're planning your first visit or you're a seasoned passholder, this app puts everything you need right at your fingertips.

- 7*24小时全时守护： 全球服务节点确保心理健康服务不受时差阻隔，让理解与陪伴触手可及。
- 900万人次+定制心理服务：壹点灵已为全球超过900万人次提供过专业、有温度的1对1专业心理咨询服务。
# 严选咨询师｜2% 入驻率，高于行业标准的专家体系
我们深知，打开内心需要巨大的勇气，因此我们建立了高于行业标准的咨询师管理体系：
- 2% 严选机制： 历经 12 大维度筛选与 50 分钟双重面试，入驻率仅2%。
- 高学历深背景： 75% 以上咨询师拥有名校心理学硕博背景，平均从业经验 12 年，完成 200 小时以上长程专业培训。
- 数字化干预方案： 我们根据您的个案概念化，定制阶段性方案，让心理成长过程数字化、可视化、系统化。
 #线上线下融合：OMO全链路疗愈体系
依托“线上即时响应 + 线下深度咨询”的 OMO (Online-Merge-Offline) 一站式心理服务模式，我们打造了覆盖全生命周期的服务体系：
- 线上即时性： 7×24 小时在线，通过文字、语音和视频，在您最需要的瞬间永远在线。
- 线下旗舰中心： 在北京、上海、杭州、广州等 20+ 核心城市设立 70+ 专业心理健康中心。融合私密空间设计与专业咨询环境，为您提供可信赖的深度疗愈。
#670万+分钟公益：让每一份情绪都有出口
- 24小时免费热线： 坚持回馈社会，已累计提供670万+分钟专业公益支持。
- 1000+ 专业量表： 涵盖性格、情感、职场等全方位心理测评，精准感知你的每一条情绪信号。
# 24h AI 陪伴：零压力的情绪管理工具
- 0 距离对话： “AI 暖暖”全天候在线，为您提供 24 小时私密情绪树洞。
- 数字化成长轨迹： 将不可见的心理波动转化为可视化的成长数据，见证自己变好的每一步。
#多重安全标准：极致守护你的每一次表达
- PIPL & GDPR 双认证： 全球率先通过中、欧双重最高隐私合规认证。
- 100% 动态加密： 依托全流程数据传输加密，为您构建绝对私密、独立的咨询环境。
#赋能执业：心理咨询师成长平台
如果您是心理咨询师或学习者，壹点灵为您提供一站式专业支持：
- 攀登计划： 提供从入门到进阶的系统化学习路径，培养具有执业胜任力的专业人才。
- 执业后援： 提供数字化个案管理、名师督导及危机干预支持，让执业之路不再孤单，助力专业价值最大化释放。
「每一个被看见的瞬间，都是治愈的开始」
不需要整理好情绪再来，也不用担心说得对不对。
在壹点灵，我们陪你一起探索内心世界，温暖而有力地爱着你！
官网：https://www.ydl.com

bluejetty:00042384:ios.description:
Fitness/Health App for Peak Fitness
FEATURES FOR FITNESS PROFESSIONALS
- Build and deliver customized training plans built from workouts containing exercise pictures/videos for online and in-person fitness training
- Look up client training plans and progress stats, manage workout calendars, check clients in for workouts, and track current workouts
- Deliver meal plans or get access to professional meal planning tools right in the app
- Keep a full client contact list database and train them in-person at anytime
- Edit client workouts on the fly
- Add full client body stats including caliper body fat measurements
- Upload client progress photos
- Add new clients from the mobile app
- Message clients in real-time 
- Connect to add-ons to extend your business and services (eg. MindBody Online, Evolution Nutrition, YouTube, PayPal, Skype, Facebook, Twitter)
FEATURES FOR CLIENTS:
- Access training plans, follow and check-in to workouts
- Schedule workouts and stay committed by beating your personal best 
- Access meal plans if your coach sets them up
- Message your coach in real-time
- Track body stats and take progress photos
- Review past progress stats and graphs
- Set push notification reminders on days with scheduled workouts
- Connect to wearable devices to sync body stats instantly (Apple Watch with Health app, Fitbit, Withings)
IMPORTANT NOTE: This app is a companion app for businesses that use Peak Fitness. An online account is required. If you're a client, ask your trainer for your account details so you can login to this app. For more information visit our website.

Junta is a trusted marketplace for community savings groups.
Create your own savings group, invite friends and family, or discover trusted groups and participants through transparent reputation and verification.
Whether you're saving with people you already know or expanding beyond your circle, Junta helps you build financial relationships with confidence.
CREATE SAVINGS GROUPS
• Create a group in minutes
• Set contribution amounts
• Invite members with a link
• Manage rounds and payouts
• Track group progress
DISCOVER TRUSTED PEOPLE
• Search for savings groups
• Find trusted administrators
• Discover verified participants
• Request to join groups
• Invite reliable members
TRANSPARENT REPUTATION
Every profile includes participation history to help you make informed decisions.
View:
• On-time payment history
• Completed groups
• Verified contribution volume
• Identity verification
• Background verification
• Participation metrics

bluejetty:00128449:ios.summary:
► IDEAL HOMES
Do you love the idea of renovation? Do you dream of a fresh canvas on which to create your ideal home design again and again? Are you looking for a casual mobile game that lets you live out your interior design fantasies in a
bluejetty:00128449:ios.description:
► IDEAL HOMES
Do you love the idea of renovation? Do you dream of a fresh canvas on which to create your ideal home design again and again? Are you looking for a casual mobile game that lets you live out your interior design fantasies in a fun, relaxing environment where you can try out different furniture and décor concepts in any way you want? Then Decor Life is the game for you.
Combining a series of simple and easily mastered mechanics with a huge range of unique spaces, furniture items and design objects, Decor Life brings you all the fun parts of moving and decorating with none of the real-life hassle and hard work.
► SPACE FOR YOUR DESIGNS
• Homes, sweet homes: A huge and ever-expanding variety of rooms to work on, each with the unique atmosphere and attributes of its owner. Try and try again to find the right renovation solutions to suit each space. Choose furniture and décor options, then move them around the room until you find just the right spot.
• Outside the box: Decor Life is a game that follows the renovation process from start to finish. Begin by sorting the furniture and contents of the old, unrenovated room into the right boxes, before moving on to selecting home design options, unboxing and placing furniture, then finally unpack and arrange new decorative items and possessions in the redecorated room.
• No judgment: Unsure of your taste in home design? There are no right answers in Décor Life, and nobody to correct your choices at the end of each level. You get to select the designs and furnishings you want and judge their success on your own terms, so there’s nothing to stop you relaxing and getting the maximum pleasure out of letting your design fantasy run free.
• A place for absolutely everything: When it comes to unboxing, you never know what you’re going to find. Can you work out where best to place a drum kit, a safe, a beautiful still life, or any number of other unique and individual items that are looking for the right home in your new room?
• Anywhere on the map: the home design map opens up for you. No need to play levels in order, you can get decorating anywhere you want to in the game by exploring all the different rooms on the map.
► RENOVATION TIME
Let your creativity run wild in this imaginative and original decorating game where you’re free to make your own interior choices and admire the results of your design labors in a relaxing and open gaming environment. Got an insatiable taste for home improvement? Then download Decor Life now and get renovating.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00186862:ios.summary:

“Make your life easier by consolidating all o
bluejetty:00186862:ios.description:
One app for all your parent communication.
Bloomz is the FREE award-winning app that saves teachers lots of time in all parent communications, while creating a supportive classroom community. 
“Make your life easier by consolidating all of your communications and coordination with parents.” – WeAreTeachers
“If you’re looking for ways to build relationships with and between families, check out Bloomz!” – The Cornerstone for Teachers
“There’s one app that does it all, it’s called Bloomz.” – Vicki Davis (CoolCatTeacher)
Bloomz makes it easy for teachers to securely share photos, classroom updates and reach parents instantly through messaging, as well as to coordinate events (like PT Conferences) and sign up for volunteers.
Bloomz now supports Student Timelines, a simple & beautiful way to capture and share student-driven portfolios. Students can publish their work by quickly scanning a QR code and annotating their work. Teachers can approve and instantly share with parents on Student's Timelines.
With Bloomz teachers can:
- Post class updates and share pictures, and see who’s viewing them
- Manage events and calendar, with built-in reminders
- Schedule Parent-Teacher Conferences in seconds
- Sign up volunteers in a few easy steps
- Message one or more parents, without sharing their cell phone number
- Send alerts notifications for urgent matters, to both phone and email in one click.
- Invite parents via email or class code for privacy
- Capture & share student-driven portfolios with parents securely via Student Timelines
- Reinforce students’ positive behavior, sharing notes and awards with parents
With Bloomz parents can:
- Sign up FREE and be notified via SMS/TEXT messaging 
- Choose between push and email notifications, as well as their frequency
- Read posts in their preferred language with one-click translations (80 languages available)
- Communicate with other parents for play dates, carpooling and more
Awards:
- New Education Product of 2016 – EdTech Digest
- 2015 Awards of Excellence – Tech & Learning
- The National Parenting Center Seal of Approval
- Top 20 Most Promising K12 Technology – CIO Review
- People’s Choice Award – Stevie Awards
- Best of Show @ ISTE 2016 – Tech & Learning
- Best Website for Teaching and Learning 2016 – American Association of School Librarians (AASL)
Subscription:
Bloomz is always free for teachers, parents and schools. Bloomz may experiment with different premium experiences, while continue to offer both educators and parents a free platform to connect, coordinate and communicate. 
The Bloomz Convenience Pack is an easy and quick way to download and share media posted on Bloomz, in full resolution, and without restrictions.* For only $1.67 a month (billed annually at $19.99), parents get photo and video downloads at full resolution on both mobile and desktop, with multiple media selection (including full albums) and unlimited access, even after class is archived. Note: Teachers can always upload unlimited number of photos and/or videos to share with parents at no cost.
* Your subscription is effective for 1 calendar year starting with your purchase. Your iTunes account will be charged at confirmation of purchase and automatically renews at the then current price, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings, and you can cancel any time by emailing support@bloomz.com. You can ask for a refund within the first 15 days as long as no content has been downloaded after payment. Prices shown are in U.S. dollars. Other restrictions apply.
Privacy Policy: https://www.bloomz.net/privacypolicy
Terms: https://www.bloomz.net/terms
Follow us on:
Facebook.com/BloomzApp
Twitter.com/BloomzApp

bluejetty:00166607:ios.summary:
Arcadia Mahjong – A Senior-Friendly Mahjong Solitaire & Tile Puzzle Adventure

bluejetty:00166607:ios.description:
Arcadia Mahjong – A Senior-Friendly Mahjong Solitaire & Tile Puzzle Adventure
Unwind, sharpen your mind, and enjoy a timeless tile-matching journey!
Arcadia Mahjong brings a refreshing, senior-friendly take on classic mahjong solitaire, combining relaxing tile matching with engaging tile puzzle challenges. Designed with seniors and elderly players in mind, the game focuses on comfort and ease of use, featuring larger, easy-to-read mahjong tiles that let you enjoy your favorite mahjong solitaire puzzles.
Whether you enjoy classic mahjong, tile matching games, or relaxing tile puzzle games, Arcadia Mahjong offers a comfortable way to play, think, and unwind at your own pace.
How to Play Arcadia Mahjong:
-- Match identical mahjong tiles and clear the board to complete each tile puzzle.
-- Tap two matching mahjong tiles to eliminate them.
-- Concealed or blocked tiles cannot be eliminated.
-- Think ahead, find available matches, and gradually clear the mahjong solitaire board.
Premium Features of Arcadia Mahjong:
-- Strategic Tile Matching – Outsmart each mahjong puzzle by carefully selecting and matching tiles to clear the board.
-- Senior-Friendly Combo Mode – Enjoy smooth tile-matching sequences at your own pace with no time pressure, making the experience comfortable for seniors.
-- Large, Easy-to-Read Tiles – Clearly identify mahjong tiles and patterns with larger visuals designed for comfortable play.
-- 10,000+ Mahjong Solitaire Puzzles – Explore over 10,000 uniquely crafted and engaging tile puzzles, offering seniors plenty of relaxing challenges to enjoy.
-- Daily Brain Training – Tackle a new and increasingly challenging mahjong puzzle every day to keep your mind active.
-- Smart In-Game Tools – Use handy features such as hints and shuffles to overcome tricky tile-matching levels with ease.
-- Portrait & Landscape Play – Rotate your device and enjoy senior-friendly mahjong solitaire comfortably in either orientation.
Benefits for Seniors and Elderly Mahjong Solitaire Players:
-- Cognitive Training – Tile matching and pattern recognition encourage hand-eye coordination, concentration, and mental engagement.
-- Relaxing Play for Seniors – Focus on thoughtful tile matching and strategic moves while enjoying a calm, no-pressure puzzle experience.
-- Memory Practice – Mahjong solitaire involves identifying identical tile patterns while remembering available tiles and previous moves.
-- Comfortable Puzzle Experience – Large tiles, simple controls, and flexible screen orientation make Arcadia Mahjong easy and comfortable for senior players.
-- Play at Your Own Pace – Enjoy relaxing mahjong tile puzzles without rushing through every move.
If you are a fan of mahjong solitaire, tile matching games, or relaxing tile puzzle games, Arcadia Mahjong can be your everyday puzzle companion. With senior-friendly features, large mahjong tiles, thousands of puzzles, and relaxing gameplay, it offers an enjoyable mahjong solitaire experience for seniors and players of all ages.
Download Arcadia Mahjong today and start your relaxing tile-matching adventure!

bluejetty:00030679:ios.description:
Build, manage, and develop your own hockey franchise in a deep, strategy-focused sports simulation. World Hockey Manager 2026 puts you in charge of every major decision—from roster moves and training plans to tactical choices made before each game. Matches are realistic and fully simulated, and your preparation determines the result.
Build Your Team
Create a competitive roster by signing new players, developing talent, and forming effective lines. Every player matters, and every role contributes to your long-term success.
• Recruit and develop players
• Upgrade skills and define roles
• Set line combinations based on your strategy
Set Your Tactics Before Every Match
Games are decided by the tactical plan you prepare ahead of time. There is no live control—success comes from smart decisions, strong team structure, and strategic depth.
• Pre-match strategy and tactical planning
• Realistic simulations influenced by your setup
• Detailed post-game stats to refine your approach
Compete in Global Leagues and Events
Challenge other managers around the world, rise through competitive leagues, and participate in themed seasonal events. Earn rewards that strengthen your organization and keep your team evolving.
• Worldwide competition and leaderboards
• Special events with unique challenges
• Rewards that support long-term progression
Build an Ice Hockey Legacy
• Grow your organization over multiple seasons. Improve your roster, refine your tactical identity, and create a sustainable winning strategy that stands the test of time.
• World Hockey Manager 2026 delivers a complete hockey management experience for fans who enjoy strategy, team building, and long-term planning. Whether you're a dedicated sports-sim player or a hockey fan ready to become a GM, this is where your franchise story begins.
• Take the role of GM and build the team that can dominate the competition. 
Download World Hockey Manager 2026 and start building your dynasty today.
Our community and support
We are always ready to listen to your input, and we want to include you as much as possible. No matter what your feedback is, you never know, your idea might make it into the game! How cool is that?

bluejetty:00044347:ios.name: A&D Heart Track
bluejetty:00044347:ios.summary: A blood pressure and health metrics tracking app designed by doctors to help you collect and manage your blood pressure readings along with other health metrics. This app has been created to help you measure your blood pressure accurately u
bluejetty:00044347:ios.description:
A blood pressure and health metrics tracking app designed by doctors to help you collect and manage your blood pressure readings along with other health metrics. This app has been created to help you measure your blood pressure accurately using your own home monitor, follow your trends over time, and help your healthcare provider best manage your care.
• Ensure your blood pressure measurements are performed accurately by following our "how-to" measurement guide.
• Rapidly and efficiently calculate blood pressure averages with our Swipe Averaging™ feature. Bring your phone to your next appointment with your physician or pharmacist, and they can use Swipe Averaging™ to quickly and easily assess your blood pressure for clinical decision making.
• Link your readings directly to your healthcare provider or pharmacist, through the Heart Track BP Telemonitoring System. Find out more at andhearttrack.ca
• Learn from internationally renowned experts what blood pressure is, about high and low blood pressure, and how blood pressure can best be controlled.
• Heart Track is recommended by Hypertension Canada.
• Easily track your blood pressure and weight using an A&D Medical blood pressure monitor and weight scale. Automatically transmit your readings using a compatible Bluetooth-enabled device, or manually enter the value reported by any blood pressure monitor or weight scale.
The following Bluetooth-enabled blood pressure monitors are supported.
• A&D Medical Connected Upper Arm Blood Pressure Monitor: UA-651BLE
• A&D Medical UltraConnect Upper Arm Blood Pressure Monitor: UA-1200CNBLE
• A&D Medical UltraConnect Wrist Blood Pressure Monitor: UB-1100CNBLE
• A&D Medical Connected Weight Scale: UC-350CNBLE
MEDICAL DISCLAIMER: The Heart Track app is not intended for the diagnosis of or screening for hypertension. Users should be aware that the Heart Track app is an information management service to enable the analysis of blood pressure data and is not intended to be a substitute for the advice of a health care professional. Individuals should always consult their doctor or other qualified health care professional with any questions they may have regarding a medical condition, including any queries or concerns about blood pressure management. You should never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of information transmitted to or contained in your Heart Track app.

bluejetty:00127844:ios.name: Midco Wi-Fi
bluejetty:00127844:ios.summary: A corner-to-corner connectivity solution, Midco® Wi-Fi brings your Midco internet to the next level. Midco Wi-Fi uses your existing internet connection, strategically placed pods and this app to optimize, control and protect your home netwo
bluejetty:00127844:ios.description:
A corner-to-corner connectivity solution, Midco® Wi-Fi brings your Midco internet to the next level. Midco Wi-Fi uses your existing internet connection, strategically placed pods and this app to optimize, control and protect your home network.
To access the app, you must have Midco Wi-Fi (not just Midco internet). 
– Streamlined Navigation 
Using the app is now easier than ever. Its new tabbed navigation bar allows for simplified discovery and control:
•Home – Provides a complete view of everything across your network. 
•People – View the people and devices on your network. 
•Newsfeed – Alerts you to any network activity, events and new features. 
•More – Quick access to settings and account management.
– Smart Self-Optimizing Technology 
Midco Wi-Fi uses built-in AI to automatically adjust your network as devices come and go so you don’t have to think about your Wi-Fi – unless you want to. 
– Guard: Advanced Security
When enabled, Midco Wi-Fi preemptively monitors threats to protect your network without impacting the performance of your browsing experience. Then, if a threat is detected, the device is automatically placed into quarantine to protect your network’s integrity.
– Adapt: Network Visibility 
Have complete control over your home network. Know who is connecting – from which device and when. Create and manage guest networks and passwords for visitors outside your main home network. Then, use the built-in speed testing functionality within the Midco Wi-Fi app to ensure you’re getting the most out of your internet bandwidth per device. 
– Sense: Motion Detection
Use each person’s primary device connection to determine if they’re at home or even the room where they’re connected to your network. 
– People and Devices
Set and manage Midco Wi-Fi preferences at the user or device level. Start by creating a profile for each person. Then, set their content access limits, adblocking settings and more. Once you assign devices to each profile, those content access limits and adblocking settings will be applied to all their devices. Plus, you can set an everyday schedule by implementing device freezes. 
– Simple Self-Installation 
Grab your pods and go! Set up corner-to-corner coverage using the Midco Wi-Fi in-app tutorial or our easy, step-by-step instructions at Midco.com/Setup. Both options provide clear directions with visuals to guide you through the install process. Note: Self-installation may not be available (or a good fit) for everyone.
Don’t have pods? Or have questions? Reach out at Midco.com/Contact.

Mobile pay makes it easy to scan your app, grab your favorite sandwich and coffee, without fumbling through your purse or wallet. Use auto-reload to keep your app charged up and ready for your adventures.

Need bagels now? Quickly find your nearest Noah's New York Bagels using the mobile app to conveniently fuel up and get on with your day.

Make someone’s day with the gift of bagels. Sending an eGift from the Noah's mobile app is an easy way to let them know you care, with each and every bite.
Menu and Nutrition at Your Fingertips
Searching for your new favorite sandwich? Our entire menu is just a few taps away, ready to browse. Need nutritional information? It’s easy to find on the go.

Shadow Rival: Action War is a dark fantasy Action RPG Game where you use your slash and dodge skill to battle against hordes of Shadow Monsters and Demons. Be Rival of Shadow, choose your hero from various classes, each with unique ultimate skills and abilities, and become the Legend Demon Hunter.
KEY FEATURES
▶ Dynamic Action Hack and Slash gameplay
Experience this fighting Game with hack-and-slash gameplay by choosing a favorite hunter to discover this dark fantasy world.
Explore many types of complex terrain by running, climbing, and jumping, there are fascinating mystery points for you to find out!
Battle against Shadow Monsters and Shadow Demons by using your skills and abilities to defeat hordes of monsters, and demons and earn rewards.
▶ Find your perfect hunter: Choose from various character classes, each with unique skills and abilities. Become a powerful warrior, a skillful ninja, a wise mage, a sturdy tanker, or a fearsome summoner.
▶ Adventure Shadow World: Immersed in endless dark fantasy and atmospheric Shadow World. Discover hidden treasures, defeat powerful bosses, and uncover the secrets of this mysterious realm. Explore Ruins of the Ancient City, Mystic Town, Swamp of Sin, Sorrow Forest, Frozen Castle, Hellfire Citadel, and various dungeons,... while mastering your battle skill
▶ Level up and become stronger: Unlock and learn new combos, skills, abilities, and ultimates to defeat even the most challenging enemies.
▶ Your hero, Your Style: Customize your character's appearance and abilities. Complete missions or log in daily to get free weapons, armor, and skins to create the perfect Demon Slayer.

bluejetty:00075510:ios.description:
Welcome to Logicross, a free and enhanced version of the letters and numbers puzzle game!
Play Logicross: Crossword Puzzle - Where code games and logic come together. Decrypt quotes now!
Classic Word Games, Revamped
Your search for a highly competitive and complicated word puzzle game is over, as here comes the letter puzzle game, which combines the genres of word search, word game, brain teaser, and cross logic puzzles into a single game. Dive into our code games and guess the word puzzles, where connections word game meets word guess challenges. 
Whatever you are looking for can be found in this cryptic crossword game. Even the excitement of quote puzzles is available through fill in puzzles. It’s fun to guess the word and continue this word connections game. Our cool word games offers a variety of word games for adults, including word searches, crosswords code games and relaxing puzzles all available offline.
Crypto Letters
This letters and numbers puzzle game is a word game all about clever and intelligent moves. Players try to find a hidden sentence by uncovering each cryptic letter on the board. Like a cross logic and word puzzle game, the hidden words have hints and definitions. Enjoy the thrill of word association game, daily crossword, code games and riddles brain teasers for an engaging brain workout.
Croissant is a dessert, but Logicross brings this word into your home with cypher and crypt. Don’t ask what is the relationship between a crypt and croissant as anything is possible in a cryptic crossword game! 
Different Themes
Letter puzzle games present many challenging, logical, and tricky word puzzle levels that will test your IQ and mind. There is also a wide variety of level themes with proverbs, hidden messages, movie quotes, and historical facts. These puzzles will enhance your cultural knowledge and analytic thinking at the same time! Become a cypher and fill in puzzles using your great brain training game skills. 
Gold Rush
Challenge your friends and other players with the Gold Rush mode that brings a weekly challenge to the game. Find the golden letter tiles and earn points. Finish each week on top to get amazing rewards.
Guess the word and unleash your decrypt powers. Cryptic crossword puzzle games, word letters and word connection game masters are welcome to do cryptogram here. Dive into the world of word searches, crosswords, and zen word games in our new offline word game for free, designed for word explorer enthusiasts.
Increase Your Knowledge
Completing levels reveals a cryptic word with deep mysteries and amazing facts. Learning about scientific facts and ancient proverbs has always been smoother! Logicross puzzles will help to reach great word and brain teaser skills.
Complete Your Album
Enhanced progression with the album system encourages players to solve the mysteries and uncover cryptic clues. Complete designated number of levels to unlock new pages for your album, which presents beautiful photos and amazing landscapes.
Tricky Questions !
* Is there a logic word game?
* How does decryption work?
* Is there a cross word puzzle with brain teaser mechanics?
* What are some historical facts that sound cool?
How to Play? 
* Look at the definitions and guess each word.
* Tap on an empty letter box to write a letter and continue from there.
* Find critical letters that connect different words.
* Review each word for easy solutions.
* Complete the target sentence.
Game Features: 
* Endless gameplay with more than 1000 levels.
* Different level categories with exciting subjects.
* Fun word games for free and word games for adults!
* Smooth decryption mechanics that allow easy gameplay.
* Colorful graphics and quality animations.
* Daily challenges and weekly challenges.
* Can be played with one hand.
Download and play the letters and numbers puzzle game today and start training your logic, enhance your brain, boost your memory and get out of boredom!

bluejetty:00096028:ios.description:
Find, Protect & Secure Your Phone – All in One Security App
Never lose your phone again! AntiLost is the ultimate phone finder & anti-theft security app, combining smart tools to locate your device, stop thieves, and keep it safe – anytime, anywhere.
Key Features:
- Clap to Find Phone: Clap or make a sound and your phone will ring instantly, even in silent mode.
- WTMP Intruder Reports: Capture photos and logs of anyone who tries to unlock your phone without permission.

bluejetty:00087819:ios.description:
SpeedyBee is an Appllication for Flight controller parameters settings. 
Communication between mobile devices and flight control boards can be achieved through Bluetooth, you can use mobile devices to set the parameters of the flight controller.Any Bluetooth module compatible with your mobile device can be used, but if using the SpeedyBee Bluetooth-UART Adapter, this Bluetooth module will deactivate and activate automatically according to the status of the drone(armed/disarmed), no Bluetooth signal interference during the flight.
Flight Controller Requirements:
Betaflight firmware version ≥ 3.1.0
iNav FC version ≥ 1.8.1
Butterflight firmware version ≥ 3.1.0
System Requirements : iOS 13.0+
Instructions for use：
1.Connect the Bluetooth PCB with the UART interface of the Flight Controller, or use the flight controller integrated  Bluetooth.
2.Open the Betaflight Configurator, on the Ports tab, open the Configuration/MSP port of the Bluetooth PCB, for the Bluettooth module of BLE4.0, 19200 is the recommended baud rate value.
3.Open the APP, connect the Flight Controller via Bluetooth, and you can adjust the parameters now.

Communication between mobile devices and flight control boards can be achieved through Bluetooth, you can use mobile devices to set the parameters of the flight controller.Any Bluetooth module compatible with your mobile device can be used, but if using the SpeedyBee Bluetooth-UART Adapter, this Bluetooth module will deactivate and activate automatically according to the status of the drone(armed/disarmed), no Bluetooth signal interference during the flight.

Flight Controller Requirements:
Betaflight firmware version ≥ 3.1.0
iNav FC version ≥ 1.8.1
Butterflight firmware version ≥ 3.1.0

System Requirements : iOS 13.0+

Instructions for use：
1.Connect the Bluetooth PCB with the UART interface of the Flight Controller, or use the flight controller integrated  Bluetooth.
2.Open the Betaflight Configurator, on the Ports tab, open the Configuration/MSP port of the Bluetooth PCB, for the Bluettooth module of BLE4.0, 19200 is the recommended baud rate value.
3.Open the APP, connect the Flight Controller via Bluetooth, and you can adjust the parameters now.

bluejetty:00122727:ios.description:
Fidelity Bank & Trust is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Fidelity Bank & Trust–Mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Fidelity Bank & Trust–Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Fidelity Bank & Trust Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00083571:ios.description:
Looking for a fun way to break the ice, deepen your connection, or add some spice to your night? Look no further! 21 Questions is your go-to app, offering over 5000 unique and thought-provoking questions across 30+ categories, perfect for couples, groups of friends, and everyone in between.
Whether you’re just starting to get to know someone, reconnecting with your partner, or hanging out with friends, 21 Questions has the perfect deck for you:
 First Date – Spark up the conversation and set the tone for your new relationship.
 Deeper Intimacy – Dive into deeper, more meaningful conversations with your partner.
 Long-Distance Love – Keep the connection strong, even when miles apart.
 Under the Sheets – Add a little heat and fun with some spicy questions.
 Secrets Revealed - Spicy – Turn up the heat with juicy questions for friends.
 Would You Rather - Spicy – Spice things up with tough choices and wild scenarios.
 Would You Rather - Couple – A special deck to test your compatibility with your partner.
 Group Icebreaker – Perfect for breaking the ice with new people, friends, or groups.
 Who's More Likely - Spicy – Fun and spicy questions for any group or party.
 Real Talk, No Judgement – Get deep and honest with your friends, no holds barred.
 Family Fun – Fun and light-hearted questions for family time.
 Philosophical Questions – Engage your brain and explore some thought-provoking topics.
 Unpopular Opinions – Agree to disagree and have a laugh while discussing strange opinions.
 Truth or Dare – Classic fun with a spicy twist for friends and partners.
• Long Conversation – For when you want to go deep into any topic with your friends.
• Road Trip – Perfect for those long journeys with friends or loved ones.
With categories ranging from “Would You Rather” to “Truth or Dare”, “Family Fun”, and “Unpopular Opinions”, the app offers hours of entertainment. Whether you're in the mood for a lighthearted chat or a deep heart-to-heart, we’ve got a deck to match your vibe.
Perfect for road trips, college crews, coworker gossip, or a cozy family game night, 21 Questions is guaranteed to bring laughter, thought-provoking moments, and meaningful conversations to any occasion. Add a little fun to your relationships, strengthen your bonds, or just enjoy a good laugh with your favorite people.
With a wide range of spicy, deep, and fun questions, you can spice things up, create memorable moments, and explore the people you care about on a whole new level. It's a game that everyone can enjoy. And with over 30 unique decks to choose from, there’s no shortage of conversation starters!
So, grab your friends, partner, or family, and get ready for hours of fun, connection, and unexpected moments. With 21 Questions, the game never stops!

3D ARPG×Magic×Guilds! Experience the story and grow your guild!
The strongest team is assembled! Get ready to embark on a fantastic magical adventure with your guildmates! The brand-new official 3D action mobile game, "FAIRY TAIL: Fierce Fight" is officially launched!
Experience the most authentic and vivid magical world with the intense and passionate anime storyline. Engage in battles with nearly 40 wizards in highly detailed 3D environments. Build your ultimate team by utilizing diverse wizard types and unique counter relationships. In the 3D free battle system that seamlessly combines strategy and action, confront the Underworld King Mard Geer, outsmart the Oracion Seis, and challenge the Tower of Heaven. Officially authorized by Kodansha and based on the popular TV anime "FAIRY TAIL", the action mobile game "FAIRY TAIL: Fierce Fight" faithfully recreates anime scenes and revisits classic chapters like the Battle of Tartaros. Join forces with guildmates to combat formidable enemies such as the Eisenwald, Oracion Seis, and the Underworld King Mard Geer. Rediscover the profound bonds among Fairy Tail members, grow in battle, and reignite your passion for adventure.
***Immerse in 3D Intense Battles***
Witness dazzling magical animations and experience intense 3D action to faithfully portray each wizard's unique magic. The unique shield-breaking mechanism challenges your understanding of magical combat. Utilize the counter relationships between wizards, pay attention to strategic positioning and dodging, and seize the perfect timing to seamlessly chain skills, all contributing to creating a completely new combat experience.
***Build the Ultimate Team***
The true essence of the ultimate team lies in fearlessness when fighting alongside genuine companions. Original voice actors such as Kakihara Tetsuya, Hirano Aya, Ohara Sayaka, and Nakamura Yuichi lend their voices to recreate classic battles from the anime, immersing you in every intense fight!

bluejetty:00114942:ios.name: PatternDraw by Fashionary
bluejetty:00114942:ios.summary: PatternDraw is tailor-made for pattern design on iPad & iPhone. Now you can sketch, paint, adjust colorways, generate mockups, and create seamless repeating patterns in one powerful tool—without switching between apps or relying on desktop
bluejetty:00114942:ios.description:
PatternDraw is tailor-made for pattern design on iPad & iPhone. Now you can sketch, paint, adjust colorways, generate mockups, and create seamless repeating patterns in one powerful tool—without switching between apps or relying on desktop software.
Key features:
- Live Pattern Preview
- Create Multiple Colorways
- Mockup Generator
- Turn Any Image into Patterns
- 20+ Pattern Styles
- 100+ Professional Brushes
- Production-Ready Export
** Live Pattern Preview ** 
See your pattern tile in real-time as you draw. No export-and-check cycles. No guesswork. What you see is what you get—instantly previewed across your chosen repeat method while your brush is still moving.
** Create Multiple Colorways in Seconds **
Create a range of colorways for your pattern in seconds. PatternDraw can now automatically separate each color into different layers, so you can manage them easily with drag-and-drop. Reorder colors, shuffle your palette, or randomize new combinations—designing colorways has never been simpler.
** Mockup Generator **
Preview your patterns on mockups and export high-resolution images for social media and portfolios.
** Turn Any Image into Patterns ** 
Transform any image into a unique pattern with one tap. Import photos, sketches, or illustrations and instantly apply any pattern style. Complete creative control, zero technical barriers.
** 20+ Pattern Styles ** 
Access every repeat style you need: basic grids, half-drop, brick, mirror, diamond, and complex geometric layouts. Switch between methods instantly to explore different design directions without redrawing.
** 100+ Professional Brushes + Photoshop Import ** 
Our curated brush library covers everything from technical line work to expressive textures. Need your signature brush? Import your custom Photoshop brushes directly and work with the tools you already love.
** Production-Ready Export ** 
Export print-ready files for fabric manufacturers, wallpaper production, packaging design, or digital applications. Your patterns export clean, seamless, and ready for any commercial workflow.
** Universal Purchase—Design Anywhere **
One purchase unlocks PatternDraw on both iPad and iPhone. Use your iPad for detailed studio work, or sketch new ideas on your iPhone when inspiration strikes.
** Built by Designers, for Designers **
Two years ago, we launched FashionDraw. Our community of professional designers immediately asked: ""Can it create patterns?""
We tried every existing solution. Professional software felt bloated and unintuitive. Consumer apps couldn't handle serious design work. Nothing bridged the gap.
So we built PatternDraw—the tool we wished existed. A professional-grade pattern design app that feels as natural as sketching on paper, with the precision and export quality your projects demand.
Download PatternDraw and start creating production-ready patterns today!
https://patterndraw.app/pages/terms-and-conditions
https://patterndraw.app/pages/privacy-statement

bluejetty:00089105:ios.description:
CaloCare is more than a calorie counter and nutrition tracker, it's your dedicated health partner caring for your weight loss, offering meal plans, and helping you build lifelong healthy habits.
Our user-friendly app not only tracks your calorie and food intake with an instant barcode scanning feature, but also keeps you informed and motivated with nutrition analysis and a professional weight tracker. CaloCare gives you all the tools you need to reach your health goals.
Become your best self with CaloCare. Download now and take the first step towards a healthier, happier you.
Features:
1. Calorie Tracker & Calorie Counter
CaloCare is a user-friendly calorie tracker and counter, making it easy to log meals and monitor your intake. For weight loss, gain, or maintenance, our app provides custom programs, a food log, and a nutrition tracker. Log calories through search, barcode scanning, or AI image recognition to stay on track with your dietary goals.
2. Weight Loss & Weight Tracker
CaloCare’s weight tracker is perfect for managing your weight loss journey. Track your progress with ease and get insights into your weight changes after each log. Whether you want to lose weight or gain weight healthily, our app helps you track and achieve your goals with visualizations and metrics.
3. Food Tracker & Meal Plan
Log food easily using our instant scan feature with barcode. CaloCare helps you track all the food in every meal you log in detail. Follow the personalized meal plan that fits your lifestyle. The meal tracker we offer makes healthy eating a breeze.
4. Diet & Health Recipe
CaloCare recommends easy-made recipes that fit your diet and health goals. Browse our library for healthy meals tailored to your needs. Each recipe offers all the nutrition details you want to know, serving as a nutrition counter and helping you track your nutrient intake with our nutrition analysis.
Why Choose CaloCare?
- Count and Track comprehensive calorie & nutrition information for every food and meal
- Utilize an intuitive interface and visual designs for users with diverse goals to interact and navigate.
- Experience customized guidance and reminders helping you build lifelong healthy habits.
- Make nutritious meals with Easy-made Health Recipes tailored to your dietary needs.
Download CaloCare now and start a new chapter in your healthy life!
Subscription Information: CaloCare offers an auto-renewing subscription at $35.99/year and $9.99/month to provide you with unlimited access to the PRO features. Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase. Your subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The renewal cost will be charged to your account 24 hours before the end of the current period. When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded. If offered, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
Note: This app is developed for informational purposes only. You must always consult your physician or doctor before starting any fitness program. Results can vary.
Terms of Service: https://calocare.life/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://calocare.life/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00005786:ios.description:
Dragon Hunter is an epic hunting game with realistic graphics. Fight against dragons, evil beasts, and other creatures to save the world. Explore the entire game environment with your avatar and complete different quests to earn you gold, equipment, and experience points.
Are you searching for a game similar to Monster Hunter World or Hunting games? Like Dragon Hunter Games, Dino hunt, Dino hunting, Dino Hunter, Action Games or Dinosaur Games? Then Dragon Hunter: Monster World is for you!
The one and only dragon hunting first-person 3D shooter experience are more than being a dragon tamer. Join Millions of hunters and embark on dragon mania to become a legend. Be a dragon slayer to save the world and defy the odds to seal the fates of these bloodthirsty wild animals.
If you love to play dragon hunting games to become a dragon warrior in this dragon war, Hunt the dinosaur to become a dino hunter, dino hunting is a wild hunt in this game just experience it.
SET FOOT IN THE MONSTER WORLD:
Confront lethal flying dragons, flightless dragons (aggressive or passive), golden dragons (inspired from Spyro) in their environment, having their names and history avoiding their wrath of fireballs. Hostile forest wildlife will surround you.
FACE PRIMEVAL MONSTERS:
Strategize to become a Monster Hunter and chase down the historical monsters, namely: Trolls, Vampires, Griffins, Manticora, and Hydra, to deserve a title of a Monster Legend.
THRILLING & EXCITING MISSIONS:
Play through 50 missions of Bounty Hunter Mode with Boss Missions. Hunt down a diversity of creatures to complete the required objectives.
NEVER-ENDING SURVIVAL MODE:
Put your survival skills to the ultimate test by managing your essentials tactically to survive the terrifying waves of creatures till you can.
BREATHTAKING REALISTIC GRAPHICS:
4K textures, spectacular gun designs, the true-to-life creatures, evergreen forests will leave you genuinely astounding and awe-inspiring and wanting for more.
WORLD-CLASS ARMOURY:
Earn coins as you play to invest in the powerful arsenal of weapons including SMG, Shotgun, AR, Machine Gun, and Sniper Rifle and become a legendary marksman, deadly sharpshooter, or raged gunslinger.
TROPICAL ENVIRONMENTS:
Inhale the never-ending beauty of the jungle with dynamic weather. Get lost deep inside the forest to search for different creatures to hunt.
ADDITIONAL FEATURES:
Auto-move, auto-shoot, auto health-regen, ammo box to help you conquer the creatures. A free-look mode to check the sides without any weapons to plan your attacks stealthily while taking cover behind the trees.

bluejetty:00096191:ios.description:
Lilo is the study timer you use with friends. Start a focus session or a Pomodoro, challenge your friends, climb the weekly leaderboard and keep your study streak alive.
500K+ students have downloaded Lilo and left 200K+ ratings, because studying together works better than studying alone.
STUDY TIMER AND POMODORO
- Focus timer, stopwatch and Pomodoro with breaks.
- Pick a subject and tasks before you start, so every session counts toward a goal.
- Timer scenes and a full screen mode keep your phone out of the way.
- A Live Activity and a home screen widget show your session and streak at a glance.
CHALLENGES WITH FRIENDS
- Invite friends to a study challenge: streak, time goal, speed race or ranking battle.
- Follow everyone's progress live and see who stays focused the longest.
- Join a challenge from a link, even before you create an account.
LEADERBOARDS AND STREAKS
- Weekly rankings with your friends.
- Daily study streak with streak protection, so one bad day does not erase your progress.
- Comment on your friends' sessions and keep each other accountable.
PLANNER AND STATS
- Day planner with tasks and subjects.
- Study history, subject distribution, activity heatmap and advanced stats.
- Share your weekly results to Instagram Stories in one tap.
FOCUS MUSIC AND SCENES
- Lofi, nature sounds and white noise inside the timer.
- Choose a timer scene and an accent colour that matches your mood.
WHO IS LILO FOR
High school and university students, exam season, homework, language learning, thesis writing, and anyone who focuses better with a bit of friendly competition.
Lilo is free to use. Lilo Premium adds Pomodoro and stopwatch modes, the full focus music library and extra scenes. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Terms: https://lilostudytimer.com/terms/
Privacy: https://lilostudytimer.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00183090:ios.description:
Enter the charming world of Blocky Farm where you can take care of cute pets and animals, style them with cool gadgets and get love in return. Manage your lands, deliver goods to the town with the tractor and create friendship with citizens. Start your farm life today!
Blocky Farm is vege-friendly. No animal is harmed during gameplay!
==============
GAME FEATURES
==============
* MANAGE your farm and supply neighboring town 
* TAKE CARE OF PETS & LOVE ANIMALS - unique system of animals love and interactions
* DRIVE THE TRACTOR with physics-based drive system
* GO FISHING, SWIM BY BOAT and catch 16 unique species
* COMPETE with other farmers & take a part in global events
* BEAUTIFUL 3D GRAPHICS - immersive, interactive, living world
* OFFLINE MODE - play anytime & anywhere you want
* 60 FPS smooth gameplay
* iCloud SUPPORT - play on multiple devices without losing your farm progress!
* VIP MEMBERSHIP - subscribe and unlock great bonuses today!
==============
AWARDS
==============
Blocky Farm was rewarded with the Community Award during Digital Dragons 2017 (Krakow, Poland) conference.
==============
MEDIA MENTIONS
==============
“The game stands out for its charming voxel-style visuals and character design, which includes chickens with top hats and glasses.”
~http://toucharcade.com/2017/09/14/blocky-farm-expanding-its-soft-launch-to-new-zealand-and-australia-wants-more-beta-testers/
“Aside from the usual farming malarky, you can style your teeny creatures with cool gadgets, drive tractors, (...) - and all at a smooth, smooth 60 FPS. “
~http://www.pocketgamer.co.uk/r/iPhone/Blocky+Farm/news.asp?c=72971
==============
SUPPORT
==============
Farmer, are you having problems? Contact our Tech Support at support@jettoast.com or in game by going to Settings.
==============
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
==============
Blocky Farm offers a 3-days free trial, after this period user will be charged. Payments are charged to the user’s Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless the user cancels at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period. User can manage and cancel subscriptions in their account settings on the iOS App Store. For more information check the following link:
End of trial and subscription renewal:
• This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
• Payment will also be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of the free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Canceling trial or subscription:
You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes account. Check https://support.apple.com/HT202039. When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period cannot be canceled. After your subscription expires, you will no longer be able to use elements offered in your chosen Subscription Option.
If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at studio@jettoast.com
Privacy Policy:
https://www.blockyfarm.com/pp.html
Terms of Use:
https://www.blockyfarm.com/tos.html

apple-macos:6476817859.name: Sabertooth for Mastodon
apple-macos:6476817859.description:
Sabertooth puts the power of the fediverse social network in your hand. Access a universe of user-created content and join the decentralized conversation from anywhere.
Connect with friends near and far by following users across instance boundaries. Share your perspective through photos, videos, and short-form posting. Discover new voices and communities by exploring public timelines.
Customize your experience with content warnings, muting, and blocking. Stay in control of your digital life. Harness the strength of open protocols and ethical design.
Sabertooth allows you to tap into the fediverse and join the Mastodon social network through an intuitive, cross-device experience. The future of social media, in your hand.
What is the Fediverse?
The fediverse is a network of decentralized, interoperable social media servers. Each server runs open source software that implements shared protocols like ActivityPub. This enables users on different servers to follow each other and interact across the fediverse.

apple-itunes:1544320618.description:
A NEW game from Tivola! Welcome to the beautiful mountain valley where animals, big and small, live together in peace and harmony. Gain the animals trust. Care for, play and feed all animals. Train with them and discover their unique personalities and stories. Zanda, the little red panda, is here to help guide you through the game. A game full of mini adventures! 
49 UNIQUE CHARACTERS – Furry, scaly or feathery, the mountain valley is a safe home for both wild animals and household pets. Understand all their needs and make friends with them. Their unique stories await! 
EXCITING CHALLENGES – There’s so much to do! Unlock new animals, gain their trust and train them for shared adventures. Use the resources, salads, carrots and many more from your own garden and pond in order to care of all the animals. Hidden treasures await that help you upgrade the mountain valley to make space for even more friends. 
MAKE THE WORLD A LITTLE BIT BETTER – The mountain valley is the ideal refuge for all animals. Mountains, rivers and green meadows give your friends freedom and everything they need to live happily ever after. Send your animals on expeditions to reforest the woods, rebuild dams and more. 
GET TO KNOW THE ANIMALS – Each animal is unique and has their own story. Discover more about their past by forming closer bonds with them. Both beautiful and tragic animal stories await and are recorded in a scrapbook. 
FEATURES 
* Discover the mountain valley 
* Take care of cute animals 
* Meet rare animals 
* Gain their trust 
* Train animals 
* Send them on expeditions 
* Unlock their stories 
* Make your own food

apple-macos:6811712624.name: OpenKind Music
apple-macos:6811712624.description:
Your music, organized your way.
OpenKind Music brings your personal music collection together on iPhone and iPad. Browse songs, albums, artists, and folders; build playlists; save favorites; and find the track you want.
LISTEN YOUR WAY
Play imported audio files offline. Manage your queue with shuffle and repeat, use a sleep timer, and enjoy background playback. For music in your Apple Music library, availability and playback depend on your Apple account, subscription, and the track's permissions.
TRANSFER OVER WI-FI
Move audio files from a computer using a browser on the same local network. Wi-Fi Transfer and Web Player help you manage and listen to your own collection.
LISTEN TOGETHER
Share compatible local-file playback with nearby devices on the same network. Protected Apple Music tracks cannot be shared through Listen Together.
MAKE IT YOURS
Choose your appearance, organize favorites and playlists, and use a focused driving interface with larger playback controls.
NO ACCOUNT REQUIRED
Start with your own music. OpenKind Music does not include a music catalog or a music-download service. Share only audio you have permission to share.
OpenKind Music is free for everyone. There is no trial, subscription, paywall, or purchase required to use any feature. Optional support is separate from app access. Music-library and local-network permissions are requested only for the features that need them.
